title: Aoyagi Toya — Card Story

rows.Line: Kamiyama High School - Class 1-C

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Akito, are you here?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
Hey, Toya. Great timing.
I was just about to go buy lunch...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: What's that in your hands?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: A dog plushie.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
I can tell. That's a really huge plushie, though.
From the arcade again, I'm guessing?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Yes. I saw it at the game arcade on the way back home yesterday, so...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
Why'd you catch it, anyway?
I didn't know you liked dogs that much.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: It was in a position that was difficult to catch, so I felt like I had to take up the challenge.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: You know, people usually go for the easier ones. You're really unconventional here.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
So why'd you bring it to school, anyway?
You caught it yesterday, right?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I left it in a locker at the train station because I didn't want to be told off for bringing it home.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: What? You were hugging it all the way here from the station?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Yes. I chose a bad place to store it, though...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: The locker was pretty small, so the plushie's slimmed down quite a bit from yesterday. I feel kind of bad.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: That's not what I was concerned about...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: I can't believe you came to school holding that thing. You must've really stood out, and not in a good way.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Now that you mention it, I guess I did get a few stares?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Well, I guess that's just you being you.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: At any rate, you really love going to the arcade, huh? It's just a loud and noisy place to me.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: The disorderly mix of noises is quite soothing, actually.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Even so, you go there too often for your own good. It's expensive, right? Especially if you wanted to catch something difficult, like that huge dog?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Not really, I caught this dog in three tries.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
Three tries?!
I thought large toys like that would take a lot more tries than that...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: You can more or less figure out the plushie's density by its size and shape. Once you know that, you can calculate how it will move when applying force to it in a certain way.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Most claw cranes have the same movement range and grip strength, so it's not that difficult to shift the crane to a particular spot you want.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: You can make some rough calculations on the first try. After that, it's just fine-tuning.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: No, that only works for brainy guys like you.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: That's not true. You have what it takes too. In fact, if you just put in some effort, you'd do well in your studies too. Yet, you prefer to simply coast along the passing grade...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
How did we end up talking about my grades?
Anyway, you know it's not my type of thing.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Also, what're you gonna do about that dog plushie? You said you can't bring it home, right?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Yeah. I don't know what my father would say if he sees me with it... Akito, bring it back for your older sister.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Well... Ena'd probably just use it for her social media, but it's a bit too fancy for her tastes, I think...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (Actually, I just don't wanna be seen walking around with something so ridiculous.)

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Sorry. Can you find someone else to take it?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I see... I'll ask Tsukasa, then.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: What? He likes stuff like this?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: No, he has a younger sister who accepted a few plushies from me previously through Tsukasa.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Well then, she's the perfect person to give it to, right?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Yes. In fact, Tsukasa takes really good care of them too.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: He even named the panda I passed him the other day Foreston Bear the First.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Really... Hm?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (Foreston Bear...as in forest bear?)

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: He's just calling it what it is...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Since he named it, he must like it quite a lot.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: He sends me photographs of the panda sometimes too. Foreston Bear the First must be happy to be so loved.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Well, that's good. It means this dog'll be in good hands.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
I agree.
I'll go hand this over to Tsukasa now.
Sorry for taking up your time.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: No problem. I'll head to the stall first. See you later.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
(I don't get it...
Why's Toya so enamored with that guy?)
Kamiyama High School - Corridor

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Hey, Toya. Just saw you walking out from the library. That means your library committee duties are over, right?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: No, I came out to do something in the preparation room.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: You've finished helping out with the soccer club?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Kinda. I slipped out after helping in one intraclub match.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
I see. Can you wait for a while more?
There's still some time left before I can close the library.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Sure, I'll wait for you here.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Here? Why not wait in the library?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
Because I can't listen to music inside.
You'd be the first to pester me about it.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
It's a library, so of course.
Well, I'll see you later then.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Yup. Sheesh, you're such a serious guy.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Huh? Preparation room again?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I'm collecting a book that was returned yesterday but has yet to be shelved. I was going to shelve it after closing the library, but...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Someone may be looking for it, so I'll go pass it along.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: May be looking for it? How'd you know?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: This person was looking around at the same shelf for the book and asked me about it before.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: It's a mystery novel that I've read before, too.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Right...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (Come to think about it, Toya likes to read, doesn't he?)

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (He volunteered for the committee because nobody else wanted to do it, too.)

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: What, again? The library's a really busy place, huh?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Not all the time. An upperclassman was supposed to be on duty with me today, but he caught a cold, so he's resting.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Also, here.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: A book?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: It's an adventure novel. A good way to kill some time.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
Ah, novels are a bit too tedious for me.
I'd read manga instead.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: That's a shame. There are plenty of good novels that—

rows.Speaker: Female Student's Voice
rows.Line: Excuse me, could I borrow a stool to reach that book?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Oh!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: We're in the midst of acquiring a new stool because the current one is a little wobbly.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I'll take the book for you.

rows.Speaker: Female Student's Voice
rows.Line: Are you sure? It's that one on the top shelf...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: This one? Here you go. Are you checking out the book now?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Sorry for running off mid-conversation.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
It's okay...
Actually, just ignore me and focus on your library duties.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: You said you're the only one on duty today, right?

rows.Speaker: Male Student A
rows.Line:
Hello, librarian?
The picture books on this shelf seem to have shifted somewhere...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Picture books? Oh, they should be on the next shelf...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
Yep, serious to a fault.
Or more like, too nice for his own good, I guess.
Miyamasuzaka

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I've got to hurry or I won't make it on time...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Wait, wasn't that...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Hey. Sorry, did you wait long?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Nah, not even a minute.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: That's a relief... Oh?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: What's in that box?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Oh, this?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: My sister, Ena, dragged me out to have cake with her.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (So I was right, that was his sister I saw.)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Do you go out together often?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Are you kidding me? No, it's a bother.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: I went with her this time only because I wanted to get something from that shop myself.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Is it cheesecake?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Yeah. You know me too well.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
You really like your cheesecake.
You had cake at the shop and also bought some to take home?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: No, I didn't have anything to eat while we were there. I can't enjoy my food with Ena around.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Why not?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: She takes forever taking photos of the food from different angles to upload to social media.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: And she doesn't only do it before eating, but also after taking a few bites, and when she's done. It drives me nuts.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I see how that can be annoying.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: But at least I had her pay for my slice of cake.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: I have one for you too. Let's eat it when we get to the live house.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: You got cake for me too?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Ena was in a good mood, so she didn't mind. Must be something to do with her group.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Oh yeah, you mentioned that before, didn't you?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
What was it called, Nightcord?
She chats on that with some friends?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
Yeah. They make music videos.
Ena does the illustrations for them.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: What genre of music?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: I dunno.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: But Ena seems to be having fun with it, so there's that.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: That's good.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Yeah. She flips out less often thanks to that.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Flips out?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: When she gets mad, she throws stuff, or lunges at me trying to scratch me.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
It's not as serious as it sounds.
I can dodge her easily anyway.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
Except her scratch attack.
If I let her get close, she digs her claws in...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: That reminds me, you had lots of scratches on you when we first met.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I assumed you had a cat.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: And what's so funny?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Nothing. I felt a little jealous of your family.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Are you crazy?!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: I guess...things haven't changed at your house?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: No...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
It's not easy for either of us.
You've got problems with your parents, I've got my sister...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Yeah...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (I wish I could be like you, unafraid to say what I think even if it might lead to a fight.)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (I've never managed to be open with my feelings like that.)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (That's probably not going to change...)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (But I wish it did.)
Kamiyama Street

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (I've never been to the event venue where we're meeting today.)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (I think I need to turn into this street?)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Huh? Someone's playing a violin?

rows.Speaker: Passerby A
rows.Line: Look at that guy playing violin! How cool is that!

rows.Speaker: Passerby B
rows.Line:
Yeah, wow.
He's playing so fast, too!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (He's playing so fast that he's going off-key. That violin's not tuned right either...)

rows.Speaker: Violinist
rows.Line: Haha! Despite that I am a music school graduate. That was just a warm-up!

rows.Speaker: Violinist
rows.Line: Want me to show you just how fast I can go?
Live House

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (The sound of that violin is stuck in my head...)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (Why was that guy obsessed with playing fast? It only strains the instrument more...)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (I can't get it out of my head...)

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Yo. It's rare for you to come later than me...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Dude, you don't look so well.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
A-Are you okay, Toya?
Are you feeling unwell?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I'm fine, don't worry...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Why did you look away saying that?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: You're right. I should be honest with you.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Summing up, you heard some punk abuse his violin in public and the noise he was trying to pass for music made you feel physically unwell?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: He wasn't that bad...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Really? He made you feel sorry for his violin.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: So, was it the bad playing that soured your mood, or was it because he was playing the violin?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Both?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Sorry, I don't follow...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
No matter.
We better get started with our practice.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: But Aoyagi isn't feeling well...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: You and An are singing your part first today, no? So you go ahead and meanwhile I'll talk to Toya.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Well, he's your partner, so you look after him.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Kohane, let's leave them to it!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Okay...
Take it easy, Aoyagi.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Sure.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I'm sorry, Akito.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Don't be. You still got that violin stuck in your head, making you feel sick?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Yeah...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Then you need a reset.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: What do you mean?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: I mean this.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (Their singing voices are beautiful as usual, rich and strong.)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Sorry for the wait. I'm ready now.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Alright. Let's make ourselves heard, eh?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: You said it.
After school
Kamiyama High School

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (I've submitted all my work, and I don't think I've forgotten to do anything...)

rows.Speaker: Classmate
rows.Line: Aoyagi? You're not with Shinonome today?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Akito...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I can't perform with you anymore.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: He went back first because he had something on.

rows.Speaker: Classmate
rows.Line: Oh. It just feels weird when you're not together, you know?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: It does?

rows.Speaker: Classmate
rows.Line: It does! Anyway, I may need his help for club activities again soon. Pass the message for me, okay? See you!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Ah... Pass him a message, huh.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (Usually at this time, I would be meeting Akito to sing, or heading over to Weekend Garage...)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (Right now... I have neither Akito nor music with me.)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (And my family...)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Toya!
What are you doing looking all spaced out in a place like this?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Tsukasa...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Huh? What's the matter?
You look like an abandoned puppy.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Hm...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Very well, if you have some time after this, come with me!
Shopping Mall

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
The mall?
Are you buying something here?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Well, actually...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: You're late, Tsukasa! Huh... Toya?!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Tsukasa's younger sister?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Wow, how long has it been? Mom and Tsukasa tell me about you sometimes, but this is our first time actually meeting again in a while, huh? How have you been?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I'm well. How about you, Saki? How's your health?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Aww, thanks for your concern!
You're always so nice and well-mannered.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I've recovered enough to be discharged recently. To prepare for my return to school, I'm here today to get used to the outside! It's just an excuse to play, really♪

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
I see.
I'm just glad you're better now.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Hehe, thanks! But sorry too.
Tsukasa must have dragged you along with him today, right?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
Yes, but I'm grateful for that.
I didn't have anything to do later, anyway...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Hm?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Toya, Saki! If you're done updating each other, let's go! Our first destination is the arcade!
Arcade

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Should we go for another song?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Urgh... I...I can still go on!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Haha, Tsukasa you're terrible with video games. I think even I could beat you with ease!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Hehehe, my dear sister Saki...
Do you really think you can beat me? Your most excellent older brother?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Of course I can!
You heard that, Toya. Change places with me!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Yes, here you go.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Hahaha! I must applaud you for tying with me!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Ugh... I was so close...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Saki. You just need to pay closer attention to the interval between the notes and the song itself.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: O-Okay. Like this?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Ah! This really makes it easier to hit the notes!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Hey, it's not fair to get help from someone else!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Why does it matter?
It's my first time playing this game!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Whoa, the song just got harder.
If I try to do what Toya told me to for this part...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Ugh! This is a really hard part!
Ogh?! Awaaaargh?!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I did it! I beat Tsukasa!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
This cannot be!
I have been thwarted!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Hehe...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Oh, stop being such a drama queen.
Look, even Toya's laughing at you.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
(What?
I was laughing?)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Grr... Saki, Toya! Our next combat shall be held on the battlefield of fighting games!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Ahh... I haven't had so much fun in ages!
Thanks for hanging out with me today, Tsukasa, Toya.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: No, thank you for allowing me to join you.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Good.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Your face looks much better now, Toya.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: What?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: I don't know what exactly happened, but I'm always here for you. I'll never leave my junior classman in a lurch!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
I know.
Thank you for today, Tsukasa.
Vivid Street

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Toya, they're already waiting for us at Weekend Garage.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: We should be able to talk about the event soon, then.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: That reminds me...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Hm?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Some other musicians came up to talk to me the other day, when I was heading home from a show.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Why? Did they say something bad to you?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: No... It was more of a...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (We did pretty well in today's show, generally speaking. The last chorus part, though...)

rows.Speaker: Musician
rows.Line: Hey, aren't you Toya from BAD DOGS?

rows.Speaker: Musician
rows.Line: You performed today too, right?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Yes...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
(I think they were in today's show too...
I wonder what they want from me?)

rows.Speaker: Musician
rows.Line:
You guys rocked!
I hope to see you perform again!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Thank you...

rows.Speaker: Musician
rows.Line: Getting to sing with Akito is a pretty big feat, you know.

rows.Speaker: Musician
rows.Line: Most of the people who asked to partner with him before usually got turned down for not being good enough.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Right...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: But we only partnered up because we have the same goal...

rows.Speaker: Musician
rows.Line: Right, I've heard the rumors.

rows.Speaker: Musician
rows.Line: You're trying to surpass the event that Ken from Weekend Garage pulled off a long time ago, right?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Yes...

rows.Speaker: Musician
rows.Line: Can't wait to see your performance as Vivid BAD SQUAD together with An and Kohane, too!

rows.Speaker: Musician
rows.Line: We won't just be watching wistfully from the audience stand, though. Let's perform together again in another event if we ever get the chance!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Yes, absolutely.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: We had a normal conversation, and then they left.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
I see...
They may be people that I know.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: While you were on your way back from that show... Did they approach you near the shops?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
Yes, they did.
So they were your friends?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Not really. More like people who asked if they could sing with me as a group when I was still going solo.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: But they were more into just singing for fun. Because we had different goals, we never performed as a group together, even if we did take part in the same events.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I see.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: What now? You seem happy about that.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Well...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Although their goals are different from ours, they've been singing in this place for a long time, right?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I'm just happy to be acknowledged by people like that. It makes me feel like I'm allowed to be here.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Allowed... Don't think of yourself like that.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: The more important thing is whether you want to sing here or not. I told you that before, remember?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Yes. I understand what you mean now.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
But I'm still happy about it.
It makes me feel like I'm really being accepted by this town.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Sheesh, this place has always accepted you, right from the start...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
Yes, you're right.
I only realized that because of everyone.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: What?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Because of you, Azusawa, Shiraishi, Ken, and...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Miku, MEIKO, and Len from that mysterious SEKAI, I've come to realize many things I never did before.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Okay...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I'll be counting on your support in the future too, Akito.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: You got it, partner.
Street SEKAI
Crase Cafe

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: And here's your usual blend.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Thank you.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Excellent aroma. It's very relaxing...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Hehe, I'm glad you like it.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Hello, MEIKO!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Oh, Toya's here too!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: He is!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
Welcome!
Sit anywhere you like.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Thanks!
Toya, you're really early.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Yeah, we met Len on the way here too...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: We said to him we were definitely going to be the first to turn up here today, but here you are.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Ah, but I didn't plan on showing up this early either...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I had to pick a time to leave my house when I wouldn't be seen.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Be seen? By who?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: My dad.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Oh, right...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Here you are. Your usual drinks.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Thank you, MEIKO.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Hehe. It's commendable that you make sure to arrive ahead of time!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Len and Rin are such a handful since they'll show up late or forget about meetups entirely!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: But... It's easy to forget the time when you're absorbed in singing.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Oh, wait... I get it now!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Get what?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Why you're always early! It's because you can't wait to sing with everyone, right?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Hmm, maybe?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: It's always a good idea to turn up early for gigs, so you can warm up or gauge the mood of the audience...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Yeah, so it's exactly as I said! It's because you can't wait to get started with your show!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: And what do you two think about it...?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Haha! If Len's so convinced, he may be right.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I see...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
You must feel it, Toya.
The happy anticipation!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Anticipation?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Like when you see the excited audience waiting in front of the live house!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
Or when talking with your group backstage!
And when it's almost time to get on stage!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Huh? Don't tell me you don't feel that way!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Um, I know what you're talking about, Len.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: In my case it's not just anticipation, but also a bit of anxiety.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: How did you feel during STAY GOLDEN, Toya?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: I mean, it didn't end the way we hoped...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: But when we were talking about it at my dad's cafe, you seemed enthusiastic and smiling too.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I remember that...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: But it was you two that made me smile.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: What? Us?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Yeah. You were so excited for STAY GOLDEN that you could hardly sit still.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
So that means...
You were laughing at us being hyper?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Wait, really?!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Haha... But we really were bouncing off the walls that day.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Wow, we were probably acting like little kids. Please tell us if that happens again...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Hm? Sure.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Geez... I bet my dad and Akito were rolling their eyes at us. I'm getting embarrassed just thinking about it now.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Why? I think it's great that you got so excited that you went a little nuts!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Excitement, huh...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (I've never really been aware of my emotions when it came to singing or getting the crowd hyped...)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (Next time we do a gig, I'll try to be more mindful of what I'm feeling.)
Weekend Garage

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Okay, team. Let's talk about our next gig.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
So we'll be performing at the event An's friend invited
us to?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
That's right. It's a good chance for us to show off just how
good we got. Let's make the most of it!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Yeah! Sounds good!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: What's up, Toya? Why are you spacing out?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
I was just trying to imagine what you guys are feeling
right now.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Dude, what?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Let me guess, what Len said the other day really made you
think?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: What did Len say?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
That I get excited for singing even though I don't realize
it.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Hmm, I see...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
It would be helpful to me if you could describe your
emotions before the gig.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Haha! You sound like you're not from this planet, Toya.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
As for me, I feel happy that I'll be singing together with
Kohane, and that I'll be performing in front of people...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: I guess that's what you'd call happy anticipation!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Your turn, Kohane.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Um... I feel very motivated, but also tense.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
But compared to when I started, I'm less tense and
more motivated!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I see. Akito, how about you?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
Hmm... I'm dead set on getting the audience more fired
up than anyone else. I've got to make it a success.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: And what are your feelings, Aoyagi?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I... Hmm...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Come on, dude. Say something.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
I'm sorry, I couldn't think of anything to say, so instead
I tried imagining how I feel during gigs.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Okay, and what have you got?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
I always try to tune in to how everyone's feeling, paying
attention to the tone of your voices.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
I also try to read the audience's reaction to the group
who performed before us.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: But this is just what I do, not how I feel...

rows.Speaker: An's Father
rows.Line:
Understanding one's feelings can be difficult, eh. Here's
what you ordered.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Thank you!

rows.Speaker: An's Father
rows.Line: You're welcome. Enjoy.

rows.Speaker: An's Father
rows.Line: If you don't mind me butting into your conversation...

rows.Speaker: An's Father
rows.Line:
Toya, it sounds to me like you have this ambition to make
your gigs great.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: An's Father
rows.Line: Isn't that right?

rows.Speaker: An's Father
rows.Line:
What you've been describing is the actions needed to make
your shows work.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Thanks, An. You can be sure that I'm going to give it my all
at the show!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
I know you will! If you're feeling lost, just focus on my
voice.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I'd say we're poised for success at STAY GOLDEN.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
You don't wanna get complacent. Anyway, I'll see you later.
I've got some business to take care of.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Okay, later.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
(Something tells me he's going to practice on his own.
After all that singing... Akito's a perfectionist when it
comes to singing.)

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
By the way, you were acting weird after STAY GOLDEN.
Like you were out of it.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Now I know what it was. You were disappointed.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Was I?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: You should know.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Was my dad right on point, Toya?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Yes. I do want to make our gigs the best they can be.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
So that we contribute to the events we perform at, and
show the audience a good time.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Right? Isn't it fun when we hit all the right notes? I think
that also points to you feeling some sort of anticipation!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Yes, maybe.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
We're on the same page then. Gotta make our next gig
awesome.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Yeah! Let's do this, guys!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Let's make it a success.
Two weeks before the School Festival
Weekend Garage

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: The School Festival is just around the corner. My class is pretty much ready now. How about yours?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Sigh... We really gotta buckle down to get ready in time.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: So we won't be able to practice together until the festival's over?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Yup.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Well, it's a special school event.
We should participate and help out.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: By the way, can you come to the festival, Kohane? It'd be awesome to see everything together!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Um, it's in two weeks, right? I'm going on a trip with my family that weekend...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Aww, man...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: But the festival goes all the way into the night, so you can drop by anytime and I'll show you around!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Okay! I don't think you told me yet what your class is doing for the festival.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Just your standard cafe, but we're gonna have really fancy decor so you gotta check it out!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Yeah, cool! How about you, Shinonome, Aoyagi?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
We're doing a haunted house.
But well, that is a shame...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: I wish you could come. I'd even put in the effort to scare you out of your wits.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Whaaat?! No, no... Th-That's okay...!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I thought you were just the receptionist, Akito?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Yeah, but I can tell the monster team what to do.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
Wanna come test your courage?
It's supposed to be pretty scary.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: M-Me?! Uh... Sorry, but I'll be too busy with my class and seeing everything else so... Pass!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: S-So what are you guys doing, Toya?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: A cotton candy stall. We'll have a few different types too, and it'll probably be fun just to see them all.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Different types of cotton candy?
Like different colors?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
Let me show you a picture I took earlier.
We're making ones like this for example.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Oh, wow! An, look at that!
That's really amazing!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Hmm? What, is this for real?
It's a teddy bear! That's so cute!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
That's really well made.
Wait, you really made those?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
Yeah. It's surprisingly easy.
You just follow the instructions.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
We can also make bunnies and unicorns.
All of my classmates really liked them too.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Hmph. So you're busy getting a stall ready for the event like a real student.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Well, he's always taken school seriously.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: But you're helping with your class' thing too, Akito.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Only during lunch breaks or when I don't have work.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Same here. I'm too busy with my dad's cafe, so I haven't had much time to help out with our class' cafe.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Right...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: In my case, I think getting into it because I'm just trying to make up for lost time.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: What do you mean?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Oh. Until now, I never really got to participate in many school events.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: I think it's more like, You weren't allowed to...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: What?!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Why couldn't you...?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: My parents wouldn't let me. They wanted me to practice the piano rather than waste time on stuff like this.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: They always made me spend my weekends playing the piano too. In my dad's mind, school events only got in the way of practice.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: My mom was paranoid about me getting hurt and not being able to become a pianist... She even banned me from playing any ball sports.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: She wouldn't let me go on outings, camping or even school trips.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: That's crazy...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: My parents kept telling me I had to practice every single day, or I'd lose all of my progress.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: It's like the drivel you hear with sports clubs, like it takes three days to make up for one missed day of training...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
Anyway, I don't have to live like that anymore.
I'm taking part in the School Festival this time.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Yeah. That's great...!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: It is. That means you have to get as much out of this festival as you can, Toya!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
I'll definitely stop by your stall!
I'll bring some friends too!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Yeah. That'll be nice.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Sooo, can I get a buddy discount?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
...
Okay. I'll think about it.
Street SEKAI

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: It's nice to be here again.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Yeah, we've all been too busy with the School Festival to drop by.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I missed the taste of MEIKO's special brew.
Crase Cafe

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
Oh! Hey, guys!
It's been a while!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Hey, it's Akito and Toya!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
Yeah! Great to see you again!
Let's all sit together!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Sure. In that case, if you don't mind...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
Is Miku not here today...?
At least we get to see this cheerful bunch.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Huh? Do we look cheerful to you...?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: We've all been pretty down because it's so boring when you don't visit.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Sorry, school kept us busy.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Should I get you your usual?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Yeah, thanks.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Yes, please.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Okay. It'll be just a moment!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
So what were you so busy with?
Is it those tests you keep talking about?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
No, it was because of the School Festival.
Preparing for it took up a lot of time.

rows.Speaker: Rin & Len
rows.Line: The School Festival...?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Huh? You don't know what it is?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Hmm... Is it when you turn your classroom into haunted houses and stuff?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Huh? Len, no!
It's all about food stalls!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: You're both right.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Students prepare all sorts of attractions for this event. There are student-run shops, shows and all sorts of other stuff. It's a lot of fun.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: In fact, my class did a haunted house.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Whoa, that's so cool!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: What did your class do, Toya?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: We had a cotton candy stall.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Wow, cotton candy?!
The puffy clouds of sweetness?!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: That's right. We made ones that looked like animals.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: I didn't know you could do that! That sounds amazing!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Toya, show them that picture.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Oh, sure. Let me find it... Here.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Aww! It's so cute! Len, look!
It's a cotton candy teddy bear!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
Yeah, that's awesome!
You took cotton candy to the next level!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Sigh... I wish I could've seen you make that!
I'm really craving one right now...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: You need a special cotton candy maker for this...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
Alright, here's your coffee!
Be careful. It's very hot.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
MEIKO, wait!
You have to see this!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: A cotton candy bear? That's adorable.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: MEIKO, do you think you might have a cotton candy maker lying around the store somewhere?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Hmm, I don't know.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: There's a whole pile of mics and speakers, but I doubt we have one of those.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: That'd be too good to be true...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: If you wouldn't mind waiting a bit...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I could see if I can borrow a home cotton candy maker from a classmate. We've been using it to practice making them before the festival.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Really?!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Well, no guarantees...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Yay! This is so exciting...!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
Rin, don't get your hopes up just yet.
What if he can't borrow the machine?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: I know, Len... But I'm really looking forward to it♪

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Hehe. I like listening to you all talk about music, but school life's interesting too. It's nice to get to know everyone from this sort of perspective.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Huh, really?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Yes, really. As students, you get to experience so many different things, right?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: It all contributes to the ways you express yourselves.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: How we express ourselves...?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Like when we sing?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Oh, I see.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Well, this is a cafe, so you're free to chat about anything you like.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: But I guess it's only natural that you all gravitate towards discussing music.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Haha. Yeah.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (How we express ourselves, huh...? People often tell me that they can't figure out what I'm thinking because I always seem to have a blank expression on my face.)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (Maybe new experiences will eventually help me learn to be more expressive.)

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Toya, what are you thinking about this time...?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Oh, nothing. I think I just realized something is all.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Well, alright. Cool.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Yeah.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
(And aside from being more expressive,
I want to participate in more school events!)
Toya's Room

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: It wasn't by chance.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: It's because you got over whatever was going on between you and your dad.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
(I really enjoyed the last event.
And what happened with my dad...)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
(It's been a while since I felt this good.
I'd like to get some practice in...)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
(But we all agreed to take a break today.
Maybe I'll just relax listening to some music.)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
(Come to think of it,
Akito lent me that CD and... Hm?)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: What's this...?
Street SEKAI
Crase Cafe

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Hello.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Oh! Hi, Toya!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Yay, good to see you!
Come sit with us!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Sure.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Welcome. Is it just you today?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Yes. We don't have practice today, so I thought I'd come here and just listen to some music.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
And if it's alright with you...
Would you mind putting this CD on?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Oh, is it classical music?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Yes. It's a recording of my dad's solo concert.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I couldn't stand the sight of it, so I put it away and forgot about it until coming across it by chance today.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: I see. And you felt like giving it another listen?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Yes... I thought that if I listened to it here after telling my dad how I felt about music, then I could finally appreciate it for what it is.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
Okay, sounds good.
We can all listen to it together.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: I'm curious to hear what your dad sounds like too!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Wait, Len. It's classical music.
Won't you just fall asleep halfway through?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: No, it won't! And if you fall asleep listening, Rin, I'll doodle all over your face!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Challenge accepted!
I'll do the same to you if you doze off!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
(I made the right call coming here.
I'd just overthink things again if I were alone...)

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Okay, shall I go and put the CD on?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Yes, thank you.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: That was really awesome...!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Yeah, it really was!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: I loved the third piece the best. It felt so sad that my heart sort of began to sink, but at the same time, that was what I really liked about it!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: I liked the one towards the end. It felt like a piece where a lot of people would be singing and dancing!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Oh, I totally get that!
I had the same image in my head too!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
Right? Toya, your dad's amazing.
How does he play like that?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Thanks. I feel proud of being his son after hearing that.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: It changed my impression of your dad too, you know.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Based on what I heard about him from you earlier, I thought he was a cold and strict person, but his performance was very rich and colorful.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
Well, he is very strict.
Especially when it comes to classical music...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: That may be due to his playing style as well...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: What about his style?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: It's all about his steadfast conviction when it comes to performing.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: His goal is to flawlessly portray the composer's thoughts or intentions.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: He not only learns the actual music, but also researches the composer and their surrounding musical composition until he knows all there is to know about them.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: By doing this, he recreates the composer's vision for a piece in his head and plays accordingly.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
Wow...
That's incredibly thorough...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: It's also why he despises anything that deviates from the composer's original vision, such as different arrangements, additions and such...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: I see...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I used to look up to Dad since I was little.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
But he also put me under pressure.
He wanted me to play the same way as him...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Yet you're putting him in such a good light now...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Yes... I'm finally glad that I can listen to my dad's music and feel respect for him instead of stress...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: That's great, Toya.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
Toya, if it's alright with you,
would you mind if I borrowed this CD for a bit?
I'd like to listen to it some more.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Of course.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Hehe. Thank you.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
Oh, let me treat you to some coffee jelly.
You know, as a small token of my appreciation.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Here you go. And for Rin and Len, I have fruit jelly! I only made enough for three, so you get to be the lucky ones today!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Yay, treats!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Thanks, MEIKO!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: You're welcome! Enjoy!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Thank you very much. I'm sure we will.
Live House

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: We're on soon...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Oh... That's a big audience. I still can't believe we got invited as guests to this event!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: I bet it's thanks to all that word of mouth publicity we got after our last show. Our customers have been talking about it lately too.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: As good as that one was, we gotta keep raising the bar and make that our standard.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: So let's show them what we got today too, guys.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Right. Let's do this!

rows.Speaker: MC
rows.Line:
Give it up for Vivid BAD SQUAD!
Talk about an unreal performance!

rows.Speaker: Spectator A
rows.Line:
Wow, that was awesome!
They really the same group from STAY GOLDEN?

rows.Speaker: Spectator B
rows.Line: Yeah, they really stepped up their game!

rows.Speaker: Old Regular
rows.Line: Wait, I know these guys...
Weekend Garage

rows.Speaker: An's Father
rows.Line: Looks like your last gig was a success.

rows.Speaker: An's Father
rows.Line: Right after I opened up this morning, customers who said they saw you came in droves to tell me about it.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Wow, really?!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: That should make people forget about our flop at STAY GOLDEN.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I agree.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Welco... Oh, hello!

rows.Speaker: Old Regular
rows.Line: Ah, great! Perfect timing!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Oh, that's Ken's old friend...

rows.Speaker: Old Regular
rows.Line: Hey, kids! I was hoping to find you here!

rows.Speaker: Old Regular
rows.Line:
I went to your gig the other day too.
Just wow! Absolutely phenomenal!

rows.Speaker: Old Regular
rows.Line: In particular...

rows.Speaker: Old Regular
rows.Line:
Your singing knocked my socks off!
Your style's really come together,
and so quickly too...!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Thank you.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: But I need to return that gratitude as well. What you'd said gave me the opportunity to rethink a few things about myself as well.

rows.Speaker: Old Regular
rows.Line: Is that so? I'm happy to hear that!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I think I'm very fortunate. Especially when it's come to meeting people.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I'm who I am now thanks to the support and encouragement of those around me.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: At the same time, I do seem to be making progress, but also don't feel that I've changed much myself...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Well duh. You're still you, dude.

rows.Speaker: Old Regular
rows.Line: Hahaha! True, true!

rows.Speaker: Old Regular
rows.Line:
You really make an excellent team.
And you're right, Toya...
It's rare to be in such good company at your age.

rows.Speaker: Old Regular
rows.Line: I'll definitely be keeping an eye on all of you!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Thank you. We'll keep doing our best.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (I really am lucky to have friends like Tsukasa, Ken, Azusawa and Shiraishi... And most of all...)

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Hm? Why are you staring at me?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: No reason...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Yeah, right. I could tell you had something to say to me.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Oh?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Dude, I've learned to read that poker face of yours.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Tell me what it was or it's gonna start bugging me.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Nope...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: What?! Why not?! Come on, tell me, dude!

rows.Speaker: An's Father
rows.Line: Haha. This is a rare sight.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: It is... Now I'm getting curious...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Hehe. Me too!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: See, everyone wants to hear it.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I'm still not telling.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Oh, come on! What's the big deal?!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Forget them, just tell me! Aren't we best buds?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: And that's the reason I won't tell you.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Cut it out already! Why make it some huge secret?!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (Because it's clear that I don't need to say that you're the best partner I could ask for.)
Diner

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Phew...
We got more than I expected.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: But thanks to you, Toya, everything went smoothly! You have my gratitude!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: No, I didn't do anything. All I did was carry some things for you.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I just hope the Doll Festival party turns out well.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Yes, we got all the party goods Saki likes to have, so it's bound to be a great success!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: But I'm sure you're tired after all that, no?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Please, don't mind me. I didn't have any other plans today either so...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Tsukasa...?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Well, it's just that you seem to be smiling more often now.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I am...?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: When we were kids, I always tried my hardest to make you laugh or smile, but I guess you don't need any of that now...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: You're like a little brother to me, and next to Saki, my number two fan!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: I should thank Akito for helping you turn things around.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
That'd be nice...
But I also have you to thank, Tsukasa.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: As I mentioned before, you were the one that actually led me to meeting Akito in the first place.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: And do you remember the time when we first met...?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Hmm... Oh, it was when you came over to my house when your parents needed a sitter.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Yes.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (Our parents already knew each other from before, but I didn't and was a little scared at first...)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (I didn't even know that Tsukasa was learning to play the piano just like I was...)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (I wasn't sure about what to say if he asked me to play with him, but...)

rows.Speaker: Little Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Alright, Toya!
You're gonna help me with some training!

rows.Speaker: Little Toya
rows.Line: Training...?

rows.Speaker: Little Tsukasa
rows.Line: Yes! My little sister, who's in the hospital right now, and I compete to see who can find people the fastest in these books, but she always wins...

rows.Speaker: Little Tsukasa
rows.Line: That's why I want to win next time and show her what her big brother is made of!

rows.Speaker: Little Toya
rows.Line: Umm... So you want to me to look with you?

rows.Speaker: Little Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Exactly! So let's get started!
On the first page...

rows.Speaker: Little Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Here...! No, that's not him...
I didn't notice the cleft chin at first...

rows.Speaker: Little Toya
rows.Line: Huh? Is it this person way off to the right...?

rows.Speaker: Little Tsukasa
rows.Line: What?! You're the main character! Why are you hiding over there?! I feel cheated for some reason...

rows.Speaker: Little Tsukasa
rows.Line:
But well done, Toya!
You did great!

rows.Speaker: Little Toya
rows.Line:
Huh?
Oh, hehe...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Although I do have older brothers, they're much older than me and were sent off to study before I even got a chance to get to know them better...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: On top of that, I hardly ever had time to play with my friends because of piano and violin practice.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: But after that day, I started going over to your house more and more where you even started showing me your plays.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: You really helped keep my spirits up...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Toya...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: There's something I need to thank you for as well.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: There is...?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: The first time we met, I'd already gone to see Saki that day.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: We played together like always but when it came time to go home, Saki started crying all the sudden...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: She'd been in the hospital so long by then, everything she kept pent up inside just seemed to come bursting out.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
She even said, Please, don't go...
But all I could tell her was that I'd be back tomorrow and we could play again...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: The fact that I couldn't bring back Saki's smile kept bothering me so much.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: But that day, you smiled.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Your smile made me want to make Saki smile. It made me want to keep my promise to her.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I see. That's so nice.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Also, I still ended up losing to her when we started going through those books together.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Toya, you don't owe me anything. Just know that you've been there for me too.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Okay...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: It's been a long time coming, but thank you for then, Toya.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
You're welcome.
And thank you as well...
Weekend Garage

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Alright, we've got our set list for the next event, so we can start getting working out the finer details for practice.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I agree. I'm very much looking forward to it.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Yeah! We've all been on fire lately too!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I'll see you tomorrow.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Oh, Aoyagi! One sec!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Hm? Yes?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Um, I saw you in town hanging out with someone the other day. Were you two out shopping together?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: I swear he looked exactly like someone that does shows for the Wonder Stage too!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: It has to be...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Oh, you mean Tsukasa? Yes, he is a member of that troupe.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: You've mentioned that you're a fan of Phoenix Wonderland, no?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: I am! Wait, does that mean you're friends with one of the cast members, Aoyagi?!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: He's like an older brother to me and I respect him very much. We've known each other quite a long time as well.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: I didn't know that...!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: So, what were you out doing with Tsukasa...?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Oh, he was looking for something to buy for her sister's Doll Festival party.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Doll Festival party?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: A lot happened after that and I ended up being invited as well.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Really? At school, he's famous for being some kind of weirdo, but that's pretty nice of him to do for his little sister's party.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: It was.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: By the way... Did you celebrate the Doll Festival with your family too, Azusawa, Shiraishi?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Sort of... We has chirashi sushi together if that counts...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Oh, same at my house.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: And we didn't go this year, but we usually go to my grandmother's house to set up our dolls together as a family.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Tsukasa said he does the same. I guess it really is a big family event.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: It is! Oh, but my dad sort of likes to take photos more than set up the dolls...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: He always tries to get me to look towards the camera or pose with dolls a certain way, so it takes a long time to get anything done...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: And he always gets scolded by my mom and grandmother...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Haha! He must really love taking pictures of you, Kohane!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
I have to agree.
What about you, Shiraishi?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: We celebrated too, but we only brought out the emperor and empress. Oh, except that we put them on top of an amp as a little tradition.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Wait, on an amp?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: It's one of my dad's. He has so much equipment lying around the house, it's about the only place they can go.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: And Ken was probably still a part of the scene when he had you too.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
Oh, you're right.
But how about you, Akito?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Me? Uh...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: You have an older sister, so I figured that you celebrate every year as well...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Yeah, we do. It's a pain getting everything set up, so I don't really have much of an interest in it...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: But you still get your dolls out and celebrate?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: We do.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: But there was this time my big sister started crying because she thought the dolls were making scary faces or something...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: I can sort of understand why...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Yeah, me too. The fancier ones are even creepier since their eyes are almost too well made, you know?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: I get that. Our dad even modified their eyes a little since she just wouldn't stop crying...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: But he did mumble something about messing with other people's works too...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: He did that just for her?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: You should've seen Ena then. She was so loud and there was no end to it...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: But as a result, our dolls kind of have more aesthetically pleasing faces now, I guess?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
That's pretty neat!
Hehe. I'd like to see them sometime!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Me too! Can you take a picture for us, Akito?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Why? C'mon, don't make me...!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Dude, just one picture!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I always thought that I'd really have nothing to do with the Doll Festival, but it's nice to hear about all your stories...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: I agree. I want to keep learning more about everyone too, like your families and stuff.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Families, huh...?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (Until now, I didn't think anyone would understand, even if I did talk to them about my dad or brothers...)

rows.Speaker: Toya's Father
rows.Line: I... I can't understand what people see in that sort of music...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Dad, were you...?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: He did come to see us.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (I've finally been able to convey to him what kind of music I actually like...)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (So maybe I can talk to everyone a little more about my family now...)
Vivid Street

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: I convinced myself that in order for us to surpass RAD WEEKEND, I needed to become as good as I possibly could.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: I'm sorry about that. I didn't realize what I was doing...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (I'm glad that we were able to get through to Akito in the end...)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Akito, we should eat lunch soon...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Akito...?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
Huh? Toya...?
Sorry, I guess I spaced out...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (He didn't seem too well when he came to school yesterday either...)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (I hope he can go back to being his old self soon...)
Weekend Garage

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Hello.

rows.Speaker: An's Voice
rows.Line: You got so many toppings for your coffee again, Kohane!

rows.Speaker: Akito's Voice
rows.Line: Aren't you getting a little carried away with them?

rows.Speaker: Kohane's Voice
rows.Line: Hehe. They all look so yummy, I can't help but try them out.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (It looks like everyone's already here...)

rows.Speaker: An's Father
rows.Line:
Oh, it's Toya! Welcome!
Your usual I'm guessing?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Yes, please.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Toya, over here!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Ah...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
You're here early.
And what were you talking about just now? Something interesting?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: We were talking about coffee toppings. Show him, Kohane.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Sure! Today I got whipped cream, chocolate chips and a big helping of caramel sauce!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: You got quite a bit there.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Hehe. One just didn't seem like enough, so I ended up getting a few.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: You turned your drink into a high-calorie snack...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Hey, no talking about calories and stuff when a girl's enjoying her drink.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Hm? What is it?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Oh, it's nothing.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (He seems better than he did yesterday.)

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: You've been getting different sets of toppings too, Kohane. How do you decide what you want to get?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Um... It sort of has to do with what I'm feeling that day, but also if there's anything I want to try.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I see. I usually get the same thing every time. I'm not sure that I've gotten anything based on how I feel that day before.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Plus, you don't really like sweets.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: True. Hm...?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
You got some toppings too, Akito?
You hardly ever get any.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Yeah, just a dollop of cream and some caramel sauce.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Ken said he'd add them as a freebie, so I said yes.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Hmm... I'm sort of starting to get jealous of you coffee types.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Oh, right... You prefer tea over coffee, right?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Yeah. I can't really add any toppings like you guys can.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Right, cream and caramel sauce wouldn't go very well with tea, would it?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: That may be true, but at least you get a slice of lemon when you order lemon tea or...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: That's right! Citrus fruits go great with tea! There's all sorts of fruity teas out there too!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: There's even Russian tea that has jam in it!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Really? I didn't know that!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Honey with milk tea is good too.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Exactly!
But not many places actually serve that...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Hang on... You're usually never interested in stuff like this, Akito.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: She's right...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: I-I'll join in from time to time...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Oh? You're not denying it though...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
Quiet, you.
Just leave it...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (It looks like he'll be back to his old self soon...)

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: And why are you grinning like that, Toya...?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Oh, it's nothing.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Thanks...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: You know, for making you all worry about me and everything...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Akito...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Whoa, hold up! An actual apology...?!
What's gotten into you, Akito?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: What? I'm just trying to do the right thing here!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: And we're all finally here, so let's get started with practice.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Hehe. I'm glad he feels better now.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Yeah. I get that he wanted to beat Arata by himself, but we're gonna do that as a team.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I'm sorry for dragging you into this too...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
No, you don't need to apologize.
We're a team, right?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Yeah!
I want us all to work together!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
Me too...
Thanks, you two.

rows.Speaker: Akito's Voice
rows.Line: Hey, what's the hold up? Let's go already!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Okay, we'll be right there!
Weekend Garage
Weekend Garage Stage

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
Phew...
That should be good for now.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Yeah, shall we call it a day for practice?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
Sounds good.
Oh, I have to get to work. Later.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Great work, everyone!
See you tomorrow!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Alright, I think I'll take a break.
How about you, Kohane, Toya?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: I'd like that.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Sure, a cup of coffee does sound nice...

rows.Speaker: Kotaro
rows.Line: Hm? You guys...?!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Mita? It's been a while...

rows.Speaker: Kotaro
rows.Line: Yeah! I just ran into Akito a second ago too. I didn't realize you were all here.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Yes, we were borrowing the stage as part of our practice.

rows.Speaker: Kotaro
rows.Line: You serious? You get to use this place as your own practice studio...? No, that's not why I'm here...!

rows.Speaker: Kotaro
rows.Line: Akito looked a lot better now than he did before. Like he's back to his usual self, you know?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Yes, and we're sorry for making you so concerned about him. Everything is alright now.

rows.Speaker: Kotaro
rows.Line: That's good.

rows.Speaker: Kotaro
rows.Line: But it's been so long since I last saw Akito with that look on his face.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I understand. Not since when we just formed BAD DOGS or maybe even when he was doing solo performances...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Wait... I knew about Toya and Akito going way back, but you too, Kotaro?

rows.Speaker: Kotaro
rows.Line: I'm in the same boat as these two. After I saw RAD WEEKEND, I felt like diving right into this world.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: I see...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: So what was Akito like back then?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: It sounded like he was way more of a bad boy based on what you've been telling us.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I wouldn't go that far, and he didn't have that look when he first invited me to join him either.

rows.Speaker: Kotaro
rows.Line: Man, you guys aren't showing any mercy at all...

rows.Speaker: Kotaro
rows.Line: But I guess he really hasn't changed that much since then.

rows.Speaker: Kotaro
rows.Line: The biggest difference might be how he used to go after guys that made fun of him.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Oh, right. A lot more people started becoming performers after RAD WEEKEND happened...

rows.Speaker: Kotaro
rows.Line: Exactly. Everyone looked up to Ken and his team back then!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Hehe. It really wasn't that long ago, but it feels so nostalgic.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: All those voices, all those songs, all those performances... They were all part of what made it such a legendary night!

rows.Speaker: Kotaro
rows.Line: But some guys also fought over where to play or what to sing. Then a bunch of new live houses started popping after that.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Is that why there are so many live houses on Vivid Street...?

rows.Speaker: Kotaro
rows.Line: Yeah. But you know what they say, The nail that sticks up gets hammered down.

rows.Speaker: Kotaro
rows.Line: Older musicians would tease or bully younger musicians, and some just stopped showing up altogether.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Right. That does happen...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: You too, An...?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Yeah, I've had to deal with it a few times. They'd crash an event I was in and try to test how good I was.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: If you do well, they'll help get the crowd going for you and even give some advice on how to get better.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: That's pretty cool of them to do that.

rows.Speaker: Kotaro
rows.Line: Most of them are good guys that are just as into music as we are.

rows.Speaker: Kotaro
rows.Line: But there's always a few bad apples.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Akito tended to attract the latter type to him...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Wait, why...?

rows.Speaker: Kotaro
rows.Line: Because he told everyone that he'd put on an event that surpasses RAD WEEKEND on his own.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Mita's right. Most of the older musicians are indeed good people but...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: There's always some that feel the need to bring you down to their level.

rows.Speaker: Kotaro
rows.Line: But because of his personality, he'd usually end up biting back.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: True.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
Who do they think they are?
Making fun of someone's dreams like that.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Why are you even here if you don't have any hopes or dreams?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: A lot of things made Akito mad back then.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: To be fair, it's not that he wanted to be angry...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Everybody has dreams that they're aspiring towards, so it's perfectly normal to be furious with someone that tries to take that away from you.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: At the same time, he'd get mad at people who said they'd surpass RAD WEEKEND even though they weren't serious about it.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: I see...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: I really does mean that much to him.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: True.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: His dedication is why I chose to join him...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Just ignore the haters and let them say what they want.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: We'll silence them all someday...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Right. And we can do that by starting a team together.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Then it's settled!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Starting now, we're the BAD DOGS!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: BAD DOGS...?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Yeah, like a pair of dogs that no one can train or teach anything.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: The way everyone else probably sees it, what we're trying to do is completely nuts.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: We'll show them. They'll know what it feels like when the dogs bite back.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Wait, is this why you were asking me so many questions about English?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Yeah, but it also has a different meaning too.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: A different meaning?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Yeah. BAD DOGS is apparently a slangy way of saying that we're serious business.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: How's that sound?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (I didn't really think about it because I didn't really understand back then but...)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (I have to think he chose dogs for our name for another reason...)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Aoyagi, is something wrong...?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: No, I was just thinking about how much we'd been through even though it's only been two years.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I'm sure a lot more will happen in the future as well.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Yeah, but we'll be fine.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: I think so too! As long as we're together, we should be able to overcome anything!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I agree. I'll be counting on you two when that happens.

rows.Speaker: Kotaro
rows.Line: And I'm not giving up either!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: We wouldn't expect anything less.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (We have to keep moving forward if we're actually going to surpass RAD WEEKEND...)
Wedding Ceremony Hall - Waiting Room

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Our final rehearsal went pretty well.

rows.Speaker: Man A
rows.Line: Yeah, that was good! Wanna go take a break now?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I appreciate the offer, but I'd like to go check on my friend and the dance team first...

rows.Speaker: Man B
rows.Line: Sure, go for it! We'll see you later!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Okay.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Now then...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Stand more proudly! Be mindful of how you move your fingers as well! Imagine that each of your fingers has its own personality!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (Kamishiro's really giving it everything he has. Our entire team's morale seems good too, so we should be able to pull this off.)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (Now, how's Akito doing...?)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (Oh, wow... They're not looking bad themselves. I can't really complain...)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (I'm so glad that I asked Akito to do this...)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Very good. The dance team is coming along nicely.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Well, yeah. I wouldn't be showing you this if we weren't.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Hehe. Indeed.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Now, let us get some rest before the...

rows.Speaker: Hall Staff
rows.Line: Excuse me. The bride said that she'd like to go over things one last time before everything begins. Is there anyone available for that?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Oh, yes... I'll be right there...!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Hm? Toya, what's up?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Oh, hi. My team just decided to take a quick break.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Then how about we go get some fresh air?
Wedding Ceremony Hall

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
This breeze is nice.
I'm glad it's so sunny out today. It's a perfect day for our little surprise.
