rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: But I'm pretty amazed that we got this much done in this little time.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: I actually regretted saying yes to this when I saw the entire team for the first time.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Luckily, they're all pretty good at dancing and staying in rhythm, so it turned out to be pretty easy.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I suspect how Kamishiro decided what we'd all be doing helped make that happen too.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: He even went through the trouble of asking each of us about our individual talents and experience.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Really? He did that with all of you guys...?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Yes. I've never done any acting before either, so choosing teams couldn't have been easy.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: That's got nothing to do with you. He's the one that agreed to take over, so it's all on him.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Yes, I know. But...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (I think Akito has the wrong idea about Kamishiro...)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (He'd understand if he heard what I did back there from Kamishiro...)

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Toya? Hey, Toya, you there?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Huh...?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: You mad or something?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: What...?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: This was originally between me and Tsukasa. I guess I just don't feel that great about roping you into this so suddenly...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: So...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
Is that all...?
Dude, stop worrying so much.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: In your case, you're almost too passive, you know?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: But...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: If you need help, just ask, but I'll say no when I want to. It's as simple as that.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Plus, not all dances or dancers are the same. I think asking for my help was a good call this time around.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: And I have nothing against Kamishiro if that's what you're worried about.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: I knew he was egging me on to join, so it's all good.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Akito...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Honestly, I just can't figure out what Kamishiro's thinking...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: But I do know that he's serious about making all these people happy with his show.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: I can't make fun of someone like that.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (That's right. Akito's just...)

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: I feel like I'm being played by him...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: But I said I'll help, so I'm giving it everything I've got. No ifs, ands or buts...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I see.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (I think I was the one getting the wrong idea...)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Akito, let's make sure this surprise succeeds.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Don't worry, we will!
Kamiyama High School - Class 1-B

rows.Speaker: Toya's Classmate
rows.Line: Hey, Toya. There's something I want to ask you.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Yes?

rows.Speaker: Toya's Classmate
rows.Line: This wedding video's been going viral on social media, and I saw two guys that looked exactly like you and Akito in it...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
Yes, that's us.
Someone passing by must've taken that video.

rows.Speaker: Toya's Classmate
rows.Line: You serious?! This is what you guys do for work?!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
No, it's nothing like that.
I was there because a friend of mine couldn't make it that day.

rows.Speaker: Toya's Classmate
rows.Line: Oh, okay... But this was pretty surprising, you know? I mean, look, your dance moves are perfect!

rows.Speaker: Toya's Classmate
rows.Line: When we're playing soccer during gym and stuff, you hardly ever do anything so I just assumed you weren't that athletic or something.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Again, it's not quite like that...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I understand the rules, but really don't know what I should be doing. I end up hesitating a lot because of that...

rows.Speaker: Toya's Classmate
rows.Line: You don't know what to do?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Yes. For tennis or volleyball, you just need to send the ball back to your opponent's half of the court.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: But for soccer or basketball, positioning is much more important and how you strategize is completely different, no?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I'll spend most of my time just trying to think of what to do next, but the match is always over before I realize it.

rows.Speaker: Toya's Classmate
rows.Line: Hahaha! That's pretty good!

rows.Speaker: Toya's Classmate
rows.Line: At the same time, that means you really pay close attention to your surroundings and what other people are doing.

rows.Speaker: Toya's Classmate
rows.Line: So if you can learn about more of the theoretical stuff, I can ask you to help us out too, with Akito...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Come to think of it, you and Akito went to junior high together, right? Have you been asking him to help with the soccer club since then?

rows.Speaker: Toya's Classmate
rows.Line: Yeah. Where I'm from, he used to be pretty famous!

rows.Speaker: Toya's Classmate
rows.Line: He quit playing right after we started junior high and wouldn't talk to me for a while but...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Hey. What are you guys talking about?

rows.Speaker: Toya's Classmate
rows.Line: Hey, it's Akito!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Yeah, it's me. That reminds me, you brought back my textbook, right?

rows.Speaker: Toya's Classmate
rows.Line:
Oh, right!
Here you go. Thanks a bunch!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Yeah, yeah...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Anyways, what were you talking about?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: The surprise show we did for that wedding we went to. Apparently, people have been posting videos of it online.

rows.Speaker: Toya's Classmate
rows.Line: And I was saying how surprised I was by Toya's dancing and was wondering if I could ask him to help with the soccer club too.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Oh, okay...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: He was sort of all over the place at first, but got better fast when he started to get the hang of everything.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: I think he even looked the best because of that metronome inside his head.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Really?

rows.Speaker: Toya's Classmate
rows.Line: Yeah, see what I mean?!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: But soccer seems like an entirely different story. Also, I work in the library so I really doubt that I have the time to help...

rows.Speaker: Toya's Classmate
rows.Line: Dang...

rows.Speaker: Toya's Classmate
rows.Line: But you like being active and moving around, right? You might not do a whole lot in gym and stuff, but you usually look like you're having fun.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Having fun, huh...?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Up until high school, I almost always sat on the bench and just watched. I never thought that I could have fun doing anything athletic like that.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: But you may be right. I think I am having fun...

rows.Speaker: Toya's Classmate
rows.Line: You think? Dude, it's your life!

rows.Speaker: Toya's Classmate
rows.Line: Okay, how about this? Let's go somewhere together and have some fun!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Toya's Classmate
rows.Line:
You know, that one arcade?
The one with all the sports stuff!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
You really like that place, huh?
Didn't you go there right before you took the entrance exam for this school?

rows.Speaker: Toya's Classmate
rows.Line: It has the power to cheer anyone up. I mean, you go to that one cafe all the time.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: That's different. I'm not there to play around.

rows.Speaker: Toya's Classmate
rows.Line:
Alright, alright.
So what do you say, Toya?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Toya...?

rows.Speaker: Toya's Classmate
rows.Line: Not really your thing...?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
No, it's not that.
You're sure about inviting me along?

rows.Speaker: Toya's Classmate
rows.Line: Of course. The first time we ever talked was during the School Festival, and I thought you were pretty cool so...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Really?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Just accept it...

rows.Speaker: Toya's Classmate
rows.Line: What he said.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Alright, let's go next weekend or something.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: You've probably never been anywhere like this, right?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: No, I haven't.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (When is the last time I went anywhere with anyone from school...)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (I hadn't thought about it since forming BAD DOGS after I met Akito...)

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: As students, you get to experience so many different things, right?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: It all contributes to the ways you express yourselves.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (MEIKO did say that...)

rows.Speaker: Toya's Classmate
rows.Line: Oh, mind if I invite some other people too? It'd be fun to have enough for a game of futsal!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Sure, why not?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
And thank you for inviting me.
I'll be looking forward to it.

rows.Speaker: Toya's Classmate
rows.Line: Yeah! This is gonna be awesome!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Haha! You're like a little kid!
Toya's Room

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (I've finished making a list of all the new books the library received, so I can start practicing some...)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Hm? Shiraishi's calling me?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Hello? Shiraishi?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: <Hey, sorry. I already called Akito about this, but it's about Kohane. There's something I want to talk to you guys about.>

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: <I'd like it if the three of us could meet up and talk it over. Are you free now?>

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Yes, I can go.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: <Thanks! See you then!>

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: See you.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Something about Azusawa...?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (That reminds me, she seemed bothered by something that someone said during our last event.)
The next day
Kamiyama High School - Class 1-C

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Akito...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Hm? Oh, right. Wanna get some food?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Sure.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Oh, about yesterday...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: You're talking about Kohane?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Yes. I like your idea about us entering into STAY GOLDEN again so that she'll be able to feel more confident about herself.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Right? To be fair, we pretty much went through the same thing.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Yes, we did.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Hm? What's up?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I was just wondering what Azusawa's singing will be like once she does find that confidence.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Yeah, I get what you mean. It's not like she's been letting her nerves get to her while she sings.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Exactly. I genuinely believe she's been giving every performance her all so far.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: But also...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Tono said that there's something interesting about how Azusawa sings.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: He did?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: All I remember is how he said Kohane was too amateurish and someone he'd never work with...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Really?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Dude, seriously? You looked pretty pissed then too.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Yes, that did make me mad too...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Anyway, I have no idea what she's gonna be like when she does learn to have confidence in herself...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: But even if she does, I doubt her personality will change all that much.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Remember what happened right after we decided to join up as a team? She saw what we were practicing and tried to do everything all in one night.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Right, that did happen.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: We did everything we could to stop her and hurriedly came up with a separate list for her to work on.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: We managed to come up with something more balanced and probably better for her...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: But it was still far too much for any run-of-the-mill novice...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Yeah, and it was just meant to be a chance for her to see what she's made of.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: She even commented that it was really hard but she still managed to get through all of it.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: And I couldn't believe it either.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Since then, she's kept practicing because she honestly believes there's nothing more fun than singing.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: And she still seems to believe so even now.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: If she learns to feel more confident about herself, I'm sure she'll keep falling more in love with singing.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: And we have to do well at STAY GOLDEN to make that happen.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Sure.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Azusawa keeps saying that she's constantly chasing after us, but that's really just a milestone she's been working towards.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I hope she'll be able to see that there's more beyond that point.
Weekend Garage

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Alright, see you tomorrow.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Okay, see you tomorrow!
Kamiyama Street

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: STAY GOLDEN went better than I could've ever expected today.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Yeah, so well that I still don't know what to say about it...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I feel the same way...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: We were right next to her and I think she surprised us the most out of everybody that was there.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Yeah.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: But you kinda had a moment like that at another event we did, Toya...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: That was pretty jaw-dropping too.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: At the same time, why do I get the feeling that you saw this coming?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: You were the one that kept talking about how we should go back to STAY GOLDEN and show Kohane that there was more to this than just chasing after us...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Yes, I was but...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Still, how Azusawa ended up performing went well beyond my expectations.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Right.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: And ultimately, it was a good surprise.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: People are able to move forward by seeing others do the same, and it creates a sort of cycle...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: She's both our teammate and rival. I feel like this setup suits us well.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Yeah.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Man, another person I have to compete against...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: That may be so, but this is also what it means to be a team and it's very fun.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Hm? What's wrong?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Nothing... It's just weird to hear you say that something is fun, you know?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I wasn't trying to say anything strange...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
What are you talking about, dude?
Don't you remember what happened that one time?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: What do your true feelings tell you right now? Do you really not want to do this with me anymore?!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: You have no idea how many times I've thought about just focusing on chasing your dream with you!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Right, that did happen...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Yeah, it did.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Do you understand just how hard it was to get you to say how you actually felt?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Sorry.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: *Sigh*

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: At least we're doing a lot better than we were back then.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Right. We've found a way to move forward.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: All so that we can surpass that legendary night.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Now you look all excited...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Huh? Excited...?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Yeah. It definitely looked like it. You couldn't tell what you were doing?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: It did feel good, sort of...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (That reminds me of when Len and I were talking...)

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
You must feel it, Toya.
The happy anticipation!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Why? I think it's great that you got so excited that you went a little nuts!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (I see...)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (This is the same feeling I had when I was talking to Len... Happy anticipation...)

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Normally, I'd suggest going to the park to practice some more...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
But it's getting pretty late.
We should head home soon.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Yeah, and we'll be back first thing in the morning anyway. It can wait until then.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Yes, I agree.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Alright. See you tomorrow, partner.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Yeah, see you tomorrow.
Vivid Street

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: See you tomorrow.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: It was just one surprise after another today.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
Yeah, it was.
I didn't expect to hear that Taiga was back in town.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Not only is he Ken's partner and one of the key figures behind RAD WEEKEND, he's a world-famous artist now...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: That alone was enough of a surprise.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: But what really took the cake today was...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: His singing was indescribable.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: I bet. The first time I heard him sing, I didn't really know what to do with myself afterward.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I see.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (No musical performance has had this much of an impression on me since...)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (The first time I saw Dad's concert...)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (He remained completely loyal to the original music. He never once improvised or added anything in.)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (Some would say that there's no fun in that, but he pulled the entire audience into a whole new world after playing just a few notes.)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (He's world-class in every sense of the word. From his unyielding obsession to his actual playing ability...)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (I always figured that there were others in this world who could match Dad in terms of musical talent...)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (But to think that one of them would be in this city...)

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Toya? Hey, you there?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Oh, sorry about that.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Akito?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: It's just... You seem pretty calm considering how surprised you said you were.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I am. I meant every bit of what I said.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: However, I live with a world-class artist, so I may not have quite the same reaction as others when it comes to being starstruck.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Oh, right. Your dad...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
Yeah, that makes sense...
Then, I guess there's nothing to worry about.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: You're worried...?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Again, it's nothing to worry about.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Also, it'd be great if Kohane does get to practice with Taiga.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Yes, it would be...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (He's worried...?)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (But it wasn't just today either. Between Kohane's performance at STAY GOLDEN to Taiga suddenly appearing, these past few days have been full of surprises.)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (I guess he was wondering if it was starting to be too much for me.)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (But he has seemed more concerned than usual as of late...)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Is something bothering you, Akito?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
Huh? Uh, no...
Let's get started with practice.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (Oh, I know. Before we head over...)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (He really is keeping an eye out for everyone...)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Akito.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Hm?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: A lot has been happening lately, huh?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Yeah...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Is there anything I can do to help?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Nah, just keep doing what you usually do.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Okay.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Wait, just like that...?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: A part of me was expecting that, so I wasn't really taken aback by it.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (It may be that he won't tell me or can't tell me right now.)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: But feel free to ask for help if you feel you need it.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Toya...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Alright, I will if it comes to that.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Good.
On a certain holiday
Shibuya Park

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: It's very windy today...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: It is, but it shouldn't affect practice too much.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Hey, I'm here!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Hey. Alright, let's start warming up.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Okay.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Huh?! Oh no...!!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (The wind blew her cap away...!)

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Akito!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Got it...!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Whoa, nice catch!!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: That was impressive. I couldn't react at all just now. We have soccer to thank for your good reflexes.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Sure, but I would've been called for a handball there.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Anyway, here.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Thank you so much, Shinonome!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: What are you, a little kid? I've never seen that happen to anyone our age.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Hey, that's not fair. You should be blaming the wind instead of her! Just ignore him, Kohane!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: No, I knew that it'd be windy today and I still decided to wear my cap.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: I'll make sure to put it on more tightly so it won't blow away again.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (Things finally seem like they're getting back to normal...)

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Is something wrong, Toya?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: No, don't mind me. Let's start warming up.

rows.Speaker: Kohane & Akito
rows.Line:
Okay!
Sure.
Weekend Garage

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: I'm home...

rows.Speaker: An's Father
rows.Line: Hm? You guys done with practice already?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Yes. Oh, can I get my usual?

rows.Speaker: An's Father
rows.Line:
Sure thing.
Hold on, no Akito or Kohane today?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Akito's got work, and Kohane's doing something with her mom this afternoon.

rows.Speaker: An's Father
rows.Line: That means you're not doing an event today and are free to help out all day, right?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Urgh...

rows.Speaker: An's Father
rows.Line: Gotcha! Don't worry, I'm far from shorthanded today, so enjoy your day off.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Yay!
Oh, can you make me a latte?

rows.Speaker: An's Father
rows.Line: Fine, fine.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Also, practice went really well again today. I can't wait for our next event!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Same. We have a new set list too, so it'll be nice to see what the crowd thinks of it.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Yeah, totally!
Oh, that reminds me...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Yes?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Were you and Akito talking about something before practice today?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: You seemed relieved or something, you know...?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: I had this feeling that something was going on.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I see. However, you have nothing to worry about.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: For a little while now, I've also been wondering if something was bothering Akito.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: But he hasn't seemed concerned or worried for a few days now, so I figured that he reached a resolution.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Really...? So, you know what was bothering him?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I don't actually know.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Wait, what?!
You said you were concerned, right?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Yes.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: But I also suspect that it's something he won't tell me or can't talk about yet, so I decided not to poke or prod.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Okay...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Um... Sorry...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: For what?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Well... I was so focused on what I needed to do during practice that I didn't try and see how you guys were doing.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Again, you have nothing to worry about. I only came to realize just recently.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: By the way, how long has Akito been acting this way...?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I can't say for certain, but likely since STAY GOLDEN...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: S-Since STAY GOLDEN?!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: (I had no idea! Does that mean Kohane's performance has been on Akito's mind this whole time?)

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: So, does that mean...?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I was under the impression that something about Kohane's performance was bothering him, but I was wrong.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: (Huh? It wasn't that...?)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: He even said that he'd ask for my help if he ever ended up needing it.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: That sort of told me that it wasn't about him, but someone else.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Someone else...?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: *Gasp*

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Oh geez...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: (It's me. It's my fault...)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Is something wrong?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
No, it's nothing...
But for now, sorry!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Anyway, I don't think we have anything to worry about when it comes to Akito.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Although, he isn't always inclined to tell anyone about whatever it is that's going on.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: But you saw right through all of that, right, Toya? That's what partners are for! I have a lot to learn from you in that department.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
But okay...
I've had so much just on my own plate lately.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (Could something be bothering Shiraishi too...?)

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Thanks, Toya.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: You're welcome?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: *Nod*
Aboard a train

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Finally, our last train change...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Yeah, we should be at our station in about an hour, and a bus will take us the rest of the way.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Cool. That means we can chill for a while.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Yeah... Oh, I should tell my mom that we managed to catch our connection before I forget...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Hehe. That's right. Your mom did seem more worried about us missing a train than going out camping.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: I love the way she said, This is your first time going to this place, so don't get too absorbed in the scenery.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Yeah, she has a habit of saying that because of my dad, so I'm guessing she's worried about me doing the same thing.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: But I understand what she means. Anyone would want to take their time looking around if it's somewhere they've never been before.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
Wait, Toya...
Did you tell your dad about us going camping...?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Yeah, I mean, wasn't he totally against you dropping everything to go do street music instead?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: But you're here, so that means he must've agreed to let you go.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Yes, he did. Well, after I detailed everything out in a presentation.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Wait, a presentation?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Yes. It was to show him why exactly I needed to go on this trip.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I even put together supplementary figures and documents to explain what we'd be doing.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: About two hours in he said, I'm busy with work, so do as you please.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Two hours...?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Sounds like your passionate speech overpowered him.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: But it's nice to hear that your dad seems to understand, Aoyagi.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
So am I.
But there's still a bit of a problem...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: A problem? Did him agreeing to this come with some strings attached?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: No, it has to do with my presentation and how it has a fatal flaw.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: It does?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Yes. Ultimately, I was able to convince him by using words to explain how important it is for me to go on this trip.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: But that took far too long to actually explain.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Yeah, two hours is a bit much...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: So if I have to do this again, he could just turn me down by saying, I don't have time right now.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Which is why I need to think of a quicker and more digestible way to explain things next time.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: That's amazing. You're already planning that far ahead!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: But you're really good at explaining stuff, Aoyagi, so I'm sure you'll think of something!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Thanks, Azusawa.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: It's hard to say when next time is...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
But we'll deal with it then.
I'm sure the four of us can come up with something.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Yes, I'd like that.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: The scenery's changed quite a bit...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: We've gone from buildings and skyscrapers to a much greener landscape.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Hehe. Yeah.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Oh, look...!
There are cows grazing on that hillside.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Hey, you're right!
There's so many!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Are those wild cows...?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
No way, dude.
That's gotta be someone's farm, right?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Probably.
Oh, I see a bunch of rice fields through the windows on the other side!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Looks like they've already harvested everything. It feels really somber for some reason.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: If only we'd come sooner. I'm guessing it was really pretty with all those rice stalks dancing in the wind.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Pretty, huh...? I've seen videos of fields like this, but never the real thing...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Really...?
But rice fields give you some of the best fall photos.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: You know how rice stalks turn yellow just before they're harvested? They become this beautiful golden color as the sun sets at dusk.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: And the wind makes them all rustle in a way that sounds like waves are crashing on a beach.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
Like a beach...
That really must be something you can only enjoy during the right time of year.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Come to think of it, my dad told us something similar when we went camping that one time...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
And it's absolutely gorgeous, right?!
It reminds me of when we harvested rice during elementary school.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Oh, would you guys mind telling me more about your experiences...?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: So we can all get on the same page...?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Yes, would that be alright?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Of course. Actually, I might have some albums and videos still saved on my phone.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Thanks, Azusawa.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: And I can tell you more about harvesting rice! Although, it was a long time ago, so I don't exactly remember everything...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: But we have plenty of time until our next stop, so knock yourself out, dude.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
Thank you, Shiraishi, Akito.
I really appreciate it.
The next morning
Campground

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (It's a bit chilly, but what a beautiful morning.)
<Morning, Toya!>

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: That voice...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
Ah, Luka, KAITO.
Good morning.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: <Morning. Did you sleep well?>

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
Yes, very.
It was morning before I knew it.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I must've fallen asleep immediately after going in my tent. I was so startled by how I wasn't home when I woke up just now.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: But I suppose that's all a part of experiencing what you don't on a regular basis.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: <Exactly. That's why you should do as much as you can before it's time to go home.>

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Right.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
Hey, Toya, you're up already...?
KAITO and Luka are here too?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: <Morning, Akito. Are you about to start making breakfast?>

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: We'll need to do that soon, but I was hoping to wash up first. There's supposed to be a small spring somewhere around here.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: A spring...? I'll go with you.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: <Oh, if it's safe to drink, it might be good to fetch some for everyone.>

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: You can drink spring water?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: <Yes! I mean, we've been blessed with such a beautiful morning. How does some coffee made with some pure spring water sound?>

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Oh, that does sound nice. Let's do that.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Sorry for the hold-up, you guys!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Thanks for getting started with breakfast. Is there anything you'd like us to do?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Yeah, Toya's chopping up some vegetables. Mind helping him out?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Okay!
I'll help you, Aoyagi!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Ah, thank you.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: <Let's see... Bread, ham, cucumbers, lettuce and a can of tuna... I smell some nice breakfast sandwiches coming along!>

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: That's right. Something easy that doesn't require us to build a fire.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Oh, where'd the margarine go...?
We should spread some on the bread.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: We should? But we're not toasting them.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Yeah, the veggies are gonna make the bread all soggy without it. The oil in the margarine will help prevent that from happening.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I see. Would you like me to help with that once I've finished chopping the vegetables? I've never done that before, so I'd like to give it a try...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Yeah, go for it!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: <Haha. Another first?>

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Right.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (I've learned so much during this trip.)

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Alright, let's dig in!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Hehe. You put so much on yours, An.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Haha. I might've gone a little overboard. My ham looks like it's about to fall out.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Yours looks very neatly made, Azusawa. The way you've presented it even shows off how colorful it is.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Yeah, totally!
Yours looks so pro, Kohane.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
I-It does?
I was hoping to brighten it up a little more, but couldn't really find anything that does that...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Something brighter...? Oh, I still have some of the oranges that I brought from home. Wanna try using those?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Why not try making a fruit sandwich while you're at it?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: How? We don't have any whipped cream.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Grr...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Hehe.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: That was nice.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Oh, before I forget. You guys wanted to brew some coffee using spring water, right? Here, use this!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
Wait, a camp stove...?
You actually brought one?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Yeah! I brought it just in case we have trouble building a campfire!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: But it never really got a chance to do its this thing, so I thought now's its chance...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
Sure, let's give it a shot.
It'll save us the trouble of having to deal with a fire.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Yay! I brought a dripper too, so just gimme one sec to dig it up!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Hum hum♪

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Oh, that coffee's starting to smell really nice...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Yes, it is. Despite having coffee almost every day, it smells much better than usual for some reason...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: <Aww, I wish I could be there with you all...>

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: <I know! I'll go ask MEIKO to brew up some coffee! Be right back...>

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: <Oh, have her make some for me too.>

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: <What? Can't you just ask her yourself, Luka?>

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Alright, that should be enough for all of us...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Oh, that's good, if I do say so myself!
Have at it, guys.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Thanks, An!
Oh, it smells so good...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Yes, it really does...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
<Here you are, Luka.
One for you and one for me.>

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: <Thank you, KAITO!>

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: <Mmm... That hits the spot. Coffee goes so well with the wafting breeze, the chirping birds and all this greenery.>

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: <The birds I understand, but we can't actually feel the wind from where we are...>

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: <Can't you see that I was just trying to set the mood, Luka?>

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: <Haha. Okay, sorry.>

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (Set the mood...?)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (This trip turned out to be such a valuable experience for me...)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (I'll be sure to thank Mom and Dad for letting me go once I get back.)
Street SEKAI
Crase Cafe

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: I still can't believe we get to see COL again.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Yeah, I can't either.
We owe you big, Kohane!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
I didn't do anything.
You should be thanking Taiga for actually getting a hold of the owner.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: But you were the one who asked him about this place. We wouldn't be here if you hadn't.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: He's right, so thank you, Kohane!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
So what's COL like?
Is it different from other live houses?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Is it really big or something? There were lots of people there, right?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I've only heard bits and pieces from Akito...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Why don't you settle down and give them a chance to answer, Len?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: I mean, we can tell you guys all about it, but it really wasn't that different from any other live house.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Also, you're gonna get to see it for yourself, so why not just wait instead of inflating your expectations?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Yes, I agree since you'll be joining us on this little excursion.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Nooo! I won't be able to sleep from all this excitement!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Again, please try to settle down.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: More importantly, I'd like to learn more about what RAD WEEKEND was really like.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: The only solid piece of information I have at this point is that the event An's dad put on was unlike anything else.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: What it was really like...?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I remember asking Akito the same thing when we first formed our team.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: To be fair, it was more like I monologued while you sat there to listen.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: You seemed very eager to tell someone about how great it was.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
Gimme a break...
Everyone else I talked to about this would listen but laugh at me once I was done.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: If that's the case, Akito, can you tell us what you told Toya?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Sure, but you'll only get to hear about what happened from my perspective.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: That's totally fine! I wanna hear too actually!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Me too!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: It's been a while, so I'd like to hear it again as well.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
Alright...
I'll talk.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Toya, Len, I've already told you both a little about how I used to play soccer until I was a sixth grader and quit after burning out...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: That was when I was introduced to music.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: My sister took me to the Summer Festival that year to see the show they were putting on, and I was hooked...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
The Summer Festival?
Didn't you and Toya sing there this year?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Yeah, it was hard to believe that I'd be performing on the stage that I saw all those years ago.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: If I recall correctly, you weren't exactly interested in performing at first.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
It was my sister's idea.
She casually suggested I do it in passing.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: But singing without really meaning it isn't my thing. Also, it wouldn't have been good for the event...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Hehe. That's so thoughtful of you, Akito.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Yes, I agree.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: That passion and thoughtfulness of yours may be the reason why you got to go to RAD WEEKEND.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Call it karma or whatever.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: But I'm really glad I ended up going...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: That's great, so what was the show like?!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Incredible...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Back then, I had no idea who anyone on stage was since I knew next to nothing about street music.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: But they had me hook, line and sinker from the first song...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: I couldn't take my eyes off them as they threw me into a sea of music.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: I didn't know anyone in the crowd either, but in the heat of the moment, it felt like we were all old friends shouting our lungs out together...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: That was when I knew I was witnessing something special... Something legendary...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Yeah, what he said! I was shouting like crazy with everyone else too.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Once it was all over, I thought, “I wanna do something like this too.”

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: I had zero musical knowledge, but I felt compelled to start practicing that day because of how it sent these shockwaves through me.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Hehe. Like now?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: D-Did I sound that excited?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: More than usual at the very least.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: No, I suppose this could be considered normal since RAD WEEKEND is what's driving you. Plus, you always seem to have fun talking about it.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: It just means that much to you, doesn't it?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Yeah, it does.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (Until now, all I had to work with was what Akito felt that night...)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (But actually seeing COL... Seeing where it happened might give me a better insight.)

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: You feeling it now, Toya?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Yes, I believe I have a better understanding.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I'm very much looking forward to visiting COL now.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Haha! You and me both!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Indeed.
Weekend Garage

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: I'm back!

rows.Speaker: An's Father
rows.Line: Oh, all four of you are here this time, so I'm guessing you just finished practicing?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Yes, we appear to be in such good singing shape today that we overdid it slightly and decided to take a break.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Which is why I think it's a good opportunity for me to try what Akito usually does by adding honey or whipped cream to my coffee.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Hey, it's not like I always ask for those things.

rows.Speaker: An's Father
rows.Line: Oh? Does that mean you don't want either today?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Uh... I-I'll have both...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Honey and whipped cream...
I'd like to try that as well.

rows.Speaker: An's Father
rows.Line: And you, Toya?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: A blend, as usual.

rows.Speaker: An's Father
rows.Line: You got it.

rows.Speaker: An's Father
rows.Line: Still, it's pretty remarkable how you're all okay with practicing during a day off like this.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Thanks, but that DVD probably has something to do with it, you know?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Seeing that footage seems to have really brought us together and further strengthened our resolve to surpass RAD WEEKEND.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: As a result, we're more motivated than usual.

rows.Speaker: An's Father
rows.Line: I see.

rows.Speaker: An's Father
rows.Line: How about I reward your hard work and resolve with some cookies?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Wow, really?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Thank you.

rows.Speaker: An's Father
rows.Line: You're welcome. Just promise to get in a good break, alright?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: We will.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: I still can't believe that video actually exists.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
I know, right?!
It's my dad's fault for not telling us sooner.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: To be fair, it's supposed to be a legendary event. I can see why he'd be hesitant about letting anyone see it.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Do you think he'd be willing to lend it to us if we asked to see it again?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Oh, I already asked him and he said he'd be okay with it!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: He did?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Yeah. He even asked Uncle Taiga to hear what he thinks and they both gave us the green light!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I see...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (But that means...)

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: What's up, Toya...?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Um, it's just...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: As I just mentioned, this DVD is the sole piece of hard evidence that shows this legendary event took place.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I can't even begin to imagine how many others would want to see this... And yet, we're able to see it at our own leisure.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: There probably are lots of people who want to experience RAD WEEKEND again.

rows.Speaker: An's Father
rows.Line: Alright, your cookies are ready.

rows.Speaker: An's Father
rows.Line:
Oh, just so we're clear...
I ask that you please not tell anyone else about this video.

rows.Speaker: An's Father
rows.Line: For your eyes only, understand?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Because it's such a valuable piece of history?

rows.Speaker: An's Father
rows.Line: Something like that.

rows.Speaker: An's Father
rows.Line: I'm sure you'll honor our agreement, but again, don't tell anyone else about this, alright?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: We will.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Just getting to see that video became an invaluable experience for us.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Yeah! Doesn't this mean he thinks we're cut out to actually surpass RAD WEEKEND?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: You might be his daughter, but we still got a long way to go...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Still, I'm glad that we stumbled across this opportunity...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Me too!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: But we'll need to keep trying our best to meet these expectations and make our dreams come true!

rows.Speaker: Kohane, An & Akito
rows.Line:
Yeah!
Got that right!
Live House

rows.Speaker: MC
rows.Line:
Give it up for tonight's headliner!
Vivid BAD SQUAD!!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: You guys can keep going, right?!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Because we're about to blow the roof off this place! Here we go! Try to keep up, alright?!
Kamiyama Street

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Phew... I'm glad we were able to sing really well...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Me too. I feel like we're singing the parts where we split into pairs and when we're all together much better now.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Yeah, I thought so too!
It's gotta be because we're all on the same wavelength!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: This might've been a case of actually talking about what we were imagining leading to real results in terms of singing.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I agree. I definitely think we've taken another step forward as a team.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: We have Kohane to thank for absorbing everything Uncle Taiga taught her too!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Hehe. I'm glad I could help you guys.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (Help us... As a team...)

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: <Hehe. I think you're selling yourself too short.>

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: <I believe everyone possesses some sort of “unique talent”.>

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (Isn't there anything I can do for us as a team...?)
The next day
Toya's Room

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (Practice today doesn't start until this afternoon. I can work on some things on my own until...)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
A message...?
From Azusawa?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: <Sorry to bother you before practice. There's something I'd like to ask you.>

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Ask me...?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: <Taiga asked me to listen to some classical music to practice seeing different things from a variety of perspectives.>

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: <I tried looking up some works by Beethoven and Debussy.>

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: <But I was wondering if you had any other suggestions.>

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I see...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
<Again, I'm sorry.
Initially, I was hesitant about asking you this kind of question...>

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: <But Shinonome said that you wouldn't have a problem with it.>

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: I understand...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: But what you did is different, Toya. You chose to get back into music again...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: You really gotta love music to do that, right?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
<I appreciate your concern.
Akito was right to tell you that. I'll send over a list of composers and suitable works.>

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: <I didn't realize there were so many. Thank you so much! Can I show An and Shinonome what you just sent me?>

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
<Of course.
It may be good for us to all listen to some of them.>

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
<Good idea!
I'll post a message to our group chat!>

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I'm glad I could help...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
(That's the extent of my knowledge...
Classical music...)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (I know I need to do more if I ever hope to contribute in a more meaningful way...)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: But I...
bgm_area00003
Street SEKAI

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (I need to get my head back in the right place before practice...)

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
Hm? Toya?
Practice isn't until much later, right?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Oh, um... I just...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Is there something you'd like to talk about?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
Yes, there is...
Would you mind listening for a bit...?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: A way to make better use of your knowledge and experience with classical music for the sake of your team, huh...?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Yes...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I never had a chance to participate in school events or even play with my friends much for that matter.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: As a result, I've experienced so much less in life compared to the others...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Classical music is the only area in which I've clearly experienced more than them.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
That's all I really have.
So, I want to make better use of what I know...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: However, I ran away from classical music...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: So I have no right speaking about it...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: But what do you want to do about that, Toya...?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Huh...?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
Don't give me that.
You're doing that thing again.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
Right and wrong are just words.
Have you asked yourself what you want to do?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: But...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (What do I want to do...?)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
...!
Did something flash just now...?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Oh, look at that... It's a fragment of a feeling.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
A fragment of a feeling?
Is that what this ball of light is?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Yes. SEKAI are born out of feelings, so similar feelings can sometimes manifest themselves within SEKAI like this.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Just a fragment...?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
Yes. It's just that.
Not enough to become a full-fledged SEKAI, so it'll return to being just light in a moment.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
(But it flashed just now...
Did that happen because Toya went near it...?)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
A fragment of a feeling, huh?
This place really never ceases to surprise me.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: It's just that sort of place.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
Anyway, Toya...
Would you like to take a closer look at this fragment?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Huh? Wait, wouldn't that be rude to the owner of this feeling...?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: But it's going to disappear without anyone examining it if you don't.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Which is why I think it'd be good for us to see what happens in place of its owner. What do you say?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
I see...
It would be sad to see it go without anyone actually examining it.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Try touching it, Toya.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Okay.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: This place looks like a mess...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
Yeah, it does...
Wait! Toya, stop!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
Phew...
There's a hole there so watch out.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Oh, good eye. Thank you...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
You're welcome.
Still...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: This is supposed to be that fragment's SEKAI...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: But this place looks like it's falling apart. It almost hurts just looking at it.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: I feel the same way...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: I'm sorry. Fragments of feelings aren't usually supposed to be dangerous in any way...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
But this floor doesn't look safe.
It may not be wise to go any further.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I see...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (But I have a feeling there's something up ahead...)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
(I can't describe it...
But it's like it wants to be found...)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
Sorry, Miku.
I can't help but wonder. I'm going to take a quick look.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: T-Toya?!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Are those...? A piano and a violin?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Yes, I believe so.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (It's covered in dust, but it doesn't look broken in any way. It might still be playable if I clean it up a little.)

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: The piano and violin still mean a lot to you, right, Toya...?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: You seem relieved that the piano and violin didn't fall through the floor. Am I right in saying that?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: That may be the case...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
What do you mean by that?
You need to learn to embrace your feelings more.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
Right and wrong are just words.
Have you asked yourself what you want to do?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Yes, you're right...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I apologize. I was under the impression that I'd been doing just that lately thanks to everyone around me.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: But I seem to get confused when it comes to classical music.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Or rather... I'm avoiding it subconsciously because a part of me doesn't want to think about it.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
Avoiding it...?
Why's that?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Because things were easier back then if I did that...

rows.Speaker: Toya's Father
rows.Line: No. Again.

rows.Speaker: Little Toya
rows.Line: I'm sorry...

rows.Speaker: Toya's Father
rows.Line: Again.

rows.Speaker: Little Toya
rows.Line: But my fingers...

rows.Speaker: Toya's Father
rows.Line: No. Again. Until you get it right.

rows.Speaker: Little Toya
rows.Line: Okay...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I used to admire the way my dad plays the piano...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: He has this way of taking all of the music theory he knows and combining it with everything he's experienced to produce this magnificent sound that perfectly reflects a composer's thought process...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: There was a time when I dreamed of being able to do the same thing someday.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I wanted to practice and work hard to meet my parents' expectations.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: But I had to suffer for it and was never allowed to say what was on my mind...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: I see... I have a better understanding of why you were putting your feelings at arm's length.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Admitting that as being true would've caused your motivation to crumble to pieces, so it was easier to just never think about it...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: In retrospect, that may be what I was doing...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Ultimately, I wasn't able to keep fooling myself and ran away from classical music.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: I wouldn't say that you “ran away”.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: I understand that you wanted to make your parents proud but couldn't meet their expectations...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: But isn't it about time you let all that go and forgive yourself?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: What...?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: To be fair, your partner being such a stoic person might not have helped...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: But I'm hoping that you'll take this opportunity to see yourself in a more positive light.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: More positive...?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: For example, as opposed to saying, “Classical music is all I have...”

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: You could say, “I will always have classical music.”

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: I'd even go as far as adding, “I like classical music and respect my dad very much.” Especially since you've already faced up to him and your feelings.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: I really don't think it needs to be more difficult than that.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Let me ask you this again, Toya.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: The piano and violin still mean a lot to you, right, Toya...?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Yes...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: The piano and violin are both...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
We're back.
How do you feel, Toya?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Thank you. I'm okay.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: But...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Did we have to leave that piano and violin all alone there?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Hmm... It's a SEKAI born from a fragment of a feeling, so it'll be up to that feeling...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: What do you hope will happen to them, Toya?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: What do I hope...?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I'm sorry. I wasn't thinking that far ahead.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Hehe. Then, that may be a good place for you to start.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Yes, you may be right.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
Thank you, Miku.
You've opened my eyes quite a bit.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: You're welcome, but I'm also glad that I got to know you a little better.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Oh, you still have some time until practice. How about we stop by MEIKO's place for a quick break?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Yes, let's.
Toya's Room

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (Okay. We know when and where we'll be performing, as well as who's going to be participating.)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (There seems to be no problems with our ticket prices, so I should let Azusawa know that she can include that on our flyer now.)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (That just leaves doing an equipment check. Ultramarine should be able to supply us with most of what we need...)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (But I won't know for sure until I see what each team's set list entails...)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (I already have the one for EVER, so that just leaves Mita and Tono...)

rows.Line: If we do plan on changing anything, it should be our song choices or how we bridge between them. For example, what if I switched out my song...?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Right now?

rows.Speaker: Arata
rows.Line: Yes. It didn't go very well with Mita's song, so that may've hurt our vibe a little.

rows.Speaker: Arata
rows.Line: Mita's good at being an MC, so he should interact with the audience as much as possible at the end of his song. I'll try to sing something that goes with that flow.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (Tono in particular was still adjusting his set list during practice, so he may still be considering other songs.)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (I should probably contact him to see what's going on.)
Shibuya Park

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Oh, Aoyagi!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I apologize for pushing back when practice starts because of my own business.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Don't worry, dude. Anyway, did you manage to take care of that event stuff you were talking about?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Yes, one thing's been settled.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Wait, just one...?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Azusawa, I have all the information you'll need for the flyer. I've sent it over to your phone, so I hope you get a chance to look at it later.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Okay! Thanks, Aoyagi.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: So, what else do you have left to do...?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Hm? Oh, a list of equipment that we'll need for the day of the event.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: However, I had to stop what I was doing to contact Mita and Tono about their set lists since I've yet to see them.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: What? They haven't sent in their set lists yet?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Aoyagi, didn't you set a deadline?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Yes, it's tomorrow. They still have time, so we should be okay after I check up on them again today.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Ugh... I'll remind Mita and Tono to give us their set lists if I happen to see them.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Yes, that would also help.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Still, Toya, leaving all the clerical stuff to you was definitely the right call.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Yeah, you've been a really big help. Despite it being your first time, you seem to know exactly what to do.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I have the staff at Ultramarine to thank for that.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: They've been nice enough to show me how this process works and what to look out for beforehand.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: I didn't know that.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Yeah, it's always important to check with someone about that sort of stuff.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Take me and my dad for example. He'll say, “Go get some stuff,” and I'll reply, “Okay,” but totally forget to ask what to buy before leaving.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: That just means you're a knucklehead.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Hehe. You usually have everything under control, An, so it's kind of cute seeing this side of you.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Koohaaaneee!
You're the only person who'd ever say something so nice!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Wah! Oh, An...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Anything else that's giving you trouble, Toya...?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: No, I don't think so.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: You sure? We get that you're the one that's best suited for this job, but you don't actually have to do everything all on your own.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Yes, I understand.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Alright, if you say so.

rows.Speaker: Kotaro
rows.Line:
Hey, there they are!
Over here!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Hey, it's you...

rows.Speaker: Kotaro
rows.Line: Huh? Wh-Why are you leering at us like that? Did we do something wrong?

rows.Speaker: Arata
rows.Line:
Oh, is this about our set lists?
Aoyagi already let us know about that.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Yeah. Cough them up already.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Akito...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Haha. What a bad boy.

rows.Speaker: Kotaro
rows.Line: O-Okay, I get it! I still had to make some adjustments after practice the other day!

rows.Speaker: Kotaro
rows.Line: But here you go. My set list.

rows.Speaker: Arata
rows.Line: And this is mine.

rows.Speaker: Arata
rows.Line: I apologize for cutting it a little close. However, I believe you'll be satisfied with it. I appreciate the extra time you gave me, Aoyagi.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
No, thank you as well.
I'll look over it later.

rows.Speaker: Arata
rows.Line: Hehe. This should keep your partner from biting our heads off.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
Tsk...
Anyway, let's start practicing.

rows.Speaker: Kotaro
rows.Line:
Wait you guys are about to practice?
Mind if I join?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Kotaro
rows.Line: Wh-Why are you still mad?!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Akito, that should be enough.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
Alright, fine.
Jump in if you want.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Tono, would you also like to join us?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Yeah! We should sing together since we're all here!

rows.Speaker: Arata
rows.Line: Okay, I think I'll just have to take you up on that.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Yes, thank you.
Miyamasuzaka

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: <Oh, Toya, I think you just received a message.>

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
Thank you, KAITO.
I'll take a look.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: You sounded like the notification for a messaging app just now, KAITO.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
<Haha. Want me to do it too?
I can let you know when you get a message or when it's morning and stuff!>

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Thanks, but I kinda doubt you'll like doing morning calls. We have to wake up at five when we have morning practices.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
<What?! That's so early!
On second thought, I think I'll pass.>

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Akito, I heard from Azusawa that she's okay with our schedule change for tomorrow's practice.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
Oh, this one's from Shiraishi...
She seems okay with it as well.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Alright, let's start practice earlier than scheduled like we told them.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Okay.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: <Nice! You guys sound totally pumped!>

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: <Yes, they do. Is it because you were with that Tono person and his friend just earlier?>

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
Yeah.
I really wasn't expecting to meet his partner.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Me neither. He originally said that he was somewhere far away, so I didn't think we'd ever meet him...

rows.Speaker: Soma
rows.Line:
You're Shinonome and Aoyagi, right?
He's told me all about you guys!

rows.Speaker: Soma
rows.Line:
I'm Soma Miyata.
This dude's best friend!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (Does being allowed to transfer hospitals mean his recovery's going well?)

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Hm? What's up?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Oh, it's just...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Hearing their story reminded me of just how incredible Tono is. I mean, he's carrying Soma's dream along with his own.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Yeah...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: I still have trouble figuring out what Tono's thinking...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: But he's trying to surpass that night and no one can match his resolve. It almost hurt to see his determination the first the I met him.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: And that resolve is what allows him to put on such astounding performances.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: <That story really made me think after I heard it...>

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: <I mean, if something happened that kept me from singing with Rin, I'm not sure I could keep going while carrying her thoughts with me.>

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: <Just thinking about it is tough...>

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
<Yeah...
That's why I think it's incredible how someone can carry their dear friend's dream like that.>

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Yes, I feel the same way...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Since I... Like Tono, I also received my dream from my “partner”.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Toya...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: <I suppose the only one who can carry a partner's dream is that very person's partner, no...?>

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: <However, Toya, you and the others are also chasing after the same dream. Doesn't that put you all in the same boat?>

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: <Which means Tono isn't alone anymore, right?>

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Well...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Yes, I certainly hope that's true.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: To be fair, we don't know how they feel about that.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: <Haha! I'm sure you guys are gonna be fine!>

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: <They even seemed a little relieved when talking to you guys just now, Akito!>

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: <I agree. I'm looking forward to seeing how your event goes.>

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
<Wait, we gotta go!
We still have our own event to prepare for!>

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: <Oh, you're right. MEIKO and Miku might get mad if we stay away for too long.>

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: <We'll see you later, Toya, Akito!>

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Okay, see you.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Alright, let's head home and get in some rest before practice tomorrow.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Yes, let's.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Akito...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Hm? Yeah?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Um...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Let's make sure our event succeeds.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: We will, dude, so let's go home already.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Okay.
Kamiyama High School - Main Gate

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Oh... Akito!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Hey, Toya. Morning.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
Yes, good morning.
Sorry, but would you mind coming over to Class B for a bit?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Hm? You mean your class?
Class 1-B

rows.Speaker: Toya's Classmate
rows.Line:
Morning, Toya... And Akito?
Dude, you're in the wrong class.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
No, I'm not.
Toya asked me to tag along.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
Perfect.
I was just hoping to speak with both of you. It's about these...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Huh? Cookies?

rows.Speaker: Toya's Classmate
rows.Line:
Hm? They look homemade.
Did you bake these, Toya?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: No, my mother did.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
Care to have some?
There's no way I can eat all of these on my own.

rows.Speaker: Toya's Classmate
rows.Line: Yeah, thanks! I'll take one.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (His mom's homemade cookies?)

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: My mother doesn't cook very often, but during special occasions, like my birthday, she'll bake cookies for us.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Really? Cookies instead of cake?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Yes. I don't actually know why, but my father and brothers also just seemed to believe it's what our family does...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I knew they were only for special occasions, but before I realized it, I was asking her to make them whenever. I just seemed to fall in love with them.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Right... It's your birthday today.

rows.Speaker: Toya's Classmate
rows.Line: Wait, really?!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Also, you sure about sharing these with us? They mean a lot to you, right?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Yes, it's my birthday present and they mean quite a lot to me.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: But I'd rather not have them all to myself or let them go to waste.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
Got it...
In that case, I'll have some.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Good morning, everyone in 1-B!
Is Toya here?

rows.Speaker: Toya's Classmate
rows.Line:
It's them!
The Weirdo Wombo Combo!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Guh...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Ah, Shinonome, you're here too.
That saves us the trouble of finding you.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Good morning, Tsukasa, Kamishiro.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Ah, Toya, good morning!
And happy birthday!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: You remembered?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Of course. How long have I known you?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Anyway, we'll be putting on a special show for you during lunch on the rooftop today!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: ...! You are?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Yes! Rui and Nene will also be a part of it, so I'm sure you won't be disappointed!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
Yes, I'll be looking forward to it.
Thank you both very much, Tsukasa, Kamishiro.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Hehe. You're very welcome.
You're welcome to join us as well, Shinonome.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Indeed. The more the merrier when it comes to having an audience!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
Right...
Well, if Toya's going, then I guess I'll go too...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Ah, Nene, good morning.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Guh...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Oh, there you are!
We were just talking about the show we'll be doing during lunch.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Oh, that...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I heard that you'll be a part of it as well, Kusanagi. Thank you.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Oh, um...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Th-They asked me to be in it, but I'm just gonna be in the chorus for a bit. You really don't have to thank me...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Hehehe...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: By the way, have any of you seen Mizuki anywhere? If you don't mind, I was hoping to invite them along as well...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Akiyama?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: There's no way Akiyama's gonna be here this early.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: True. Whatever shall we do...?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: At this point, Aoyagi, you and Mizuki are reasonably well acquainted. Not inviting Mizuki to celebrate with us may come back to haunt me later.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
Oh...
Yeah, Akiyama does like these sorts of things.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Right. During the School Festival, Akiyama seemed to genuinely enjoy the show Tsukasa and his classmates did.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I doubt Akiyama would want to miss out on a special show like this one.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Dude, not what I was talking about...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Kamishiro, I'll try letting Akiyama know about the show. Fortunately, we've swapped contact information before.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Thank you. I'll send Mizuki an invite to join us for your birthday celebration as well.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Okay.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
Oh, also.
Would you all like some cookies?
Lunch break
Kamiyama High School - Rooftop

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Ah, you're here!
Would you mind waiting? We have just a bit more left to set up.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Yes, of course.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: So, did Akiyama reply back?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Yes. I received a reply saying that Akiyama should be here in time for the show, so soon...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Heya! I'm here♪

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Ah, speaking of which.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Yeah.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Thanks for inviting me, Toya!
Also, happy birthday! Here's your present!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Ta-daa!
A box crammed full of an assortment of cookies♪

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
Thank you.
I really appreciate it, Akiyama.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: You know what Toya likes?
