rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Ena's the one who actually told me.
We were just both talking about taking a quick nap when Toya and Rui sent me their invites.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: When I told Ena that it's your birthday today, Toya, she said how Li'l Bro here mentioned something about you liking cookies! I'm glad she was right!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I see...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I'd like to repay you for your gift, but this is all I have at the moment. Would you like a cookie?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Huh? These look homemade. Are you sure?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Yes. My mother made them, but I want to take this opportunity to share them with my friends.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Okay! In that case, I'll gladly have some♪ Wait, where's An? I figured that she'd be here too.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Oh, we tried inviting her, but she has a hall monitor meeting right now.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Hehehe. No offense against Shiraishi, but I chose this time because of this tidbit of information.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
Hang on...
Does this mean you're gonna do something crazy or dangerous...?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Alright, we're all set up! Let's get this show on the road!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Sit back and enjoy, Toya!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Okay!
Kamiyama High School - Rooftop

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: “The traveler that was once so lonely now has many friends and no longer has to feel alone. The end.”

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Tsukasa, Kamishiro and you too, Kusanagi. Thank you for putting on such a wonderful show for us.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Yeah, it was totally clean too.
No explosions, weird props or anything like that.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Oh? This is a school, you know?
We're not allowed to use anything that's considered dangerous or unusual.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: I know for a fact that you were going to if I didn't stop you...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: This was much easier to digest compared to that insane rendition of Romeo you guys did that other time.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
Yes, this was a very moving story.
It was also fun seeing the traveler's circle of friends grow along the way.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Tsukasa, thank you for coming up with such a wonderful show for me.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Anything becomes possible when I put my mind to something! Hah hah hah hah!
Street SEKAI
Crase Cafe

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Alright. Ready, everyone?

rows.Speaker: Everyone
rows.Line: Yeah!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Happy birthday, Toya!

rows.Speaker: Kohane, An & Akito
rows.Line: Happy birthday!

rows.Speaker: Everyone
rows.Line: Happy birthday!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Thank you all very much.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
Okay, let's cut the cake.
Which part would you like, Toya?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Hehe. Every part should taste the same. I made sure to completely cover it with fruity toppings.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
I know.
I was just trying to create the right mood.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
Oh, this part looks nice.
The one with the strawberries and blueberries on top.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Okay!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: KAITO, can I have the one next to that?!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Oh, I want the one on the other side!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: I'm fine with whatever as long as I get to have some♪

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
*Sigh*
You all realize it's Toya's birthday today, right?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Don't forget to have some sandwiches too, Toya. I helped make them.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: You did, Miku?!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
Oh, um... They should be fine.
KAITO was there to make them with her.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Wait, MEIKO, what do you mean by “fine”?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
Huh? Nothing serious.
Haha...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Oh, I almost forgot. I brought something to share with all of you.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Hey, cookies!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Yay! Thanks, Toya!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Oh, I'd like some as well♪

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Huh? There's only three left. What about you guys, Akito?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: I already had some at school.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: An and I had some when we celebrated at her dad's cafe earlier.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Oh, okay. You already had a chance to celebrate. In that case, I think I'll take one.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
That leaves two.
Just enough for the both of you, MEIKO, KAITO.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Wait, hold up...!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Hm? Is something the matter?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
Toya, have you had any for yourself?
You've been handing them out all day, but I don't think I've seen you eat a single one...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Haha. Akito, I get that Toya overlooks things sometimes, but that doesn't mean...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Now that you mention it, I don't think I have...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: You're kidding, right?!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
Oh no! Rin, Luka, stop! Stop!
Don't eat those cookies yet!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: A-All good! I haven't touched mine yet!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
Barely safe!
I was just about to eat it with some of the cake's whipped cream...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Oh, on the other hand... I'd like you to all have them.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: It is true that I used to eat these all by myself whenever my mother made them for me...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: But that was because I didn't have any friends to share them with.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: However, things are different now.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I have so many friends that I don't have enough cookies to go around.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Toya...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: If that's the case, I'll also be taking one!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
W-Wait, KAITO!
There won't be any left for Toya...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
Don't worry!
Let's see... Right about here and... Crack!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Darn... It didn't split in half as nicely as I'd hoped. Anyway, Toya, you can have the bigger piece!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Yeah! Now you both get to have a piece!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Oh, I wanna try that too!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
Okay♪
If we split the remaining six in half, it'll be enough for three whole pieces!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Right. And Toya gets all the remaining halves, right?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Yes. I mean, his mother made these just for him.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
Okay...
Thank you all very much.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: You're very welcome!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Thank goodness.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Geez... You're a smart guy, so don't forget to include yourself when it comes to stuff like this, okay?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Hehe. My apologies.

rows.Speaker: An & Kohane
rows.Line:
Hehe.
Haha.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Happy birthday, Toya!
You got to see Tsukasa's show at school today, right?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Hehe. He practiced it a ton too.
He seemed so determined to make sure you really enjoyed it.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Of course, I did. A star is no star unless they're giving everything they do all that they have!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: It's also wonderful to see how much you've been smiling lately, Toya. I believe it goes without saying that you should take good care of Akito and all your friends.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Happy birthday, Toya!
And thanks for inviting me to see that special show. I had loads of fun♪

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: You really took us by surprise when you left school right after feeling so satisfied too.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: I'm glad to see that you liked our special show, Aoyagi. It'd be great to have you play a role for us the next time we do something like this.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Inviting him's fine, but don't make him do anything crazy, okay? It might make the split-personality guy mad.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: But in any case... I'm glad you enjoyed our show and I'm glad I decided to help out.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Happy birthday, Aoyagi!
The party we had in SEKAI was so much fun!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: But I got so worried for a second when we realized that there weren't enough cookies to go around.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
At the same time, it was kinda nice.
Len and the others seemed to really enjoy it too.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Yeah. I guess it just means birthday parties are all about having tons of fun with everyone!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: I agree! I hope we get to do this every year.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Same. Don't expect anything less, Toya.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I wasn't expecting such a vibrant birthday celebration...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Cookies were all that I really used to have to mark this occasion. But now, I have my friends, my seniors from school, as well as Miku and the others.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I couldn't ask for a better birthday present.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I hope I get to celebrate my birthday again with everyone like this next year.
Weekend Garage

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Hello.

rows.Speaker: An's Father
rows.Line:
Oh, hey there.
Feel free to sit wherever you like.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Then, I'll sit at the counter.

rows.Speaker: An's Father
rows.Line: The usual?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Please.

rows.Speaker: An's Father
rows.Line: Coming right up.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: It's strange seeing no other customers here at this time...

rows.Speaker: An's Father
rows.Line: Well, a lot of events are going on at the same time today.

rows.Speaker: An's Father
rows.Line: If anything, this is like the calm before the storm. Once they're all done, everyone's going to want to stay out and stampede over.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (They have that much energy...)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I'm not sure if this counts as a hint or clue, but I did notice something...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
I may be mistaken...
But something about all the performers' voices felt sad or dispirited for some reason...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Sad...?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
What?
Even though everyone was going totally nuts?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (That time... What was it that I was feeling...?)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (As Shiraishi said, knowing that Ken and his team would be disbanding may've had a lot to do with it...)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (Asking him directly seems a bit...)

rows.Speaker: An's Father
rows.Line: Is there something you'd like to ask me...?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Huh...?

rows.Speaker: An's Father
rows.Line:
It's written all over your face.
Also, here's your coffee.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Thank you...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Um... Was it that obvious?

rows.Speaker: An's Father
rows.Line: More than before.

rows.Speaker: An's Father
rows.Line: Lately, it's become a little easier to see how you're feeling based on your facial expressions... But of all my regulars, you're still a puzzle to me.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I'm sorry...

rows.Speaker: An's Father
rows.Line: Hahaha! Conversely, Akito and Kohane are the easiest to read.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I understand Azusawa, but I wasn't expecting to hear Akito's name.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Especially since he usually does his absolute best to bury anything he doesn't want people to know about...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: And it's very difficult to see that when it actually happens.

rows.Speaker: An's Father
rows.Line: To be fair, I've been alive a bit longer than the rest of you, so I know a thing or two when it comes to that.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I see...

rows.Speaker: An's Father
rows.Line: Anyway, what is it that you'd like to ask? It must be bothering you very much based on how anxious you seemed just now.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
Yes, well...
I'm not sure if I should ask...

rows.Speaker: An's Father
rows.Line: Oh...? In that case...

rows.Speaker: An's Father
rows.Line: I'll be taking care of some business, so you just talk like I'm not here. I might be willing to answer depending on what you say.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: So, I watched the DVD of RAD WEEKEND with everyone the other day...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: And for some reason, I felt this strange sense of sadness in all the performers' voices as they sang...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I don't understand why that thought crossed my mind...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I'm sorry if this seems inappropriate...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: But I'm struggling to wrap my head around what I felt and why I felt what I did that time...

rows.Speaker: An's Father
rows.Line: You really are changing little by little, Toya. Of course, for the better...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: An's Father
rows.Line: Until just recently, you never actively tried to express or discuss what you were feeling, right?

rows.Speaker: An's Father
rows.Line: But you're doing your best to blaze your own trail anyway. I'm not even your parent and I feel pretty proud of you.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Thank you very much...

rows.Speaker: An's Father
rows.Line: And to answer your question...

rows.Speaker: An's Father
rows.Line: Everyone's going to think or feel something different when they see an event. Honestly, it's a folly to try to understand what the performers were feeling.

rows.Speaker: An's Father
rows.Line: And yet, you clearly felt something even though you're still not entirely used to comprehending such emotions...

rows.Speaker: An's Father
rows.Line: So, you should remember what you felt.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I will. Thank you, Ken.
Shibuya Park
Hey, what did I say about not throwing the ball toward the street...?!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Hm? That sounds like... Tono?

rows.Speaker: Arata
rows.Line:
Ah, Toya, perfect!
Mind picking up that ball there for me?

rows.Speaker: Arata
rows.Line: I was playing catch with these kids just now, but they aren't very good at throwing the ball and can't seem to get it to go straight.

rows.Speaker: Boy A
rows.Line:
That's not fair.
You're a terrible teacher.

rows.Speaker: Boy B
rows.Line: Yeah, what he said!

rows.Speaker: Arata
rows.Line: Yes, but... Weren't you the ones who asked me to teach you while I was warming up for singing practice because you thought I was good at baseball?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I'm still not sure what's going on exactly, but you just need me to toss you this ball, yes...?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Hmm... How do I actually grip a baseball...? There's also quite a way between us, Tono, so I may need to throw this fairly hard...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
Alright...
Tono, here it comes.

rows.Speaker: Arata
rows.Line: Okay.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Now...!

rows.Speaker: Arata
rows.Line: Huh...?

rows.Speaker: Boy A
rows.Line: Hey, he was supposed to throw it back to us. Why'd he spike it into the ground?

rows.Speaker: Boy B
rows.Line: No idea.

rows.Speaker: Boy A
rows.Line: See you later, noobs!

rows.Speaker: Boy B
rows.Line: Get better at throwing and teaching for next time, okay?

rows.Speaker: Arata
rows.Line:
*Sigh*
I apologize for making you go through that, Toya...

rows.Speaker: Arata
rows.Line: Also, I didn't realize how unathletic you were...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Yes, ball sports in particular are my Achilles' heel since I haven't really played any before...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: By the way, Tono, did you know those kids from before?

rows.Speaker: Arata
rows.Line: No, we met for the first time here just now. I believe they're local residents of Vivid Street.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I see.

rows.Speaker: Arata
rows.Line: It's nice that they get to grow up in a place like this...

rows.Speaker: Arata
rows.Line: From the time they're born, they get to live life while being exposed to all things related to music.

rows.Speaker: Arata
rows.Line: In that respect, your friend, An, comes to mind.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Yes, Akito's very envious of her.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
Oh, speaking of which...
Do you like this city, Tono?

rows.Speaker: Arata
rows.Line: Hm?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: So, I've been discussing with Akito and the others about what it means to “take a look at this city”, and we began wondering if those sorts of feelings were related in any way.

rows.Speaker: Arata
rows.Line:
Ah, I see...
Do I like this city...?

rows.Speaker: Arata
rows.Line: I honestly can't say...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: What...?

rows.Speaker: Arata
rows.Line: So much has happened while I've been here.

rows.Speaker: Arata
rows.Line: Like what I saw that night with Soma.

rows.Speaker: Arata
rows.Line: Or working on my singing every day like there was no tomorrow.

rows.Speaker: Arata
rows.Line: And things that I'd taken for granted but were taken away from me all of the sudden... So much has happened.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I'm sorry. I didn't mean to...

rows.Speaker: Arata
rows.Line: No, if anything, I should be apologizing. I'm sorry about the somber tone.

rows.Speaker: Arata
rows.Line: But I feel that it was also necessary for me to look back upon the past since this city has so much to do with it.

rows.Speaker: Arata
rows.Line: Most importantly, I was overseas and not actually here for quite some time.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: To work on your singing, yes?

rows.Speaker: Arata
rows.Line: Yes. However, there was likely also a part of me that didn't want to be here.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (If I were in his shoes...)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (I'm not sure I could keep singing here in this city with Akito absent...)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: And despite all that, Tono, you decided to return.

rows.Speaker: Arata
rows.Line: Yes. It was also nice to see that not much had changed when I did.

rows.Speaker: Arata
rows.Line: But...

rows.Speaker: Arata
rows.Line: I myself had changed a lot...because I needed to... And a part of me was uncomfortable with the fact that not much had changed around here.

rows.Speaker: Arata
rows.Line: When Taiga told me to “take a look at this city”, it honestly felt like he saw right through that and was telling me to get a grip on reality.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Really...?

rows.Speaker: Arata
rows.Line:
What about you, Toya?
Do you like this city?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Huh...?

rows.Speaker: Arata
rows.Line: I opened up quite a bit to you, so would you mind doing the same for me?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Understood...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Yes, I like this city.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: It became a place where I could belong when I had nowhere else to go, including my own home. I was even able to meet a partner I could share the same dream with.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: This city and the people I've met here have accepted me when I had nothing because I have one thing in common with them... A love for music.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Akito and the others even began to accept me as a person as I sang with them.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: So, this city means everything to me.

rows.Speaker: Arata
rows.Line: I see...

rows.Speaker: Arata
rows.Line: I think I know what you mean by feeling accepted by others.

rows.Speaker: Arata
rows.Line: I... We were the same way.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
Hm? Toya? And Tono...?
What are you two doing here?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Oh, I was hoping that we could warm up together since we'd be practicing with everyone later...

rows.Speaker: Arata
rows.Line: Me too... We've been chatting for quite a while now, so let's get started.

rows.Speaker: Arata
rows.Line: I'm glad we could talk, Toya.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: No, I should be thanking you.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: What exactly were you two talking about just now...?

rows.Speaker: Arata
rows.Line: Hehe. Alright, let's start warming up.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Huh? Hey, don't just ignore me.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Hehe...
Arcade

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: So this is where the gaming tournament's supposed to take place.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: And it's cleaner than I expected. I guess it really is their grand reopening.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Yes, with quite a selection of machines and new titles.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Anyway, how do we actually register for this tournament?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
The registration for that should be...
Oh, there it is.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Excuse me. We'd like to register for the “Funtastic Gaming Tournament” that we saw being advertised on this flyer...

rows.Speaker: Manager
rows.Line:
You'd like to enter?! Excellent!
Just fill out the parts that say, “Required,” if you will!

rows.Speaker: Manager
rows.Line: The tournament will be starting soon, so you'll need to be quick!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Our names, team name, favorite games, list of tournaments we've been in... I'm surprised at how legit this looks...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Toya, can you handle this?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Sure, no problem.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: That should be everything, so now...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Hm? What's up?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I'm not sure what to do about our team name. Do you have any good suggestions?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Oh, right...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
Hmm... Our team name...
Why not just “BAD DOGS”?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: It isn't a bad suggestion, but I'd rather not cheapen it by using it here...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Also, this is a gaming tournament and not a singing event. This doesn't seem like the right time or place for it, so let's think of something else.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: The right time and place, huh...?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Yes. With that in mind, we should try coming up with a name that suits us.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: In that case, we could try putting our initials together...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
We have S and A... A and T...
Take out the duplicate A and go with SAT...?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Isn't that what the police's special tactical unit's called?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Oh, yeah... You might be right...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
Hmm... A good team name...
Do you have any preferences or suggestions, Toya?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Well, it'd be nice if it captured who we are...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Who we are? What do you mean?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Sorry, I'm not actually too sure myself...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Okay. Then, let's give it a little more thought and just go with our initial if all else fails...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (Since the two of us are entering together, it'd be nice to come up with a name that fits us perfectly...)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (In that respect, drawing upon our real names does seem like a good option...)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (Our real names...)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Akito, do you remember when we all came up with a player name for me?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Oh, you mean when the four of us went to that arcade together?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Yes. That time, we...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: This is my first time hearing that you have to come up with a player name for yourself. Despite having been to the arcade many times, I honestly had no idea.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: It's not really your fault since you almost exclusively play the claw machines.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Yeah, claw machines are big and usually right by the entrance, so it's kind of hard to see all the other games that are further in...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Yeah, it seems pretty natural to not know based on what you usually like to do.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: At the same time, I still sorta can't believe that you almost put in your real name.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Right. I'm glad that you were all there to warn me that I should be using a pseudonym instead.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: I mean, if you don't mind or if worst comes to worst, there's nothing wrong with using your real name.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: No, everybody else was using a pseudonym so... When in Rome...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Hehe. That's so you, Aoyagi.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Isn't it?
Also, I think the name we came up with is pretty good.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Yes. There's a chance that someone else has the same initials as me, so we added the initials for our team name at the end to make...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: ATVBS... Read as “at-bis”.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: It's really just a string of initials.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
But I think it's a cool name.
I'd like to wear this name proudly as I play moving forward.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: You all helped come up with a name for me.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: So, you wanna do the same thing for our team name?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: That could work, but I'm thinking that we could use a pair of words this time.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Aoyagi and Shinonome... A willow and a cloud... Yes, we can be Willow & Cloud.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Willow & Cloud...?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
Yeah, not bad.
It's definitely better than just using our initials.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Excellent. Then, let's go with this.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Akito, let's do our absolute best today to win as Willow & Cloud.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Yeah...
Shibuya Park

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Okay, that should be enough practice for today...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Nice work, everyone!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I feel like we've been on a nice roll lately.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Me too! Let's keep this up and get into really good shape going into our next show.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Sounds good. So, let's meet at the same time tomorrow.

rows.Speaker: An & Kohane
rows.Line: Okay!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: That reminds me. Shiraishi, Azusawa, there's something I need to give you before you leave.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Here.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Wait, these are VIP passes to the Gaming Expo...!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Oh, that's right. You guys said how that gaming tournament was offering these as the prize for winning.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Does that mean you guys won?!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
Sadly, no...
The manager gave us these as a token of his appreciation.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Whoa, really?! That's so generous of him!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Yes, I agree. He's a very nice person.

rows.Speaker: Manager
rows.Line:
Don't mind me.
I'm sure I'll get another chance in the future if I stay in this line of work. More importantly, you helped make this day absolutely unforgettable.

rows.Speaker: Manager
rows.Line: To see my grandfather's store filled with customers, and to see them all smiling... I never thought such a day would ever come.

rows.Speaker: Manager
rows.Line: I have all of you to thank for that, so please, take these as a small token of my appreciation.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: But you're so good at video games, Aoyagi. You guys not being able to win must mean that it was a tough tournament.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Yes, we had some very heated battles and I had a lot of fun playing against Kusanagi and Otori, who won in the end.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Wait, Kusanagi and Emu?!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
Yes, that's right.
Kusanagi in particular was very good...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Good? She was way better than that. She was better than your average Joe even for games that she didn't seem all that familiar with.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: I had no idea that she was so good at video games!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: By the way, what games did you guys play during this tournament?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Oh, we played a first-person survival game, a puzzle game and even made Print Stickers.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Wait, Print Stickers?!
As in the stickers you make by taking pictures of yourself and doodling all over them?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
Yeah...
We had to do that for the first round and it made me want to leave afterwards...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: And this was our entry.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Let's see...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Dude...! Why do you have that...?!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I thought we could talk a little about the tournament while handing over the tickets.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: I thought we agreed to never bring it up again...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
Oh, I'm sorry...
I was under the impression that Azusawa and Shiraishi were exempted from that.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
*Sigh*
I guess there's no use crying over spilt milk...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Hahahaha!
Y-You guys even posed!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Yeah, I can't do this.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: I'll be taking that.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Hey, we weren't done looking!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Hehe. You two looked so close and like you were really enjoying yourselves.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Enjoying ourselves...?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
H-Hehehe...
I know this wasn't easy for you, Akito.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
Hey, quit giggling.
You think I'm happy about this at all?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Don't say that... H-Hehe. Hahaha!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: A-An...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Grr... I'm never doing this again...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: What...?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
Hold on...
You're not thinking about doing this again, are you?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I was since it was just the two of us this time around. I thought it'd be good for the four of us to experience it together as a way to get on the same wavelength...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Um, I kind of want to try doing that as well. And like what Aoyagi said, we'd get to share the experience...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Yeah, shouldn't you throw your partner a bone if they show interest in doing something?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Fine, if I ever feel like it...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Great! I really appreciate it, Akito.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Anyway, for now, why don't we head over to my place so you guys can show my dad that picture?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: What?! There's no way I'm letting that happen!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Toya, never ever hand that picture to her again! Got it?!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
Understood.
If you're that against it, I'll refrain from doing so.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Good. Never means never, okay?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Aww, that's too bad.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Don't think that I'm gonna forget about this...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Hehe.
Toya's Room

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (My song's finally starting to turn out the way I imagined. I should be able to finish it today at this rate...)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (And writing everything out like this has helped me quite a bit. I'm definitely having an easier time expressing myself.)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (The things I learned from Soma are all paying dividends.)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (Soma's probably working on his own song right now, so I need to keep at it as well.)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
Oh, it's already gotten this late...
But I only have some minor adjustments left to make before it's finished.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I'll check it over again just to make sure.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (Yes, this is good.)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (Hm? That last phrase...)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
(It sounds like what I imagined...
And yet, it seems like I can still do more.)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (But what would I change?)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (I've made plenty of adjustments to the beat already, as well as the bridges. They should be as good as they're going to get.)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (What else do I need to add to complete this song...?)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Ah...

rows.Speaker: Soma
rows.Line: I like to use snippets of existing songs, but I also enjoy using sounds you can hear from the world around us.

rows.Speaker: Soma
rows.Line: Haha. I guess you can chalk it up to me interpreting all these sounds as music.

rows.Speaker: Soma
rows.Line: Also, by using these kinds of sounds, you can tie your music to day-to-day life.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
The sounds around me...
Music and day-to-day life...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Come to think of it, I've been surrounded by music since I was born.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
Dad's performances for one.
But I also grew up listening to my older brothers practicing the piano and violin...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: And I began singing on Vivid Street after stepping away from classical music...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Hey, you've been singing around here a lot lately.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
Your rhythm and pitch are always so precise.
I bet you've been into music a while.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: ...I guess you could say that.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Oh? Some kind of story behind it, I take it?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
Now I'm really interested.
Hey, how would you like to try singing together?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I met Akito, Ken and learned about Akito's dream...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: After that, I met Shiraishi, Azusawa, Miku and the others. Then, we became a team...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Music has been in my life for as long as I can remember, and I've been able to meet so many wonderful people because of it.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
It's a part of me.
It's never not going to be.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: This may not quite suit my personality, but this sort of approach may work in this case...
The next day
Shibuya Park

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I'll start here first.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (This place may help me find the sound that my song is missing.)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (I hear the voices of the children as they play in the park, and street musicians singing somewhere in the distance...)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (I don't usually notice these things during practice, but this place is full of different sounds.)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: So, let's get to sampling them.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Okay, I've found quite a few nice sounds after just a short walk around...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Some strangely interesting ones too. When I walked around on the dirt and concrete, or when I bought something to drink from the vending machine...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Also...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: The sounds from Vivid Street were more full of energy because of all the cars, the people, the street musicians, the singing, the performances...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Those were definitely all unique to Vivid Street.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Anyway, the next spot will be my last...
Weekend Garage

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Welcome!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Hm? Is it just you here, Shiraishi...?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
My dad should be back soon.
He went out to buy some coffee beans.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Ah, I see.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: If you want your usual coffee, you'll probably want to wait until he returns.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Yes, I'll be patient.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (I also need to ask for permission to sample sounds from inside the cafe.)

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: By the way, Toya, did something good happen to you?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
Hm? Yes, I suppose so...
Was I making that sort of face?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Yeah, kinda.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Hehe. You've changed so much, Toya.
Until just recently, I really couldn't tell what you were thinking most of the time.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: You say that, Shiraishi, but I believe you deserve more credit for noticing that.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Maybe, but I was able to notice because you began expressing yourself more with your face.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Plus, we're teammates, so I want to share in those feelings with you more. I'll be happy when you're happy, and try to cheer you up or cry with you when you're feelings sad.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I'd like that as well...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (I wonder what everyone's going to say when they hear my completed song.)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (I want us to all feel happy, so I'll need to keep doing my best to make that happen.)
Toya's Room

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Okay...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (I wasn't expecting my song to be received so well.)

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: I really wanna sing this track!!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
It was so incredibly amazing, Aoyagi!
I really want to sing your song right now too!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: What did I think? Obviously, I thought it was the best thing ever! If we were to perform this song, the sky would be the limit!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Just hearing the intro alone made me want to sing it, but as the song went on, I felt this hot sensation start welling up inside me. I guess that's what it really means to evoke emotions in somebody.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Dude, where did you learn to make something like this?! This means I've gotta up my game too...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: And that song's going to be on the set list for our next event.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Do the others really understand that it takes place next week?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: But I'm glad...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
(They're always helping me...
And all I could do for our team really amounted to very little.)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (They said that I've been helping them, so maybe I was making real contributions to our team...)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: But... I think I'm finally able to contribute in a way that I can feel good about.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: During our next event, we'll get to sing this song. Our song...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: So, Toya, you should just keep trying until you feel satisfied. I'll be looking forward to singing a song written by you.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I promise to do just that...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: If Shiraishi sings this part with her usual power, it should pack a fairly serious punch.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: The part after that's a bit tricky, but I feel like Akito and Azusawa have the right voices for it. Then...
The next day
Weekend Garage

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
Alright, we're all here.
Let's get ready for the last week before our event.

rows.Speaker: Kohane & An
rows.Line: Yeah!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Yes.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: We're going to start by working on the lyrics for the song Aoyagi wrote, right?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Yeah, I wrote some for it.
Here, take a look...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
Hey, these are better than I expected.
I thought they'd be a lot rougher since you only had a couple of days to work on them.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: A jolt ran through me when I heard this song for the first time, and I immediately started getting ideas.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: But I'm not really sure if it totally goes with your song, Toya. What do you think...?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
This is astonishing...
Your choice of words is impeccable, Shiraishi. It's like you knew exactly how I felt.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I want to sing this song with these lyrics.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Really?! Awesome!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
Also, I divided it up into parts.
Would you all mind taking a look?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Oh, what do you got?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: This is...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: What do you think...?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: This is perfect!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: I mean, it's almost exactly how I thought we should sing this song after hearing it for the first time! I sorta can't believe it!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Yeah, me neither! Oh, like this part!
I had a feeling that it's going to sound amazing if you sang it, An!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Yeah, I also had the same sort of idea. I go for volume, Toya balances everything out and you get in the last punch, Kohane.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Let's split the song up like this.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
...!
Thank goodness.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Still, I really can't believe how we're totally on the same page.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: I know, right?! Oh, does this mean we're all on the same wavelength?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
Probably.
Now, let's get work on those lyrics.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Yes!
Aoyagi Household - Living Room

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Mom, I'm heading off to practice.

rows.Speaker: Toya's Mother
rows.Line:
Toya, wait.
Do you have a moment before you go?

rows.Speaker: Toya's Mother
rows.Line: Your father will be busy performing during Christmas, so we'll be holding our party early as usual.

rows.Speaker: Toya's Mother
rows.Line: Which is why I'd like you to come home early that day. Would that be possible?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Yes, if we have practice that day, I'll ask the others to see if we can end it early or call it off.

rows.Speaker: Toya's Mother
rows.Line: Wonderful...!

rows.Speaker: Toya's Mother
rows.Line: Then, I'll ask your father after he gets home about when will be best.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Okay.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: By the way, will we all be gathering...?

rows.Speaker: Toya's Mother
rows.Line:
Oh, do you mean your brothers?
No, they'll be busy with their own concert.

rows.Speaker: Toya's Mother
rows.Line: They both sounded very sad when I asked them.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I see...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (If they did come home, I could tell them all about Dad, Akito and everyone else...)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
I know it may seem it's beneath you.
But that's not how I see it.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: This music is as important to me as classical music is to you.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I've never wanted to hold on to something so much before...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: And I really want you to understand that... Because you're the one who introduced me to the joy of music.

rows.Speaker: Toya's Father
rows.Line: I... I can't understand what people see in that sort of music...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: That sort of music...?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Dad, were you...?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (He still hasn't fully accepted what I'm doing, but I was able to tell him what I actually want to do with my life...)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (Which means I should be comfortable with telling my brothers about it.)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (And I thought I'd get a chance to this Christmas. Unfortunately, it'll have to wait until another time...)

rows.Speaker: Toya's Mother
rows.Line: While we're on the subject, Toya, is there anything you'd like to eat during our party?

rows.Speaker: Toya's Mother
rows.Line: I'll be roasting a chicken since your father said he'd like some.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: What I'd like to eat...?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: How about that rice gratin with fish you made during our last Christmas party?

rows.Speaker: Toya's Mother
rows.Line: Oh, did you like it that much?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Yes, it was very good and definitely left an impression on me.

rows.Speaker: Toya's Mother
rows.Line: Hehe. I'm glad I decided to take on that challenge. Hearing such a glowing review means it was worth the effort.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Challenge...?

rows.Speaker: Toya's Mother
rows.Line: Yes. I generally avoid intricate dishes since I'm not exactly the best cook out there.

rows.Speaker: Toya's Mother
rows.Line: But your father said I should do just fine as long as I follow the recipe.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I didn't realize...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
(Follow the recipe...
That sounds like something he'd say.)

rows.Speaker: Toya's Mother
rows.Line: Also, Mrs. Tenma... Tsukasa's mother sent me a video for reference.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (She always goes above and beyond for birthday and Christmas parties... But I guess she works very hard behind the scenes.)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Thank you for always putting in so much effort, Mom. I'll be looking forward to what you make for us this Christmas.

rows.Speaker: Toya's Mother
rows.Line: Yes, I'll do my best to make sure both you and your father smile.

rows.Speaker: Toya's Mother
rows.Line: Oh, I'm also thinking about baking some gingerbread cookies.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Gingerbread cookies?

rows.Speaker: Toya's Mother
rows.Line: Hehe. You and your father both like cookies, no? 'Tis the season, and it'll be another nice challenge for me.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Thank you, Mom.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (The cookies she bakes sometimes get a little burnt, but for some reason, they taste better than any others I've had.)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (I'm very much looking forward to our party now...)
The day after Christmas
Toya's Room

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
That should be everything I need.
I should head off to practice now.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (The Christmas parties here, at Weekend Garage and in SEKAI were all very enjoyable.)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I've made some wonderful memories, and now I'll need to use the fun I had as fuel for practice...

<Hey! Toya!
You gotta help...!>

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Hm? That voice...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Luka, is something wrong?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: <Oh, Toya, thank goodness you heard me! We have a real emergency on our hands!>

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: An emergency...?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: <Yes! So...>

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: <Christmas ended before I could see any more illuminations!>

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Oh, that's right. I suggested that you look at them as inspiration for decorating MEIKO's place...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
<Yes, exactly!
They helped quite a lot, and I enjoyed them very much!>

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: <But I only caught glimpses of them since I had to stay hidden. I never got a good look to be honest.>

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I see...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
<So, Toya!
Are there any places left where I can still see some?>

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Well...
Shibuya Park

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
So...
Do any of you know of any places that still have all their lights on display?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: I was wondering what you meant by a “small favor”...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Wait, that was one of the reasons you came to see me that other time.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
<Yes, it was.
So, are there any places that still have their lights up?>

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Gimme one second.
I think...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Yeah, I thought so! They're gonna keep the illuminations on Miyamasuzaka up all the way through New Year's!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: <Wonderful♪>

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Let's tell Kohane when she gets here. They should be on by the time we're done with practice, so we can check them out on our way home.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Sure, why not?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
<Thank you all so much!
Rin and the others have been wanting to see them as well, so I'm sure they'll love to hear the news!>

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: In that case, we'll see you later tonight.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: <Okay♪ See you then!>
Miyamasuzaka

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: We're here!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Luka and the others should be able to come out as long as we stick to the shadows.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Yeah.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
Alright, Luka...
Thank you for waiting.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: <Okay♪ Hurry, everyone!>

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: <Okay, relax. We're right behind you.>

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <Thank you for agreeing to do this on such short notice.>

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
No, it's our pleasure.
We've actually been wanting to see these too.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
<Wow! They're sooo pretty!
Even the trees over there are all lit up!>

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
<Yes, they really are!
This is so exciting! It's still like it's Christmas!>

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: <Oh, I wanna see the ones over there! Akito, can you take us over!>

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Sure, but try to keep it down.

rows.Speaker: Rin, Len & KAITO
rows.Line: <Okay!>

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: <You too, KAITO...?>

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: How about we join them?

rows.Speaker: An & Kohane
rows.Line: Okay!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: <Thank you for bringing us here, Toya!>

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: <These are much more beautiful than what I originally imagined! Honestly, I was stunned! I'm so glad I got to see them!>

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
No, this was nothing.
Plus...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I'm glad we're all spending this time together. It'll be another wonderful memory.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: <Yes, it will! Oh, why don't we all take a photo to celebrate?>

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Good idea. Let's do that.
Street SEKAI
Crase Cafe

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Still no...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Toya's been peering at his phone every few seconds for a while now. Is everything okay...?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: I don't know. Kohane, has he told you anything?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Oh, actually...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Hey.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
Oh, Akito, perfect timing!
We were just talking about Toya's odd behavior.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Huh? Ohh...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: He might be acting that way because he's been waiting to get this new book by this author he likes until our next event is over.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: A new book...?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Yes. It's the newest installation in a popular series by a very famous mystery author.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: It's apparently been getting good reviews and was even featured on TV this morning.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Yeah, everyone was raving about it online on the day it released.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
Okay, but... Why not just get it?
Wouldn't it be better for you to just read it?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: If I do, there's a high likelihood of me staying up all night reading it...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: And once I finish it, I'll want to look up theories and reactions online. With that in mind, I can expect to lose several days...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I wouldn't want it to interfere with practice.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: I see... As disciplined as ever...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: You stand to learn a lot from him, KAITO.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Me? Haha...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I even thought about trying to simmer my craving by reading other people's reviews...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: But I ended up refraining from doing so since I may come across some spoilers.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: And that's why you were peering at your phone just now.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
Oh, Toya!
Can you tell us more about this book?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Luka, he's doing his best to not think about it...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
Oh, right...
Sorry, Toya.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
No, it's okay.
Talking about it may actually help.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: It's the latest installment in a series of mystery novels by an author who's been hailed as a master of misdirection. And this one is supposed to be full of twists once again.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Oh, like one of those books where everything is turned upside down during the last ten pages?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Yes, that's about right.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: While reading, I find great enjoyment in being surprised and seeing how everything is elegantly tied together.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Also, the protagonist and surrounding characters are usually very intriguing people. I particularly enjoy the banter between the protagonist and his partner.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (However, in the previous book, he and his partner...)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Toya...?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I-It's nothing, but...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I was just reminded of a fairly significant event that happened during the last book...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (Why did his partner do that...?)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (There seemed to be some sort of hint hidden within the conversation they had with that shadowy character, but I'm yet to read a prediction that isn't riddled with holes...)

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Are you sure this isn't having the opposite effect...?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
I'm really sorry, Toya!
I shouldn't have asked you about this!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
Uh, how about...? MEIKO!
Why not pour Toya a delicious cup of coffee?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: As much as I'd like to, he's already had five...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: I was wondering why he was drinking so much coffee. This book must've been the reason.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
Oh, I know.
How does a coffee float sound? That could help take your mind off it.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
Thank you very much...
I'll happily accept your offer.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Okay, coming right up.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Speaking of which, MEIKO, the way you brew nel drip coffee is always so interesting. It's such a nice twist on more common methods.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Twist...?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: KAITO! Be careful what you say!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Huh?! What did I do?!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Toya, you're clearly starting to hear things. Why don't you just read that book already...?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: No, our event's just around the corner. I can't let my guard down now...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Our third event takes absolute priority.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I'll forget all about this once we start practicing. So, when Shiraishi gets here...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Hey! Sorry about the wait!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Oh, Toya! It looks like the new mystery novel you were talking about just came out! I saw a bunch of copies in the bookstore on the way home!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
It sounds really good.
They even talked about it on TV earlier!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: An, wait...!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
I'm sorry, MEIKO...
Can I get a rain check on that coffee float?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Everyone! Let's practice!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Good! That's what I like to hear, Toya!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Is that really a good thing...?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: W-Well, if it helps keep his mind off it...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Looks like we all need to avoid talking about that book until their event's over...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Or anything that even sounds like it.

rows.Speaker: Luka & KAITO
rows.Line: Okay.
Shibuya Park

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Nice work, everyone!
See you all next time!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Alright, we finally got to do a debrief for our third event, so let's head over to SEKAI.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Yeah. I'm sure Len and the others are dying to hear how it went.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Sorry, everyone...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Please go on ahead without me. There's somewhere I'd like to stop by first.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Where are you...? Ohh... That new book, right?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Oh, that's right...!
Now that our event's over, you can finally get it.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Oh, um... I'm really sorry about what happened the other day, Toya! I didn't know that you were holding off on getting it...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Oh, Toya! It looks like the new mystery novel you were talking about just came out! I saw a bunch of copies in the bookstore on the way home!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
It sounds really good.
They even talked about it on TV earlier!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: No, that's okay.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Yes, there were multiple times when I pictured the book on display in a store.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I even went out of my way to avoid the bookstore you mentioned, Shiraishi, since it's on my way to school.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Wow...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: However, I realized that I'd forget about all that whenever we began practicing.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: So, if something like this happens again in the future, I should be able to apply what I learned from this experience.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Haha. That's very admirable of you, Aoyagi...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
I feel really terrible...
I think I should go with Toya to ensure that he's able to buy a copy of this book...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Then, I'll head over to SEKAI first. I'll let Len and Rin know that...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: <Tell Len and me what?>

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Whoa! Don't jump out like that!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: <Don't forget about me♪>

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: <We figured that your guys' practice would be over right about now, so we came to check!>

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: <Anyway, what were you talking about just now?>

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: ...which is why I intend to head over to the bookstore first.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
<Oh, you finally get to buy that book!
Thank goodness.>

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Yes, I'm thankful as well.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
<The bookstore? That sounds fun!
They have music magazines and stuff, right?>

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: <Mind if we tag along?>

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I don't mind, but you'll have to stay hidden as best you can. Would that be okay with all of you?

rows.Speaker: Rin, Len & Luka
rows.Line: <Of course!>

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
*Sigh*
Well, this defeats the purpose of going over to SEKAI...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Hehe. We can all visit the bookstore together.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Okay.
Shopping Mall
Bookstore

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
<Okay, we should be good here.
Toya, which book are you after?>

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
It should be right by the entrance...
Ah, here it is!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Thank goodness they have it!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: But it's been a while now since it released. I'm sort of amazed to see that they still have it on display like this.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: <Yeah, they have tons of copies all stacked up!>

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
<Let me take a... Oh, look!
It's ranked #1 for something!>

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Yes, for new releases.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: To be fair, this author always delivers, so I'm very much looking forward to reading this.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: If you got what you need, take it up to the register. We'll be browsing in the meantime.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Okay.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Toya, over here!
Do you have it?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
Yes, I got it.
Hm? Where's Akito...?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: <Rin and Len were badgering him about... Oh, that must be them.>

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: <Thanks for buying us that magazine, Akito!>

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: All good. The CD it comes with caught my interest.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: You also bought something, Akito?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
A magazine, not a book.
Anyway, now that we're done here, let's head over to SEKAI.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Sure.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: <Wait, but... Toya, don't you want to read your new book?>

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
<Your wait is over, no?
And the others can tell us all about your event.>

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: No, I plan to keep the promise I made.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: In any case, I have the book now. I have tomorrow off, so I can just read it at my own leisure then.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: <Haha. Oh, Toya, you never change...>

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Yeah! Anyway, let's go!

rows.Speaker: Toya & Kohane
rows.Line:
Okay.
Yeah!
Vivid Street

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (Tsukasa and Saki's party is happening this week.)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (Kamishiro even said that my cupcakes were good. All that's left is for me to bake more for the day of.)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (Practice ended early today, so I should take this opportunity to buy whatever ingredients I need.)

rows.Speaker: Customer
rows.Line: Thanks for the pancakes! They were delicious! I'll come back again real soon!

rows.Speaker: Owner
rows.Line: Yeah, we'll be waiting!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Oh, it's that cafe...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (Akito goes there from time to time.)

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
Hey, that cafe.
They added new pancakes to their menu again?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: “We proudly present our latest and most odd pancakes”...?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Akito, what do you think they mean by “odd”?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Hm? Oh, I think they're referring to how delicate the batter is.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Each individual pancake ends up looking unique because they all rise differently.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Wait, doesn't that mean some will turn out well while others won't look as nice? That seems a bit unfair to the customers...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Nah, they're pros when it comes to that. Regardless of how they look, they all taste good.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: However, there are people out there who only care about getting the best-looking one. Like Ena...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I see...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: I don't really care how they look as long as they taste good. They're kind of like shows, you know?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Like shows?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Yeah, because they whip up the best pancakes they can for each individual customer at that point in time.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Apparently, how they turn out depends on what kind of condition the batter's ingredients are in that day, the temperature, level of humidity and all sorts of other things.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Doesn't that kinda sound like one of our events?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Like one of our events...?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: So, the batter is the performer? And they're using the information they can only learn that day, like the temperature and humidity, to get the crowd going?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Exactly.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: I remember how KAITO compared us to pancakes when we were getting ready for one of our events...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: And in retrospect, he was right for a change.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: For a change? That's not a very nice thing to say.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Hey, it's his fault for acting the way he usually does.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Anyway, that place's “odd” pancakes are made with each individual customer in mind.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Since we're here and done practicing for the day, wanna go get some? They even have some that aren't all that sweet.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Yes, we should invite the others as well.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (Odd creations that come from the heart...)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Why not try thinking about the happiest thing they ever did for you when you were little?

rows.Speaker: Little Tsukasa
rows.Line: Then, I'm going to turn Toya's frown upside down by doing a show for him!

rows.Speaker: Little Saki
rows.Line:
His shows are really fun!
You'll be smiling from ear to ear after watching it!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (Back then, they made me smile so many times. Even now...)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (And now, it's my turn to...)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Miku, KAITO and Kamishiro... For the sake of all those who helped me, I need to do my absolute best.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Alright...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I'll grab whatever ingredients I need, go over the recipe again and review the entire process. After that...
Tenma Household - Living Room

rows.Speaker: Toya, Tsukasa & Saki
rows.Line:
That was delicious!
That was good.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Toya, thank you for the cupcakes!
They were absolutely delicious!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
Thank you.
I'm glad you enjoyed them so much.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Hehe.
We really gobbled those up. Right after having dinner too.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Yes. Not only were they delicious, they were wonderfully soft and fluffy!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Yeah! Isn't it really hard to bake those kinds of cupcakes?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Hona's a great cook, but even she said that she has to be really careful when mixing the batter in order to make sure they rise right!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Really? But she's so skilled...
Even she has to be careful when it comes to that?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Yes, there are a few tricks to mixing the batter properly.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: However, I didn't know about them during my first attempt. As a result, my cupcakes neither rose the way I'd hoped nor achieved the right texture...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Because I don't have much experience cooking, I ran into quite a bit of trouble when just trying to make the meringue for the batter by myself...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: You did...? And yet, you were able to produce these wonderfully delicious cupcakes...!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: That means you must've worked very hard to bake them.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Thank you so much, Toya!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Again, I'm just glad that you're both enjoying them so much...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I'm so happy they turned out well...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Now I can proudly go and thank everyone who helped me bake these cupcakes.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
Oh, that reminds me.
I asked Kamishiro to help me with these.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Hm? Rui?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Yes. I asked him to taste them for me and he happily accepted.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
However, as I mentioned earlier...
The ones I made initially were awful, and I ended up causing him quite a bit of trouble as a result...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Interesting. It's rare of him to help others with anything that doesn't involve shows or performances.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Which means he must've wanted to help you, Toya. So, I wouldn't worry too much about what happened.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Honestly, he's making me do all sorts of strange things on a daily basis. I think it's good for him to experience what that feels like for a change.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Oh, Tsukasa...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Why not try thinking about the happiest thing they ever did for you when you were little?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Didn't they do their absolute best to put a smile on your face?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (Kamishiro made me realize something very important.)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (Which means I need to tell him that Tsukasa and Saki both enjoyed what I made for them.)

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Oh, Toya, does that mean Rui also helped you bake those cupcakes?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: No, I had some other friends help me with that.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Because my first cupcakes turned out so poorly, I was worried that I wouldn't be able to bake any the right way...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: But my friends were there to lend me a hand, and I was able to bake several different kinds as a result.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
I see.
Then, please thank them for us and tell them...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Thank you for putting a smile on your face!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Yeah! I'm sure they're really nice too since you've been showering them with so much praise.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
Yes...
They're all very wonderful people.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Okay, I think we've cleaned up everything.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Yes, things don't feel quite as festive anymore, but that was a fun party!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Let's do this again sometime!
Oh, we should totally invite all our parents!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Ah, excellent idea!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Then, why don't we take that opportunity to show our appreciation for them by putting together a big feast?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Oh, the three of us can cook together!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
Yes, we could...!
I'd like that very much.
Lunch break
Kamiyama High School - Class 1-B

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Toya?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Ah, I'll be right there.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
What should I have today...
Have you already decided?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Yes. I'll be having the lunch set.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Hm?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Hey, you're looking awfully cheerful today.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Hm? I am? I didn't realize.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Perhaps I'm simply looking forward to going out with everyone tomorrow.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Going out? It's only an arcade.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Well, it's special to me since everyone's showing up to celebrate my birthday.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Alright then.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Although hearing you say you wanted to celebrate your birthday at an arcade is the last thing I expected from you.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: It's been a while since I've gone to one. What's more, I heard there's a new game at the arcade where we took part in the gaming tournament.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Really? What sort of game is it?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I haven't researched much into it, but it's apparently a two-player cooperative game. It also has a four-player mode where you can play in pairs against each other.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Ah, I guess you wouldn't be able to play a game like that by yourself.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: That's why I was hoping you and the others would go with me tomorrow.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Well, that's fine by me. By the way, didn't Len and the others say they'd be joining us?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Indeed. Although tomorrow is not my birthday, they did mention that they would be coming to celebrate with us.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Sounds like they're more interested in the arcade than celebrating your birthday if you ask me.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Fine by me. The more, the merrier, after all.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Ugh. It'll be tough keeping Len and the others under the radar. We better warn them.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: MEIKO and KAITO said they'd be coming too, so I'm sure there's nothing to worry about.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Knowing MEIKO will be there puts me at ease, but KAITO...?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Well, whatever. Let's just have lunch.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Yes, let's.
The next day
Arcade

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: <Hey! Could that car game over there be the one that Toya said he wants to play?>

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: <Uh... He did mention it was some kind of vehicle, but it also sounded like some sort of box... Maybe it's that one at the back?>

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: <No way! It's gotta be that one with all the flashing lights! Right, Toya?>

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Actually, it's the one Rin pointed to.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: <Yay! I got it right!>

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: <Hey, are you guys even trying to hide?>

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: <Of course we are! Nobody's gonna notice if we just peep out a little like this.>

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <I guess you're kind of making an effort... Compared to Luka, that is.>

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: <Wow! That photo booth was so much fun! Thank you An, Kohane♪>

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: You're most welcome. It was so fun taking such cute photos together.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Me too!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <Kohane, An, thank you for going in with Rin, Len and even Luka too.>

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Well, that's because a certain someone was too embarrassed to go in a photo booth.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: <Yeah, wonder who that was!>

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Anyway, it's about time we moved on to that game Toya wants to play.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: That's right. After all, Toya's birthday is the reason we're here in the first place, so we can't just spend the whole day taking pictures like this.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I don't mind. Since you came all the way here, I wouldn't want any of you missing out on any other activities you want to try.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: <Thanks, Toya! You're always so generous.>

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <Still, let's not get too carried away...>

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: So, this is the game I want to play. It's called Panic 'n Plunder.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Look, there are two carts! Although they're a little on the small side.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: What have we here? It says, “The mine is collapsing! Loot as much treasure as you can and escape with your lives!”

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: “Turn the wheel left and right to dodge falling boulders... Hit the Scoop button to pick up fallen treasure. Smack the Jump button to launch your cart over broken tracks. Make sure to work as a team.”

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
Hmm...
Sounds interesting.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: <Yeah, it really does♪>

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: <For sure. If only we had something like this in SEKAI.>

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: <I bet you'd all be hooked if—>

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <Uh-oh, everyone hide!>

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Miku?
Just as I thought! If it isn't Toya and the others!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Hm? Tsukasa?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Urgh.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: We're here too.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Yay! It's Kohane and everyone! Good wonderhoy♪

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Hello!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Who'd have thought we'd bump into each other here!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Y-Yeah...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Are you all here to try out the new game, too?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: To our surprise, Nene invited us to play it with her!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: I mean, this is a multiplayer game. There is apparently also a single-player mode, but I don't know how I'd feel about that...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I suppose that's because the developers designed it as a game to enjoy with friends. I'm sure they'd be pleased that we're playing it how they intended.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: T-That's not what I meant...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: By any chance did you have your eyes on this game, too?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Yes. Since it's my birthday in a few days, I decided to invite some friends here to celebrate.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Ah, I see.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: In that case, I hope you wouldn't mind us sprucing up the celebration a little more?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Huh? What the heck are you planning?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Hehe, well I heard that this game has a 2v2 mode.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: So that means...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Vivid BAD SQUAD versus Wonderlands×Showtime!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Huh?!
Arcade

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Hehe, well I heard that this game has a 2v2 mode.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: So that means...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Vivid BAD SQUAD versus Wonderlands×Showtime!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Huh?!

rows.Speaker: Len's Voice
rows.Line: <That sounds like so much fun!>

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: I wanna play too♪

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Huh? Who said that?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Oh... Well, we're surrounded by lots of people having fun... What a coincidence, right?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Yeah! Anyway, this sounds like a great idea!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Agreed. In that case, would you all care to join us?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Of course. As long as I get to play with friends, I'm happy to join in.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Me too!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: What about you, Shinonome? I understand that your original intention was to celebrate Aoyagi's birthday, right?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Urgh. Fine. We're winning this, by the way.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Then it's settled.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Alright then! Let the Panic 'n Plunder Showdown featuring Vivid BAD SQUAD versus Wonderlands×Showtime commence!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Woohoo!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: The rules are simple. We split into teams of two and face off in the 2v2 mode.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: You must win two rounds to claim victory. Otherwise, it's a draw. How does that sound?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: So, what does the winner get?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Hmm... How about the losers treat the winners to smoothies?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Sounds like a plan! There'll be no need to stress since the stakes aren't too high.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Okay then. Are you ready to start round one?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Um... G-Good luck.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Right back at you!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Let the Panic 'n Plunder Showdown commence!

rows.Speaker: Rin's Voice
rows.Line: <Whisper, whisper, whisper... Is this quiet enough?>

rows.Speaker: KAITO's Voice
rows.Line: <I think so. Good luck, guys!>

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Whoa! Uh, look out on your right! Oh no! They're coming down on the left too!

rows.Speaker: An
