rows.Line: Man, this is way more intense than I thought! Over there, Kohane! There's loot on the right!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: I see it! B-But how do you pick up treasure again?!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: There's a button for it, remember? Press Scoop! No, what're you doing?! That's the jump button!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: This is everyone's first time playing. Plus, this isn't the sort of game Azusawa is used to.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Nene, there's some treasure over there!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Leave it to me! Oh no, we're gonna get crushed! Go right!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: On it☆

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Oh! Looks like they're off to a great start. Keep it up, you too!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Ahhh, that was so much fun!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Yeah, although we did lose...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: But hey, I can't believe you guys managed to find that hidden treasure chest!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: The panic started setting in when I saw your score shoot up like that.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: W-Well, I noticed the jump button flash even though the track was still intact, so tried pressing it.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I see. I didn't know about that mechanic...

rows.Speaker: Miku's Voice
rows.Line: <Nice work, you two!>

rows.Speaker: Luka's Voice
rows.Line: <Although we could only hear shouting and sound effects, I just know you tried your best♪>

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Thank you, Miku, Luka!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Looks like we're up! Just because it's your birthday, it doesn't mean we'll be going easy on you, Toya!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Okay. I'm ready.

rows.Speaker: Rin's Voice
rows.Line: <Akito! Toya! You got this!>

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: We're going to win this.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Ahem! It's time for round two... Begin♪

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Leave the jumping to me. Toya, you scoop up the treasure.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Got it.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Oh, looks like they've decided on their roles! Whoa, the track splits off!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: What's happening?! This wasn't in the last game!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Oh, the course is randomized for each game. The guide mentions it in small print.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
Trust the important stuff to always be in the fine print!
Toya, mind if we go right?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Good idea. There seems to be more treasure that way.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: The route on the right seems to be the most ideal for us, too.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Let's do this!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Wow! They're evenly matched, don't you think?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Yeah, both teams are quick to react. Looks like it'll be a close match.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Oh, looks like the track splits off into three up ahead. Now, which one should we take...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Look, there's an arrow pointing right on the wall! It's got to be that way!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Ah. Tsukasa, wait—

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Akito, it's the opposite way. Let's go left!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Huh?! A-Alright!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
And the winner of round two is...
Akito and Toya!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Grgh! To think that the second split in the tracks held a clue to the final fork!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: It appeared only briefly after we scooped up the treasure, so it's understandable that you missed it.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: I see. That arrow was just a touch too prominent, so I did have my doubts...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: And you fell into that simple trap.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: If I recall, it also had you fooled until Toya told you otherwise!

rows.Speaker: Kohane, An, Emu & Nene
rows.Line:
Hehe.
Haha!
Main Street

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I must say, I did not anticipate that we would be facing off against Tsukasa and the others today.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Hehe. And it turned out to be a lot of fun!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Yes. What a wonderful celebration it turned out to be.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Good to hear.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <I'm glad we were able to witness that intense showdown, too!>

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: <You'll stop by SEKAI later, right? I want to hear how the games went!>

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: <Hehe. Your usual coffee will be waiting for you.>

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Thank you. See you then.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Happy birthday, Toya! Ena and I made a flip book animation about Vivid BAD SQUAD for you♪

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Well, it's only a cartoon of you singing together, but I made you all look cute, so I hope you like it.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: I'll compile it into a video and send it to you later. Enjoy!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Toya! Happy birthday! I heard that you battled it out against Tsukasa and his friends in the arcade. I wanna try out that game too♪

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: There is a single-player mode too, so we can still go as a group of three.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Yeah! And I'll be the cheerleader☆ Go, go Saki, go, go, go♪ C'mon! You got this, Toya♪

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Hehe. Although we never planned to bump into you, I'm glad that we also got to be part of your birthday celebration.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: That's right, Aoyagi. All that matters is that you managed to make some lasting memories. I hope you had a delightful birthday.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Aoyagi, I know I said it already, but happy birthday!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Happy birthday! And now, for a final word from your partner! C'mere, Akito!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Huh? Well, I'm not gonna go overboard and invite you to celebrate even more...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: But happy birthday, Toya. You always have been and always will be the best partner I could've ever asked for. Thanks.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Oooh, look at you blushing after saying such kind words!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: That's what happens when you put someone on the spot like that...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Hehe. Let's keep doing our best together!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Thank you all for celebrating my birthday today.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: To be blessed with so many friends who would celebrate with me makes me happy, albeit a little embarrassed.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I promise to move forward diligently, and put everything I have into singing.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: So, I hope you will continue to show me your support. Until next time.
Kamiyama Street

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I apologize for not arriving sooner.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: That's okay. An said she's still going to be busy helping out at her place.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Did the video turn out okay?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
Yes, it was edited very well.
I'm sure Rin and the others are going to enjoy seeing it.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
*Sigh*
They might finally settle down now.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Yes, they've been rather vocal about seeing what happened...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Hey, when are we gonna get to see what happened during your third event?!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: It was totally off the hook, right?! Is that video gonna be ready soon?!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Like I said, it's being edited...

rows.Speaker: Rin & Len
rows.Line: No! We wanna see it! Nooooow!!!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Seriously, every time I go over, they start hounding me about it...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I suspect they're this excited because we've already told them about what happened.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Yeah, I'd be excited too if I were them.
I mean, hearing about something is completely different from seeing it in a video.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
True.
RAD WEEKEND being no exception.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I still remember how stunned I was when I saw that video of it for the very first time.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: I've rewatched it a few times since, but that excitement I initially felt has never really faded.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: I guess it's just one of those things that holds up forever.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Yes, I can't thank the owner of COL enough for taking that video.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I've seen what we're trying to surpass now. I know what we're really up against.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: I feel the same way!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: An had told me all about RAD WEEKEND, but seeing it for myself... It was so much more amazing than I ever imagined! Much more!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Yes, it was an unimaginable event...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I can see why so many people became driven to follow in its path and do something similar.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: And then there's us.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Also, Taiga was against letting anyone make a recording of it...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I was a little shocked when Ken mentioned that.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: While we're on the subject, Nagi was apparently the one who asked the owner to record that video...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Does that mean she didn't ask Taiga?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
Probably...
I mean, he didn't seem to know that it even existed.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: I'm guessing she knew he'd be against it.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Taiga does seem like he'd be stubborn about things like that.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
(But he's her older brother...
Did she really go behind his back?)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (If so, there must be some other reason as to why she wanted to have a recording made.)

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Sorry I'm late!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
An, how was the cafe?
I hope things weren't too bad!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
Alright, let's head over to SEKAI.
Rin and Len are probably both eagerly awaiting our arrival.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Ready, Toya?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Yes, let's go.
Weekend Garage

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Get home safe, guys.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
*Nod*
See you tomorrow... No, wait. We're not having practice tomorrow, are we?

rows.Speaker: An's Father
rows.Line: You all fought pretty hard against Taiga, right? You need to give your throats a chance to recover.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: We will.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Now, if you'll excuse us.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: See you later, An!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Okay! See you!
Vivid Street

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: It's already pretty late...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Well... We did just have quite a day...

rows.Speaker: Taiga
rows.Line: That night became what it was because of one thought, one idea...

rows.Speaker: Taiga
rows.Line: Without that, there was no way RAD WEEKEND would've become the event it did.

rows.Speaker: Taiga
rows.Line: Our goal was to put on one final event worthy of the end of her life.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: I still can't believe what happened to Nagi...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Neither can I...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
...
Actually...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Didn't you say when we watched that video of RAD WEEKEND how...?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
I may be mistaken...
But something about all the performers' voices felt sad or dispirited for some reason...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Sad...?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Doesn't this mean you were right?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Oh, right...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: But I never expected to hear that it was Nagi's last event...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Her last one...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: It didn't seem like that at all...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: I mean, the excitement I feel whenever I watch that video of RAD WEEKEND... The way my heart races...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Yeah...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
A fire was lit inside of me that night.
My soul was set ablaze.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
Which means...
Akito, your fire jumped to me.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: And An's to me.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (Nagi was an incredible person. More than I realize...)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (She started a fire that set that entire venue, this entire neighborhood ablaze. And it's still going even today...)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (It's clear that we still have a lot of work to do before we can take up her mantle...)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
(But we're carrying her dream now.
It's inside all of us.)

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: This is our new starting point.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: I don't care how high or far away our target is... We're going to find a way to hit it!

rows.Speaker: Toya & Kohane
rows.Line:
Yeah!
Yes!
Weekend Garage

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Weekend Garage is really closing down...?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: It's great that Ken's going to start watching our practices, but that news was pretty sad to hear...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: It was...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Dad, lemme help.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Oh, I'd like to help as well!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: We'd also like to help.

rows.Speaker: An's Father
rows.Line:
Hm...?
I should be telling you all to head back to your respective schools...

rows.Speaker: An's Father
rows.Line: But I guess you won't make it back in time for classes. So, fine. Stay if you like...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Woohoo!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Thank you very much.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
You were just putting away the cups, right, Dad?
Why don't we do the rest of the plates and stuff for him?

rows.Speaker: Kohane, Akito & Toya
rows.Line:
Okay!
Yeah.
Sounds good.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
Shiraishi, about the plates.
Do you need us to sort each set into individual boxes?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Hmm... A box for each one seems a bit excessive. I say just sort and load them up as best you can.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Oh, wait... The saucers should go with the cups, huh?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Yeah. Ken's putting away the cups now, so we should probably take these over to him before he seals up the boxes.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Okay!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Hey, check it out! This knife's super shiny now!

rows.Speaker: An's Father
rows.Line: Okay, we see. Please stop waving it around like that.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
I wasn't waving it around.
Gimme a little credit for giving it a good polish.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Hehe. Then, why don't we start polishing the spoons next? Those should be much safer to handle.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Speaking of spoons, I remember wondering why I appeared upside down in them when I was little.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
Really? I never cared about that.
I was always more interested in the food in front of me.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Me too!
Eating was always way more important.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: That sounds like you two.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: It does.

rows.Speaker: An's Father
rows.Line: Okay, the tableware's just about all put away. Thank you all for lending me a hand with that.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: No, it was our pleasure since you and your establishment have given us so much.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I still remember the first time I came here like it was yesterday.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: That reminds me, you seemed pretty nervous that time.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I was.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Chiefly because you said that Ken had been a professional artist until just recently, Akito. I assumed he'd be similar to my dad.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: What?

rows.Speaker: An's Father
rows.Line: Hahaha! In a way, I'm honored.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Coming here opened my eyes to a genre of music I never knew about, and I got to meet all of you here.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Yeah. This is even where we formed our team and decided on our name.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: We also spent a ton of time here for practice and stuff.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Yes. This place has been one of our main bases of operation.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: It's unfortunate that I won't get to have your coffee for a while, Ken...

rows.Speaker: An's Father
rows.Line: If coffee is what you want, I can brew some up for you right now.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Wait, really?

rows.Speaker: An's Father
rows.Line: Sure, it'll be on me. The last cup before I close up here.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Thank you very much!

rows.Speaker: An's Father
rows.Line: Alright then, could you clear off that table?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Of course!
Street SEKAI
Crase Cafe

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Hello.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Oh, Toya, welcome.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Is it just you today?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Yes, I was hoping to have some coffee.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Would you mind making my usual, MEIKO?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: My house blend? Coming right up.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Toya, come sit and chat with us.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Are you sure? Well, if none of you mind...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: We just heard from Rin and MEIKO that An's dad is going to start watching you and your team practice.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Yes, and he's going so far as to temporarily close his own shop to do so.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: I see. You must be a little sad that you won't be able to have his coffee for a while, no?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I am. Fortunately, I can still come here to have MEIKO's coffee.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
Oh, that's so kind of you to say.
Also, here's your coffee.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Thank you very much.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: I'm sure your practices are going to be very demanding, so please feel free to stop by and take a break anytime.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Thank you, we will.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Oh, that reminds me... Are your friends all coming back?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: No, we haven't made any progress on that front...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Okay...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Their lack of skill and commitment were made plainly clear. It may take them quite a while to get back on their feet, and the right trigger too.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: It may...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I've been there before, so I understand that they won't immediately be willing to come back...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
Um, Toya...?
Would you mind telling me a little more about what you experienced...?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: What...?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: It's just... I was the last one to arrive here, so I still don't know as much about you and the others as I'd like...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: That's why I'd really like it if you could tell me more about yourself. Please...?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
Thank you, Luka.
I'd be happy to tell you more about my past.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Really? You don't have to if you don't want to.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
I don't mind.
It's all ancient history at this point.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I'm sure Rin and MEIKO are already aware, but my dad started teaching me how to play the piano and violin when I was very little.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Outside of school, I had to spend all of my time practicing. I wasn't really permitted to play with my friends.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: His practices were hard, but I admired the way he played the piano. I dreamt of being able to perform like him someday.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: However...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: When I heard one of his performances in person, I was absolutely staggered.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I'd played that song for a contest once...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: But my performance paled in comparison to his. Each note he played was brimming with energy.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: That was probably the moment I saw how incredible the person I admired as a child really is.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I continued practicing to meet my parents' expectations...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: But I slowly began losing motivation.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Toya...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Before I knew it, I'd begun disliking classical music and distancing myself from my dad.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: I see...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: However, I've since returned to liking classical music and enjoying his piano performances.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I even told him the other day about how Ken is going to watch us practice.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I asked him for permission to start coming home later because we want to practice more and make our dream a reality.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
Y-You did?!
What did he say?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: He said he wasn't sure if I should be spending what precious time I have in life on this dream.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: And that I need to prove that my dream is worth it if I'm going to call myself a musician.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Whoa! Talk about tough love!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: But that essentially means he's okay with you investing more time into practicing, right?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Oh, right!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I don't know how things will go for us, but I was so glad to get the sense that he at least partially understands how serious I am.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: That's wonderful, Toya.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Yes, it is♪

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
Thank you for telling me all this!
I promise to keep giving you all the support I can, so feel free to ask if you ever think you need help!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Yes, thank you.
The day of the opening ceremony
Kamiyama High School

rows.Speaker: Male Student A
rows.Line:
Which class are you in?
I'm in Class C!

rows.Speaker: Male Student B
rows.Line: I'm in A. Do you know anyone in your new class? I don't know anyone at all.

rows.Speaker: Female Student A
rows.Line:
Hey, we're in the same class!
We'll get to talk so much!

rows.Speaker: Female Student B
rows.Line: Haha! Even when we were in different classes, we still ended up talking a ton.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (Everyone seems very excited about their new classes.)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (As for me...)
Toya!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Hm?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Morning!
Starting today, we're second-years.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
Good morning, Akiyama.
I'm looking forward to being in Class B with you.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Oh, you already know that we're in the same class?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Though, I guess that makes sense since our names are pretty close alphabetically...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: The corridor's getting very crowded, so why don't we move into the classroom and keep talking there?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Yeah, good point. Let's go♪

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Oh, cool! It makes sense when I think about it, but our seats are super close!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I hope I don't end up blocking your view of the blackboard.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Nah, I should be fine.
Also, I won't have to look at the blackboard much as long as I've got my textbooks handy♪

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Okay, but I don't recommend telling any of the teachers that...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Haha. Unfortunately for them, that's just the way I am.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: But they should be proud of the fact that I'm here for the opening ceremony.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
True.
I'm certainly glad you're here.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Shiraishi seemed particularly excited about you and her becoming second-years. I'm sure she'll be by to see you soon.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Yeah, I wanna see An too.
And Li'l Bro♪

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Still, there are so many people out in the corridor. Why don't they go to their respective classrooms...?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Because finding out which class you're in is a huge event for everyone. It's always fun to talk with others about who's in which one.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Also... A few people might not want to go immediately because no one they know is in their new class...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: I feel it's pretty common for them to look for classmates that are in the same situation as them and go in after they've had a chance to break the ice.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I see...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Do you not pay much attention to who's been placed in which class or who your new classmates are, Toya?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
I usually don't myself.
My name's pretty easy to find since it's usually towards the top. After that, I'll head off.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I was the same until just recently...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (Looking always seemed like a waste of time since I never had any time to make new friends.)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: But now, I try to look for the names of people I know before heading over to my own classroom.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Speaking of which, I believe Akito and Shiraishi are both in Class A...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Wait, really?!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Yes. Kusanagi was as well.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Whoa...! Just based on their personalities, that's a really interesting combination!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Oh, but that's too bad...
You and Li'l Bro are in different classes again.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: That's not really a problem.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: We were attending different junior high schools when we first met, so being in different classes isn't really an issue at this point.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Interesting.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
That's kinda nice.
I guess that's what a bond between partners is?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I suppose so.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Still, regardless of whether or not we're placed in the same class, nothing's going to change between us. That I know for certain.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Yeah. That's pretty cool.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: It's important to me that certain relationships remain constant, but I'm also looking forward to new ones.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: New ones?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Like making new friends.

rows.Speaker: Toya

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: You don't need to say it like you're just an observer. You're going to be one of those people very soon.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I suppose you're right about that.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Sorry for the wait, Aoyagi, Shinonome! I've come up with a route, so could you take a look?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Of course.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Hm? Who are those characters doing that show over there?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Oh, they're pair of demons called Lloromannic.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Demons?! Still, they're so cute!
Hey, can we have a quick peek at their show?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: That black one with the spiky head... Are they supposed to be a bird?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
You mean Badtz-Maru?
Yeah, he's a penguin.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Oh, I'm kinda surprised you know that one.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: We had Badtz-Maru bandaids at home when I was a kid. I remember using them a lot.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Kohane, look! This Corocorokuririn character looks exactly like you!

rows.Speaker: Toya & Akito
rows.Line: (Must be because he's a hamster.)

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: We got through most of the venue, didn't we?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Yes. Now we have Tsukasa and the others' show to look forward—

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Are those...?
se_walk_men_002_1

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Aoyagi?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
Claw machines...
I didn't realize they had these here.
se_walk_men_002_1
se_walk_women_002_1

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: I was wondering where you were going all of a sudden, but of course you'd be in the arcade corner.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Wow! All of the prizes are so cute!
Look at this massive plushie!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
That's a Pochacco plushie!
But it's lying face down...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (Someone either gave up after trying or it was actually positioned like this from the beginning...)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (Its design is quite stylized with his head being a little larger than his body. But the other Pochacco plushies placed at the back are properly sitting down, so the center of gravity may actually be in his backside.)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (In that case, first I'll try pulling the feet up and using its head as a fulcrum—)

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Huh? Hellooo? Toya, you in there?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: There he goes. He's gonna try to get it.

rows.Speaker: An & Kohane
rows.Line: What?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Everyone, look! I got it!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: That's amazing! You made it look so easy by making it roll over!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: You really are good at claw machines, aren't you, Toya?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Yeah, that's great and all, but is it okay for you to bring that home? Isn't your dad gonna say something about it?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
Oh, right...
If I could, I would like to bring it home...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Um... Pochacco is really cute though! I think he's a dog since he has floppy ears.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I think you're right. Oh, his profile is written on the tag.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: “Pochacco is a curious and clumsy little guy who sometimes sticks his nose where it isn't wanted. He loves going for walks and taking the long way.”

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: What?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Oh, nothing.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: “He is as tall as four cups of his favorite banana ice cream, and weighs as much as three giant carrots from the Fuwafuwa Town carrot patch.”

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Huh? Carrots?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: What? Quit looking at me like that.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Pochacco, huh...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: On second thought, I think I will take him home with me.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Sounds good! I think Pochacco would love that.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Since he's a little bit clumsy and you're always calm, I think you two would balance each other out.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: No, this guy does some unexpected stuff when his curiosity strikes. I'd say the two of them are kinda similar.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: If so, then all the more reason I'd like to be the one to take him home.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Would that be alright with you, Pochacco?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: “Of course!”

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Oh... Hehe.
Was that supposed to be Pochacco, An?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Is that what he sounded like? At least be accurate.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: What? Was that not accurate? I was sure that was how he sounded in the show we saw just before.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Ah, that's right! We'd better head back to the stage area soon to grab a spot!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Oh, yeah! Tenma and his troupe's show is starting soon!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Let's go, Toya.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Of course.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Pochacco... Tsukasa and his troupe's shows are really great. I hope you enjoy this too.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: What is this place?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I was at home thinking about my day at Puroland, and then—

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I'm glad that Dad and the others weren't back yet. Thanks to that, I was able to bring Pochacco home without a problem.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: At any rate, I really did have a lot of fun today. Much like that time we went camping, I've made unforgettable memories...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Hm? Did my phone flash just now...?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (I thought something was happening in SEKAI, so I ended up going, but...)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (Perhaps I shouldn't have touched the ball of light that was sitting in front of MEIKO's cafe.)
se_walk_women_002_1
se_walk_men_002_1

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Oh! I had a feeling you'd be here too, Aoyagi!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Everyone! Why are you all here?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: That's what I wanna know. I was about to go to sleep when my phone suddenly started flashing...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Same here! Then I went to SEKAI and accidentally stepped on this ball of light...!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Um, we got to thinking... If we all ended up here, then maybe you would be here too. So we started looking for you.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I see...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: So, where are we?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
I'm not sure...
But it looks really similar to the satellite Puroland we went to today.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I think we should go try to find out if there's anyone else here just in ca—

rows.Speaker: Pochacco
rows.Line: Oh, hello! Are you all here to come hang out too?

rows.Speaker: An & Kohane
rows.Line: Po...Pochacco?!

rows.Speaker: Pochacco
rows.Line: You know who I am? That makes me happy!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: H-He's moving...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: And talking too.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
...!
Akito, are you alright?! He's moving and speaking, but...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Huh? Well, I know what you're getting at, but... I can handle this much.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Really? That's a relief...

rows.Speaker: Pochacco
rows.Line: Did I do something wrong?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Oh, nothing.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I'm sorry for not introducing myself sooner. My name is Toya Aoyagi.

rows.Speaker: Pochacco
rows.Line: Nice to meet you, Toya!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Oh, um...! My name is Kohane Azusawa!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: I'm An Shiraishi! Nice to meet you!

rows.Speaker: Pochacco
rows.Line:
Got it! Kohane and An!
Can I know your name too?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: I'm Akito Shinonome.

rows.Speaker: Pochacco
rows.Line:
Akito!
Hehehe. You all have such nice names!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Hey, I know this is going to sound weird, but... Are we in Puroland?

rows.Speaker: Pochacco
rows.Line: Nope. It's similar, but apparently this is a SEKAI that was formed from a fragment of a feeling.

rows.Speaker: Pochacco
rows.Line: It was probably formed from the feelings of wanting to visit Puroland again or thinking about how much fun it was.

rows.Speaker: Pochacco
rows.Line: That's what the friends I met here told me!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: So this really is a SEKAI.

rows.Speaker: Pochacco
rows.Line:
Hey, could you tell me more about yourselves?
You're all friends, right?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: We are, but we're also teammates working really hard to achieve our shared dream!

rows.Speaker: Pochacco
rows.Line: Dream?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Yeah. Our dream is to put on a music event that surpasses the legendary night known as RAD WEEKEND.

rows.Speaker: Pochacco
rows.Line: L-Legendary night?! That's so cool!

rows.Speaker: Pochacco
rows.Line: Was that event really that amazing?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Yeah! It was so exciting I could barely breathe...! I was heating up so much that I thought my heart was going to explode!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: I knew without a doubt that I wanted to put on an event as amazing as that one!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: And for me, it felt like I found the dream I wanted to devote my life to.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: After hearing stories about it from these two, we both decided to work towards achieving the same dream.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Lately, we've been learning a lot from An's dad, one of the people behind that legendary night.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: He's been really whipping us into shape.

rows.Speaker: Pochacco
rows.Line:
Whoa... G-Gotcha!
That's a wonderful dream, but it sounds really challenging to achieve...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I suppose you're right about that.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: But even so, we're able to push through the hardest of times because we have each other.

rows.Speaker: Pochacco
rows.Line: Friends really are important! I have my own group too, so I know how you feel.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Group?

rows.Speaker: Pochacco
rows.Line:
Yeah! Everyone's really great too!
Just being with them makes me feel reassured!

rows.Speaker: Pochacco
rows.Line: They think up stuff I wouldn't be able to, or find things I wouldn't be able to!

rows.Speaker: Pochacco
rows.Line: When I'm with them, I can do the things and go to the places that I wouldn't be able to on my own!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I understand. There's been a lot of things I was able to do because I had my friends.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Such as camping in particular.

rows.Speaker: Pochacco
rows.Line: Wow! Camping?! Did you all set up a tent and stuff?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: We set up our own tents, cooked together, watched the stars and sang songs as well. It truly was so much fun.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: There were a lot of firsts for you that time, huh, Toya?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Yeah! When we were cooking, Toya's eyes were sparkling when he showed me the peppers and said “Shiraishi, I did it!”

rows.Speaker: Pochacco
rows.Line: Hehe. It's great when something you're doing for the first time goes well!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Yes. Even the scenery I got to see on the train to the camping site was a first for me. Everything was a new experience.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I don't think I'll ever forget what I experienced that day.

rows.Speaker: Pochacco
rows.Line: That sounds so nice. I want to experience something unforgettable like that too.

rows.Speaker: Pochacco
rows.Line: But none of my friends from my group are here...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: How about us?

rows.Speaker: Pochacco
rows.Line: What?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: We may not be able to fill in your group's shoes, but I'm certain we can be friends.

rows.Speaker: Pochacco
rows.Line:
Really?!
You'd want to be friends with me?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Of course! I'd love to be your friend, Pochacco!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Me too!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: There has to be a reason why we met here.

rows.Speaker: Pochacco
rows.Line:
You guys!
Thank you!

rows.Speaker: Pochacco
rows.Line: Hehehe. Okay then, I want to take you to see my secret flower field!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Really?

rows.Speaker: Pochacco
rows.Line:
Yeah! Follow me!
It's this way!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Okay!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Pochacco, would you mind telling us about your group on the way to the flower field?

rows.Speaker: Pochacco
rows.Line:
You mean Badtz-Maru and the others?
Sure!
se_walk_men_002_1

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Aoyagi and Pochacco are already great friends, huh?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: I guess they really are alike. Just like you said, Akito.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Yeah, but... Your impression of him really was way off.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Ugh, quit it already. I was just playing around.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: What's wrong, everyone? If you don't keep up, you'll lose your way.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Right, coming!

Night
Toya's Room

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
So sleepy...
We did have another hard practice today...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (I've been feeling fatigued as well since I've been staying up so late recently. I should try to go to bed early tonight...)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (No, this is no time to be resting. Akito got everyone's attention for us through his performance.)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
(Just ten more minutes.
I need to—)

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: <Hi, Toya! How are you doing?>

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
KAITO...?
What brings you here at this hour?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
<Me? Well, you know...?
I wanted to see you since it's been so long!>

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: <Remember how you came to ask us for advice the other day? I've been wondering how you've been doing since then.>

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (Come to think of it, I haven't been to SEKAI in a little while... Did that cause them some concern?)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I apologize for not catching up with you sooner.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: <What? No, you don't need to apologize! We know you've been busy with practice and all.>

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: <Today's probably no exception. I'm sure you're tired.>

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
I am...
That evening event was also pretty draining.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: <What sort of event was it?>

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: A team that we performed with in a past event invited us to sing in theirs...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: The teams that performed there were all local legends, so they sort of had a home-field advantage...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
<I see...
That sounds like a tough event.>

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: <But... I'm sure you all managed to find a way to knock everybody's socks off!>

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
It wasn't that easy...
But I think we left our mark at the very least.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
<Ah, I had a feeling!
Hearing you say that makes me feel proud!>

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
It does?
Then, I'm glad I got this chance to tell you.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: So, KAITO, how have things been for you all lately?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
<Oh, us...?
Recently...>

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
<Ah, that's right!
We had a meeting recently where we came up with new menu items for MEIKO's cafe.>

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: <It wasn't all that serious, but we each presented our ideas and had MEIKO decide whether or not to try them out.>

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
That sounds like fun.
Did she end up using any of your ideas?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: <Yes! She decided to give Len's idea a try!>

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
Len's...?
What did he come up with?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
<Lemonade!
But not just any lemonade...>

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: <It's suuuper sour!>

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: <We all tried drinking it, but it was so sour that it made us all scream.>

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: And MEIKO was okay with that...?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: <Hehe. There's a reason behind that!>

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: <It tastes surprisingly good when you drink it after you practice singing for a while.>

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Ah, I see.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Now that you mention it, I've heard that lemon tastes better after you've worked up a sweat.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: <Exactly! She wanted you and the others to have something nice and refreshing during your breaks!>

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
<But it definitely was too sour.
She's apparently going to add some honey when it does become available for order.>

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
Yes, I see...
I'll ask the others to see if they'd like to try it out.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: <Great! Len probably won't know what to do with himself! Please be sure to tell him what you all think.>

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: <Between practicing and working on your individual tasks, I know you're all very busy right now...>

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: <But you should come over to take a break if you ever feel the need! MEIKO's place will always be your oasis!>

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: KAITO...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
You're right...
We'll try to rest when we can since we need to in order to perform at our best.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: <Yes, excellent!>

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
<Oh, I need to apologize!
I didn't mean to do all the talking...!>

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: <You're such a wonderful listener that I couldn't help myself... I'm sorry!>

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: No, um... That's not a problem.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (There's really no need for him to apologize. If anything, today...)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Thank you, KAITO.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
<Wait, why are you thanking me...?
I don't remember doing anything to be thanked for...>

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
No, that's not true.
I really appreciate what you've done.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
<You do...?
Then, I'm glad to hear that!>

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
<Anyway, Toya, good night!
Make sure to stay warm, and don't forget to set your alarm!!!>

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Thank you. I appreciate the concern.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I plan on getting a good night's rest so that I'm ready to do my best again tomorrow.
Street SEKAI
Alleyway

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Let's see...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Ah, here! It's this one!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Wow, you were right!
This looks just like the place in the picture you brought over, Toya!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
Yes...
I remember going to Vienna when I was little, and this place closely resembles it.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Whoa! So many travel magazines...!
Oh, there's even a photobook!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: You brought all of these over, Toya?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Yes, because the streets of that new area are from countries from around the world.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: You all seemed very interested in them, so I decided to bring these over for when you wanted to learn more about them.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: However, this is just what we had at my house, so they may be skewed in the places they cover...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
No, that's completely fine!
Thank you for bringing these over, Toya!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Oh, this person took pictures while walking across the United States! A 5,000-km photo shoot! How awesome is that?!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Wow, these photos are beautiful...
I'd love to see the northern lights someday.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Huh? There's a photo album mixed in...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Are you sure about us looking at this, Toya?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Hm? Oh, that's...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I decided to bring it over since it contains a lot of old photos from our trips to Vienna.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: That reminds me. You said the other day how you and your family always went to go see that music festival in Vienna every year...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Yes, and these are the photos from then.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Wow, these buildings are so pretty. Not only that...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
Hehe. Look at little Toya.
He's so cute.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
Yeah, he is!
This looks like your dad... But who's this old guy?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Oh, he taught conducting at the music school. I remember him being very nice to me. He even went out of his way to bake cookies for me.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
That one looks like...
One of the post-concert socials. A few of the other children were the same age as me, and they had us take a group photo...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: No matter how many times I hear about his family...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Y-Yeah... Their world seems so different from ours...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Oh!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
Kohane, take a look at this one!
The alleyway behind Toya is the spitting image of the one that appeared in SEKAI!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Huh? Oh, you're right...
We did walk down one that looked just like this.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
You did...?
I'd like to see it sometime if possible.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Then, why don't we go right now?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Now?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Yes, because how fun would it be to compare it with the photo?!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (This really does look just like the Vienna I saw when I was little...)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (I remember seeing so many resounding performances in this city. And the expectation was that I'd be able to do the same someday...)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (I still feel bad about not living up to those expectations. However, I...)

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Hey, check out this graffiti! Doesn't it look cool?!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Oh, you're right.
The white lettering kind of makes it feel hip and trendy.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: I was thinking this when I saw it in those pictures Toya showed us, but it's really surprising that even Vienna has graffiti!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
Yeah, it was.
I always thought Vienna would be spotless for some reason.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Yes, I remember seeing quite a lot under the bridges that spanned the Donaukanal.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
That takes me back...
My dad always scowled whenever he spotted it.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: As such, he never let me look at any up close like this.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: To be fair, it's easy for people who aren't used to seeing graffiti to take it as a bad sign.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Yes, I always used to tie graffiti to unsafe areas when I was little.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (But now...)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (I've broken free from classical music, and I've been accepted by streets like this, covered in graffiti.)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (Back then, I never would've thought to go near any places like this. But they've given me strength, warmth and so much more.)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (Dad trained me in classical music, but I've met new people who've shared a dream with me through street music. They're both important parts of who I am now.)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (And I plan on using everything I've experienced...to propel myself forward.)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
(As well as my dear friends.
We're going to see what it's like from on top of the world!)
Vivid Street

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: It got dark pretty fast.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Yes, we should start heading home soon...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Huh...?
Where'd I put my phone?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: You put it on the counter so that you could record us singing.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Oh, right!

rows.Speaker: An's Voice
rows.Line:
Wait, I can't find it...!
Where'd it go...?!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Want me to call it for you, An?

rows.Speaker: An's Voice
rows.Line:
Yes, please!
Wait, no...! I left it on silent!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Where's she searching...?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
It's not over there.
It should be on the counter by the stage.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
Geez...
I'll be right back.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Okay.
se_walk_men_001_1

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Should we go help...?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I think it'll be fine. Akito seems to know where she left it.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
That reminds me...
I was going to do some research for our endeavor.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Endeavor...? Oh, on how to be a model...?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: To be fair, my plan was to buy a few magazines and see how actual models pose...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: No, I really appreciate you doing that.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: I promise to find us a good location for our shoot, so you can leave that and the photography to me.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Ah, thank you.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Which just leaves doing my makeup...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Oh, about that...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Sorry about that, Kohane, Toya!
I finally found my phone!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Thanks for the help, Akito!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
Sure thing.
Anyway, let's start heading home.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Yes, let's.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: I'll message you about this later...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Okay.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: What's going on? Are you two having a secret conversation...?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
Uh, yes...
About a homework problem.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Wait, what...?
I was gonna ask for more details, but I'll pass...
Toya's Room

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: The poses the people in this magazine are doing seem relatively simple...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: This person's facing forward while having their hands in their pockets. And this person has their hands over their jacket buttons...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (Come to think of it, that website I found yesterday about “The Rules of Modeling” said something about being “the star of the show”...)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: The star...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Right. Their goal is to show the reader the appeal of the clothes they're wearing.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: In other words, they're all posing in a way that brings out the best in these outfits.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Therefore, for this photo contest, I'll also need to pose in a way that allows the star of the show to shine in the spotlight.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: And I'm supposed to put on makeup in a way that reflects the theme of the contest.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: So, the star of the show is... My makeup?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Speaking of which, Azusawa was trying to tell me something earlier...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
Oh, she just sent me a message...
Her timing couldn't have been better.

rows.Speaker: Kohane's Message
rows.Line: <Sorry about not sending you this sooner!>

rows.Speaker: Kohane's Message
rows.Line: <One of the other girls from my year agreed to help us with your makeup. Her name's Haruka Kiritani.>

rows.Speaker: Kohane's Message
rows.Line: <She even said she'll give us pointers on posing and stuff as a model!>

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Haruka Kiritani...?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
I remember now.
Shiraishi's best friend, yes? Also, if I recall correctly, a famous idol.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I'm guessing she knows quite a lot about makeup and modeling.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (I was worried that I wouldn't be able to help Azusawa much, so I'm glad we're having someone like her join us.)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
<Thank you for letting me know.
It'll be nice to have someone like her helping us.>

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (I can have her teach me more about makeup and modeling the day of.)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (But for now...)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I should do a little more research on what makes a pose aesthetically pleasing.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Alright, I'll try combing through this magazine a little more.
The day after Valentine's Day
Kamiyama High School - Class 2-B

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Good morning.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Morning, Toya♪

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
Akiyama...
It's rare to see you here so early.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Just keeping my attendance up.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Also, Toya, I have a bunch of questions that I wanna ask you!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Ask me?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
You entered that photo contest, right?
I literally fell over when Ena told me about what happened yesterday!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Seriously, how did I not hear about it!
I'm never ever going to forgive myself for missing out on such a fun-sounding event!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Don't be so hard on yourself...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
No, I can't shake this feeling!
Mind you, I was so guttered that it even drove me to come to school in the morning!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
I see.
Actually, maybe it was a good thing that you did.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: How?!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: I mean, you had Haruka Kiritani helping you guys out right?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Yes, she was very polite and helpful.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Of course she was!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Grr... No fair!
I want her to teach me about makeup and modeling!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
No, on second thought...
I'd be so nervous and worried over a bunch of things that I would probably freeze up completely.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: If I recall correctly, you also know quite a lot about makeup. So, Akiyama, from your point of view, how did I look?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Awesome!
A perfect score in my book!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I see...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I'm glad you're saying that since we put in quite a lot of effort.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: While we're on the subject, some of our classmates also congratulated me on our success.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: What?! Our classmates saw those pictures?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Yes. Right after I arrived at school on Monday...

rows.Speaker: Classmate A
rows.Line: Hey, Toya, the guy in these pictures... It's you, right?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
Yes, that's me...
They were submitted into that photo contest.

rows.Speaker: Classmate B
rows.Line:
Really...?!
And you finished in the top ten?! Congrats!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Thank you. But I was just the model. The photographer and adviser I had helping me deserve most of the credit.

rows.Speaker: Classmate C
rows.Line: So, they put on makeup for you?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: No, I did while being given step-by-step instructions. It went pretty well considering it was my first time.

rows.Speaker: Classmate C
rows.Line: You did this yourself?!

rows.Speaker: Classmate B
rows.Line: More importantly, how'd you end up being a model?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I was doing a teammate a favor.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: But I also wanted some of the chocolates that were being offered as the prize to give as a gift for Valentine's Day.

rows.Speaker: Classmate B
rows.Line: For Valentine's Day...?!

rows.Speaker: Classmate A
rows.Line:
Really?
Who were they for? Tell us!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Akito and a few other friends.

rows.Speaker: Classmate A
rows.Line: Y-Your friends...?

rows.Speaker: Classmate B
rows.Line:
You're lying...! No, wait...
Knowing you, that makes sense.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
Would you all like some...?
If so, I'll make sure to set some aside.

rows.Speaker: Classmate B
rows.Line:
No, I'll pass!
But thanks for offering.

rows.Speaker: Classmate C
rows.Line: Yeah, let's leave it at that...

rows.Speaker: Classmate A
rows.Line:
Agreed...
Sorry for getting the wrong idea...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Hahahahahaha!!!!!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
S-Seriously?! Hahaha...!
I... I can't breathe...!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Was it that funny...?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: From what I understand, I raised everyone's hopes and dashed them the next second...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Y-Yeah, you did...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: But that's also why we all like you, Toya.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
Really...?
Then, I'll take it as a positive.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
*Sigh*
Your story made coming to school today totally worth it.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: But I wanna hear more about what happened yesterday. Did everyone enjoy those chocolates?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Yes, they all did.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: The way Shiraishi and Akito reacted after they heard about the photo contest was also fairly amusing.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Oh, tell me more about that!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Okay. Then, let me start from the beginning.
Toya's Room

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Interesting. Going over how counterpoints work again was a good idea. I might be able to put them to use in my song...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
Hm? It's three in the morning?
I seem to have lost track of time...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (That explains why I'm starting to feel sleepy... But I don't have time for that right now...)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I'll go pour myself some coffee...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <Aha, I knew it. You're still up.>

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
...!
Oh, Miku, it's you...
What brings you here so late?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <I was just patrolling around.>

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Patrolling?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <Yes. I heard that you've been tasked with writing all of your team's songs for surpassing RAD WEEKEND.>

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <So, I came to see if you weren't pushing yourself too hard.>

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <But I guess you were...>

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Oh, I was just...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
No, you're right...
I'm up this late, so it's only natural for you to think that I'm burning the candle at both ends.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I apologize for making you worry. I promise to be more careful.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <Okay, as long as you understand.>

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <By the way, what's this book you were reading just now...?>

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Oh, this?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
I borrowed it from my dad's study.
I was hoping that it'd contain some helpful information.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
<Oh, it's your dad's?
It looks old, but pristine at the same time.>

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
It is.
He likes to take good care of his books.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I remember reading many during our lessons together when I was little...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <Toya...?>

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
Oh, I'm sorry...
It's nothing that important...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: But I was just reminded of how I accidentally damaged one of his books...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <Oh, I see.>

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <Still, I'm having a hard time imagining you doing that. What happened that time, Toya?>

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: After practices, I always made sure to stay in my dad's study whenever I decided to read one of his books...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Because I wanted to learn to do what he could.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: However, one day, I took a book into the living room and ended up falling asleep on top of it...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: As a result, a few pages got creased...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
<Oh, I'd be scared too...
I mean, I can see your dad getting really mad.>

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Yes, I can't think of any other time in my life when I panicked so much.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: But then, my mom came along and said...

rows.Speaker: Toya's Mother
rows.Line: Oh, you fell asleep on top of it...?

rows.Speaker: Toya's Mother
rows.Line: But you were just trying to do your best to learn as much as you can about classical music, yes?

rows.Speaker: Toya's Mother
rows.Line: I'm sure your father will understand since you're looking for ways to become a better musician...

rows.Speaker: Toya's Mother
rows.Line: So, let's go apologize to him together, shall we?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <Your mom's so nice.>

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Yes, she made me feel a lot better that time...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: We went over to my dad's study together afterwards.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <So, what happened...?>

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: When I showed my dad the book, he immediately saw the creased pages...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I still remember vividly the way he moved his finger along the folds...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: But...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: He didn't scold me in any way.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <What?>

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: He said, “Take good care of any books you read.”

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
“That being said, it's good that you're so studious. Just be careful next time.”
...is what he told me.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <Hehe. I see...>

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <Both your mom and dad noticed how hard you were trying.>

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Yes. As hard as those lessons were, they always watched over me with a warm gaze.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (Despite all the affection they showed me, I ended up disappointing them...)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
(No...
Now's not the time to be reminiscing.)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
(I have work to do.
I need to focus on that..)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
Thank you for stopping by, Miku.
It was nice having someone to talk to like this.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: But I'm going to keep working for a little while longer. I need this song to be extraordinary...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
<Okay...
Then, I'll head back now.>

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <But don't forget that we're watching over you too, Toya, so feel free to ask if you ever need any help.>

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <Anyway, good night.>

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Thank you. Good night.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Back then and even now, I have people watching over me.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
Which is why I need to succeed this time.
I'm not going to disappoint anyone.
Aoyagi Household - Kitchen

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Mom, can I put away these plates now?

rows.Speaker: Toya's Mother
rows.Line:
Yes, please do.
Thank you for not just washing them, but also putting them away, Toya.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: No, this is the least I could do after causing you so much concern.

rows.Speaker: Toya's Mother
rows.Line: Hehe. In that case, I will take you up on your offer.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
Of course.
By the way...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Is Dad coming home late again today?

rows.Speaker: Toya's Mother
rows.Line: Yes, well... The final performance for his concert is today, so he may not be back until very late.

rows.Speaker: Toya's Mother
rows.Line: He is also probably going to go get dinner somewhere. Plus, he has his fellow performers and audience to think about.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Right...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (I was hoping to talk to him about something...)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
That's too bad...
Maybe another time...
I'm back.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: What?
se_walk_men_005_1

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: We thought you weren't coming home until much later. I hope your concert went well.

rows.Speaker: Toya's Father
rows.Line: It's rare to see you welcoming me home like this...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Yes, so... There's something I'd like to tell you, Dad.

rows.Speaker: Toya's Father
rows.Line: Tell me?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Yes. It's about my song.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I'd like to report that I managed to finish it.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: And I was only able to after hearing what you said, Dad...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: So, thank you.

rows.Speaker: Toya's Father
rows.Line: Alright...

rows.Speaker: Toya's Father
rows.Line: Is that all?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Oh, um... I have it saved here on this USB drive. If you'd like...

rows.Speaker: Toya's Father
rows.Line:
Sorry, but I have work to do.
I don't have time to listen to your song right now...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
Understood...
But will you at least take it for now...?

rows.Speaker: Toya's Father
rows.Line: Alright...

rows.Speaker: Toya's Father
rows.Line: I'll be going up to my room now.

rows.Speaker: Toya's Mother
rows.Line: Oh, if you're going to be working tonight, would you like me to bring you some tea later?

rows.Speaker: Toya's Father
rows.Line:
Yes, that'd be nice.
Thank you.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (I got a chance to report to Dad about my song and gave him that drive.)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (I feel a little relieved...)
The next day

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (Anyway, it's a little early, but I should also get going...)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (Today's event seems like a very high-level one, so I need to get myself prepared mentally...)

rows.Speaker: Toya's Mother
rows.Line: Toya, wait!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Hm? Yes, Mom...?

rows.Speaker: Toya's Mother
rows.Line: I put together a lunch for you using the leftovers from last night. Please take it with you if you like. Also...

rows.Speaker: Toya's Mother
rows.Line: I think your father already listened to your song last night.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: What...? He did...?

rows.Speaker: Toya's Mother
rows.Line: Yes. When I went to take some tea up to his room, he had this very serious look on his face.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I see...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
Thank you for telling me, Mom.
I'll be going now.

rows.Speaker: Toya's Mother
rows.Line: Okay, good luck.
se_walk_men_001_1

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (I'm walking a different path to Dad and my brothers now...)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (He won't be teaching me anything like he used to. He won't be praising or scolding me either.)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
(He took the time to listen to my song.
The song I put my heart and soul into...)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (I couldn't be happier right now.)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
So...
I need to do the same for my next one.
Cafe

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I can see why you recommended this cafe so much, Azusawa. This place has a nice atmosphere to it.

rows.Speaker: Kotaro
rows.Line:
And it feels so trendy!
I'm glad we came! This feels like the perfect place for us to take our break!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Hehe. I'm glad to hear that you guys like it so much.

rows.Speaker: Kotaro
rows.Line: While we're on the subject, this place's deluxe strawberry coffee's supposed to be really good, right?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Yes, that's right! It was very good when I had it. They make it using a generous helping of real strawberries.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Interesting. That explains all the strawberries I saw in those photos. Also, Mita, it says here that the owner's family runs a strawberry farm...

rows.Speaker: Kotaro
rows.Line: Really?! Now I'm getting jealous...!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
But it looks awfully sweet...
As curious as I am about it, I sort of wondering whether or not I should just order their regular coffee...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Oh, actually!
You can order one to make it not too sweet.

rows.Speaker: Barista
rows.Line: I can help whoever's next here!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Oh, that register's open.
Let's go order!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: O-Okay...
se_walk_men_002_1
se_walk_women_002_1

rows.Line:
Welcome!
What can I get for you today?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Um, I'd like...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: A skinny deluxe strawberry coffee with white chocolate chips, please. Double whip, double vanilla.

rows.Speaker: Toya & Kotaro
rows.Line: Hm?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
(Wh-What did she just say...?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Oh, umm... I ordered their deluxe strawberry coffee with white chocolate chips as a topping.

rows.Line: Some extra whipped cream and vanilla as well. Also, I asked for them to use fat-free milk instead.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
Ah, I see...

rows.Speaker: Kotaro
rows.Line: What...? After just that explanation?!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
Yes.

rows.Line: That being said... It may not be the best idea for me to repeat what she said due to my dislike of sugary things.

rows.Line: So, Azusawa, I'm sorry, but would you mind giving me a recommendation?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Oh, okay! Let's see...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Ah, to take out the syrup and whipped cream.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Exactly! Also, you could ask for extra espresso if you want to enjoy the taste of their coffee more.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: But I'm not sure how much you should add. It might be good to ask them about that.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
Okay, thank you...
I'll try ordering that.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Excuse me. I'm ready to order.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I'd like your deluxe strawberry coffee, please. No syrup, no whip. Some extra espresso as well, but...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: How much would you recommend putting in? I'm actually not all that fond of sugary drinks, and I was hoping to enjoy the taste of your coffee...

rows.Speaker: Barista
rows.Line:
Got it.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Then, three shots it is.

rows.Speaker: Barista
rows.Line: Okay, it'll be right out.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I was able to give them my order. Thank goodness.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Congratulations, Aoyagi!

rows.Speaker: Kotaro
rows.Line:
That was amazing!
Alright, now I've gotta get my order right...!

rows.Speaker: Kotaro
rows.Line: Mind lending me a hand, Azusawa...?!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Sure. So, Mita, since you like strawberries so much...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Oh, this is very good.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: On top of it being not too sweet, the rich taste of this coffee matches these strawberries incredibly well.
