rows.Speaker: Izumi
rows.Line: Hahaha. I'd say you're cocky, but I suppose a rival worthy of me should have that level of confidence.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Let's put on a great performance.

rows.Speaker: Izumi
rows.Line: Yeah.
Hotel - Cafe Entrance
se_walk_men_002_1

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
Hey.
You looking at something on your phone?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Good morning, Akito.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I just received a message from my brother.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Your brother? The one who introduced us to Mr. Lloyd?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
No, not Shuji.
My oldest brother, Natsuomi.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Huh...?

rows.Speaker: Natsuomi's Message
rows.Line: <Shuji told me that you're over in the US.>

rows.Speaker: Natsuomi's Message
rows.Line: <I was hoping that we could talk, but I unfortunately haven't been able to find the time. I want to tell you at least this.>

rows.Speaker: Natsuomi's Message
rows.Line: <Toya. Few have the privilege of leading lives free of regret. You could probably say that no such people exist.>

rows.Speaker: Natsuomi's Message
rows.Line: <However, at the very least, I'm hoping that you're able to pursue your dream with your friends without any regrets.>

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
Really...?
Your oldest brother gave you his blessing?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Yes...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: That's great.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: You told me you guys weren't really close because he's so much older than you, so I pictured someone like your dad...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: But he seems sympathetic about how you feel.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Yes.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: In retrospect, we likely became distant because I was subconsciously trying to get away from him.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Just as I wanted to avoid my dad...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Yeah, I know that was a tough time for you, but you're doing pretty well for yourself now. That includes how things are between you, your dad and your brothers.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
I mean, my family's sort of the same.
But I don't think you've actually met my dad yet.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
I don't know much about your dad...
But your sister seems very caring.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Caring? Her?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Anyway, moving on...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
You're doing really well.
Especially when it comes to your dad.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Yes, I suppose I am.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: No, don't suppose. You are.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Because you were able to work up the courage to actually face him, you know how he really feels now.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
Yes, that's true...
I am glad that I know now.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: He was simply trying to do what he could to ensure my happiness.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Come to think of it, when we first teamed up, I remember becoming really irritated every time your dad came up.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Because I couldn't figure out why he wasn't letting his son do what he wanted.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
Yes, I remember...
You used to get very angry each time.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: That's because you refused to get mad.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Just so you know, the look of hopelessness on your face also bugged me.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: I honestly thought that you should try to get your way by using whatever means necessary, even if you had to punch him in the face.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I see. My hand hurts just thinking about that.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Obviously, you'd never actually hit your dad or anything...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: But in another world, I might've ended up barging into your house to give him a piece of my mind.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Yes, that's certainly a possibility.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: However, if that did happen, then that would've likely been it for us.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: After all, my dad did keep saying that you were a bad influence on me.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Wait, I was the problem?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Of course, I tried to convince him otherwise, but he refused to budge.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (Back then, the way he belittled Akito irritated me so much that I tried arguing back...)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (But now, we can laugh about it.)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (Because I was able to face him, tell him how I feel and blaze my own trail.)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (Which is nice.)
Street SEKAI

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Thank you both for agreeing to practice with me today, MEIKO, KAITO.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO & KAITO
rows.Line: You're welcome.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: The others may also be done practicing and making their way over to the cafe.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
So, I'll be excusing myself here.
See you two in a little bit.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Okay, see you.
se_walk_women_001_1

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Then, why don't we take the scenic route back?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: That sounds good.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Oh, in that case, would you like to head over to the plaza?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: The plaza? Sure, but why?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I'd like to check up on the tree.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Oh, hey! Look over there!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Wow...!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: The tree's even bigger now...?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
Right.
I can certainly understand why you'd like to make sure it's doing okay.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: After all, it's only natural to worry about something your feelings created!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Thank you. I feel that we should make sure it's doing okay since it just underwent a tremendous growth spurt.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: KAITO?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
Ahem!
I'm all for that, Toya!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: So, let's go! Right now!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Okay.
se_walk_men_001_1
se_walk_men_001_2

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Ever since we came into contact with those black fragments, I keep thinking...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: What if things went differently that day?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
What do your true feelings tell you right now?
Do you really not want to do this with me anymore?!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Is there no part of you that wants to get up on that stage with me?! If there is, then somewhere in there you must have the same dream of surpassing RAD WEEKEND that I have!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: What if we hadn't told each other how we actually felt?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: What if that nightmare were real, and this were all a dream?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Hmm... That's a difficult one to unravel.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: But you managed to wake up from that terrible dream, so I wouldn't worry too much about any what ifs.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Yes, you're right.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
But I feel a little too lucky right now...
I fear that I'm going to wake up and realize that this was all a dream.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: I see.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
Stop right there for me, Toya.
Now, turn your back towards me.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Huh? Like this...?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Yes! Just like that, and...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
...?
Oh, are you...?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Hehe. I'm going to be your alarm!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Good morning, Toya!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Whenever you feel that this is all a big dream, Toya, then come talk to me. I'll be there to wake you up.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: By slapping your back and saying, “Good morning!”

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: So, let's try to enjoy the present!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: The present...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: That's right! The future starts with the present, does it not?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Which is why I believe it's important to enjoy the present. The more fun you have now, the brighter your future will be!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: However, based on your personality, you'll also need to keep reminding yourself about how you truly feel from time to time.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: How I truly feel...?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Oh, did that ring a bell?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
Yes...
I just remembered something very important.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: During that dream, I think I heard all your voices...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: You did?! You heard us calling your name?!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: We actually kept shouting your names the whole time to try and get you all to wake up.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
...!
I had no idea.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
Hehe. Now you know.
Rin and Len shouted so much, I thought they were going to lose their voices.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
You should go thank them later.
I'm sure they'll really appreciate it.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Yes, I'll do just that!
Street SEKAI
Crase Cafe

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Today's coffee was delicious as always. Thank you very much.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Hehe. I'm glad to hear that.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Toya, it's your birthday soon, isn't it? Are you having a party with everyone?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: We haven't had the time to discuss it, really.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: We do plan to have a party! But our hotel rooms are pretty cramped, after all, so we're a bit stuck on what to do.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: It feels like it'd be a challenge to get a reservation somewhere, too. No guarantee we'd make ourselves understood to the employees.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Well hey, why not hold it in SEKAI then? We'd love to celebrate with you too!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Thank you. If the others are okay with it, I see no issue with that idea.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Okay, sure! Also, you don't have to worry about us. It's your birthday, so we should do what you want to do.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Let us know if there's anything you'd like to do for the party.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Anything I'd like to do...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Anything you can think of, we'll be happy to help!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: It's your special day, after all. Just let us know.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: In that case, I'd enjoy trying a vacuum coffee maker.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Vacuum?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: It's a kind of coffee maker that uses glass vessels to brew.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Oh, is that that thing I see KAITO using sometimes?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: That's right. It makes an extra-fragrant brew, and the actual brewing process feels like a science experiment, so it's fun too.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: I could teach you about it if you like. Want to try together?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Yes, please.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: I'm sure you'll do great. But what made you want to try it out in the first place?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I recently bought some good beans at a coffee shop in the US.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: The employee there told me that these beans have an especially fine aroma, so I should use them with a vacuum coffee maker.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Wow, that's definitely exciting! I'd love to smell them for myself.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Hey, don't forget it's Toya's special day, not yours!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Hahaha, I know.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: So if KAITO's handling the coffee side of things... What can the rest of us do?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Hmm...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: I know! Why don't we make some snacks that'll go well with coffee? Like cookies!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Sounds good to me. Toya does like them.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Are you sure? I don't want you all to feel obligated, but it would make me very happy.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Hehe. I'll really put some elbow grease into them, so look forward to it.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Oh, um... Yeah! Let's do our best together, Miku!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Alright! We'll make the best cookies ever!

rows.Speaker: An, Kohane & Rin
rows.Line: Yeah!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Thank you, everyone. I'll do my best to brew delicious coffee for us all, too.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (I would be satisfied just spending my birthday with everyone... But it seems like it'll be an especially enjoyable day.)
Several days later
Toya's birthday

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: As a practice run, why don't you try making three cups first?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Right.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: First, put three cups of water in the carafe and set it.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
Alright.
Now I turn on the flame and set it to boil, yes?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: That's right. You can use this chain attached to the top container to see if it's boiling.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Place the container like so, with the chain inside the carafe, and...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Ah, the chain is starting to bob around.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: When you see bubbles running up the chain, that's the sign it's boiling.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I see... That's fascinating.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Now we put the ground coffee in the top container, use it to seal the carafe, and...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Oh, look at that. The boiling water is traveling up the container's spout.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: It really does feel like a science experiment.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Hehe. This is one of the best parts of making coffee this way.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Now all you have to do is use this wooden spatula to press the grounds into the water and mix them around.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: It takes less work than I had imagined. And the air is already full of the refreshing scent of coffee. I can't wait to taste it.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: We'll have cookies, too! I wonder how everyone's doing?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: An, is this enough mixing for the wet ingredients?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Perfect! Hand that over to Miku and the others so they can start mixing in the flour.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Okay, got it!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: It seems to be going well. Shiraishi has overall command, and the others have split up their duties.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Okay. I think we can rest easy—

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Miku, we got the cookie stuff from Kohane!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Alright. I'll sift in the flour, so you do the mixing.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: A-Are you sure? Want me to do it?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Don't worry about it. I've actually read up on it this time.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: If you overmix cookie dough, it affects the texture. So...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: We're aiming for as little mixing as possible. Which means the flour is going in all at once.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: All at once...?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Ready? Here goes.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Whoa!
Ah... Aah... Ah-choo!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Wow, look at that cloud of flour...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Looks like we won't have any dough ready to wrap for resting anytime soon.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Nope. For now, let's clean up this flour.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Right. Let's break out the brooms!
A few hours later
Crase Cafe

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Do you all have your cookies and drinks?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Yeah! All set!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Okay! Without further ado...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Happy birthday, Toya!

rows.Speaker: Everyone
rows.Line: Happy birthday!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Thank you, everyone. You made so many cookies... They look delicious.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: The coffee you made for us smells great, too! And it's poured right from the carafe, too! How classy.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: That's right. Part of the appeal of a vacuum coffee maker is in its presentation, after all, so I'm glad you like it.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Try a cookie too, Toya! I made the star-shaped ones myself.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Oh, don't mind if I do.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Hey, Len, that's not fair!
Toya, try my musical note cookies too!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I will. You made them in so many different shapes.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: MEIKO let us use her collection of cookie cutters.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: It was a lot of fun using them all together!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: It really is a nice feeling, sharing coffee and snacks with everyone.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Yeah, it's not bad once in a while. Though this isn't all we've got planned either.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Huh? What do you mean?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Ahem! Attention, please! It's time to begin today's entertainment!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: I present to you... The SEKAI Trivia Tournament!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Trivia tournament...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Alright, I'll start by explaining the rules!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: There will be a total of 13 questions! We'll go round-robin on announcing each question.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Write your answers down on these whiteboards. We have a special prize ready for whoever gets the most questions right.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I see. I am fairly confident in my trivia knowledge, so I intend to win here.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Well, look who's confident. We're not holding back just because it's your birthday.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Nor would I want you to.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Okay, I'll start us off! Let's see who gets this one right!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Which genre of music, born in the United States, combines the rhythms of swing with improvisation?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Oh, I know this one!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: “The rhythms of swing” is a big hint.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Okay, everyone's done writing! The answer is...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Jazz! Was it a little too easy, maybe?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Just right for the first question, right?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I think so too. And the connection to the United States was appreciated, too.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Okay, my turn! Mine's pretty hard, so everyone be ready.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Hmm, it looks like Miku is in the lead right now.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: I have seven points, and next is Toya with five, I think.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Len's trick question tripped me up. I couldn't help but overthink it.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Sorry, Toya. Looks like I'm winning the crown today.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: There are still three questions left. I haven't given up just yet.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: The battle is heating up. Just in time for a very important announcement!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: This just in: These last three questions will be special questions!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Special questions?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: You'll find out what's so special about them at the answers! Kohane, take it away?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Okay! Special question number one!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: What are the named roles in musical theatre called?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (The named roles in musical theatre...)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (I recall hearing about this from Kusanagi during Shibu Schools Fest...)

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Hmm, I don't know if I know this one.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: It's a pretty hard one.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Um, it looks like everyone's finished writing. So, the correct answer will be read by... A special guest!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: <We'll be the ones announcing the correct answer! Go for it, Nene!>

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: <Um, the answer is 'principal role'. Did everyone get it right?>

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: <Did you get it? And also! Toya! Happy birthday!!!>

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: <Happy birthday. You're in the United States right now, right? When you get back, I'd love to talk to you about composing again.>

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: <I'd be interested to hear about the US, myself. I have a present for you too, so I'll give it to you when you get back.>

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: <This has been your special guests! Keep on battling for the high score!>

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Saki... And Hoshino and Kusanagi, too...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Kohane asked them for a trivia question and a special video for you. Pretty surprising, right?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: It certainly was. I didn't expect to receive a video message...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: We have more special questions too. While you're thinking of the answers, try to guess who they're from!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: The next question is... What photography technique involves intentionally loosening the focus to create blur?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Photography...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (Could it be...?)

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Looks like everyone's done. This answer is brought to you by...!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: <The correct answer is 'soft focus'. I believe that's the technique Kohane used when she took those modeling photos of Aoyagi.>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <It was probably pretty simple if you know your cameras... What did everyone think?>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <Also... Happy birthday, Toya!>

rows.Speaker: Haruka, Airi & Shizuku
rows.Line: Happy birthday!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: <I'm so glad we can send you our best wishes even when you're so far away. I hope your birthday has been lovely.>

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: <I know you're in the US studying for your music career, but you can take it easy for today, at least. See you again sometime!>

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: And that was from Haruka and friends! Who got it right... Just Toya!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: It's all thanks to Azusawa telling me during the shoot.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: That ties the rankings, I think. Is the next question the last one?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: That's right. So whoever gets it right is the winner.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Okay, the final question! Trumpets can have various coatings. Which lacquer produces the most powerful sound?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Trumpets, huh? That reminds me of when Toya helped with that instrument event and practiced with one.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: That was just with the mouthpiece, really. To think that experience would serve me now...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (Hm, no, these questions are likely...)

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Everyone done? Okay, here's the answer!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
<Heya, Toya♪
Enjoying your birthday party?>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Here's the answer for this one, from the two who thought it up!>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <Um, the correct answer is gold lacquer.>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: <This one was a little hard, so we included a hint in there. Did everyone get it?>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <I sure didn't! But if you think about the colors, then you could make an educated guess, so it's a pretty solid question!>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Anyway, once again! Happy birthday, Toya♪>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <Happy birthday. I hope it's a good one.>

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: The last question was from Mizuki and friends! Toya and Rin got it right, and so did Len and Luka. Which means...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: The winner of the SEKAI Trivia Tournament is... Toya Aoyagi!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Congratulations, Aoyagi! And here's your prize!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: This is...a wristband?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: That's right! You can wear it during shows, and it's understated enough to wear in daily life too, right?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: It is. Thank you very much. I'll take good care of it.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Congrats, Toya. I was so close...but you beat me fair and square.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Actually, those special questions...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: No, never mind. Thank you all very much.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Hehe, you're very welcome!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (Having so many people send me their well-wishes... I truly am fortunate.)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (And thinking back, I've made memories with so many people.)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (Each one is precious to me.)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (I want to continue treasuring the connections I build with people... And the memories I make with them.)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Happy birthday, Toya! Are you enjoying your American birthday?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Japan and America are really far apart from each other... But I'm sending happy happy birthday waves all the way there to you!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: I wanted to celebrate with a super-long-range birthday cannon as well, but sadly, the technology is only theoretical at this stage.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: To make up for it, we'll welcome you home with a truly fantastical spectacle.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: That's right! We'll merge your welcome home party with your belated birthday bash! We'll have a special show waiting for you too, so look forward to it!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Happy birthday again, Toya! Did you solve the question we...by which I mean Kanade and Mafuyu, came up with?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: You seemed very knowledgeable about trumpets, so maybe it was a little too simple in the end.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: I only helped with that one question... But I hope you had fun with the game.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: We've got presents for you when you get back! Enjoy the rest of your stay in the US with everyone!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Happy birthday, Aoyagi. Given the occasion, I thought a question related to a memory we shared would be best. How did you like it?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Your photos really turned out great that day, Toya. You, Azusawa and Kiritani worked so well together.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: The bond you share with Kohane truly came through in the photo as well.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Let's have another group photoshoot someday. We don't even have to be rivals this time, either.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Oh, yeah. That might be fun.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Happy birthday again, Toya. Keep on doing your best out there with Akito and the others!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Happy birthday, Aoyagi. It's a strange feeling, sending a video message to a friend all the way in the United States.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: You're over there to see the real thing when it comes to your style of music, right? I'm sure being around all those people will be an amazing experience.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Yeah! It makes me want to do more for us, too!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Toya! When you get home, let's compose together again! And go out for food with Tsukasa! Hehehe, I have so many fun plans ready!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: It looked like you really enjoyed the trivia contest. It was fun having all of us write messages on your new wristband, too.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Yeah! I think you did sort of see through our special question idea, though.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: That's what happens when you ask people for questions specifically based on their memories with Toya. Still, it made for a good look back, I bet.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: I think so too. It makes me want to think of trivia questions based around our memories, too.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: That's fun! I really wanna make some super hard questions, ones Toya might be right on the edge of forgetting about!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: I can't decide where to start. There's too much to pick from.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Anyway, happy birthday, Toya. Let's keep on getting up on stage, building up our experience... And someday, stand on top of the world.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Today was so much fun. I got to try my hand at a vacuum coffee maker, and the cookies everyone made were delicious.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I didn't expect them to come up with a game just for me. I'll have to send my thanks to the special question guests, too.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: And to all of you who sent me happy wishes for today, thank you.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: My team and I will keep on chasing our dream.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: And I promise to keep on bringing you the greatest music I can.
Flea Market

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: They have more food trucks lined up over here.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
Oh? Hey, they've got a big selection.
Birria, lobster rolls and... How do you read this? Souvlaki?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: I've never heard of a lot of these foods before...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: I can imagine what lobster rolls involve, but I honestly have no idea what birria and souvlaki are.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: They're not things you see very often in Japan.

rows.Speaker: Slade
rows.Line: Souvlaki's a type of meat that's grilled on a skewer. They serve it with this yogurt sauce called tzatziki.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Wait, yogurt sauce?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: We grill all sorts of meat on skewers in Japan, but we usually use soy marinade and stuff...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: I'm curious as to what it tastes like.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Then, what about birria?

rows.Speaker: Cedric
rows.Line: It's a type of stew that's made using chilis and herbs. People get hooked on the spiciness and flavor of the meat.

rows.Speaker: Slade
rows.Line: You eat it by dipping tortillas in it, and it's amazing! I bet you guys would love it!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I see. That does sound good.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Since we're here, why don't we give it a try?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Yeah. A few other things caught my eye, but...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Huh...?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Is something wrong?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: No, I just noticed that they're selling American dogs over there...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: But they're calling them something else.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
You're right.
Let's see... It says “corn dogs”.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Yes, that's what they're called over here.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
It seems it's because they use cornmeal...
A flour made using crushed corn.

rows.Speaker: Slade
rows.Line: Hey, you know your stuff, Toya!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I learned about it during one of my previous visits overseas.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Corn flour...
Aren't they made using wheat flour in Japan?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: So, these ones taste a bit different?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: That's certainly a possibility.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Still, it's interesting how the same food can be prepared differently depending on the country you're in.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: We've been hit by surprises left and right since coming here! For example, the size of the hamburgers!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Yes, and that also applies to music.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Oh, are you talking about the alleyway behind the academy?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: It was very similar to Vivid Street, but different types of music were being played there.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Yeah, everything from classical to pop.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: People were even playing traditional folk music. I'd never heard anyone put on that kind of street performance before.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Me neither. It's nice that we're getting to experience these differences in culture firsthand.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Even small discoveries, like the names of food, help us better ourselves and enrich our perspectives.

rows.Speaker: Cedric
rows.Line: Wow...

rows.Speaker: Cedric
rows.Line: That's an interesting way to approach visiting another country. It's actually kind of cool.

rows.Speaker: Slade
rows.Line: Didn't expect we'd hit on something so profound when this all started with corn dogs, though!

rows.Speaker: Slade
rows.Line: Or wait, is this one of those cultural differences too?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: No, this is more Toya culture than Japanese culture...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Hehe. He's just like that.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
Anyway, I digress...
Since we're here, why don't we have ourselves some corn dogs?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I believe tasting the difference for ourselves is the best solution.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Oh, I'm in!
I really wanna have one now!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Me too. I can't wait to see what they taste like.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Then, let's go buy some.
Flea Market
se_walk_men_001_1

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Pretty cool sneaker shop over there.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: They've got a lot of brands that you don't see back in Japan. Find anything interesting on your end?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Yes, but I'm having some trouble choosing.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
Hm...?
Wait, you're looking at tableware?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: This is apparently what you normally find in your standard American diner.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Oh, now that you mention it, I was wondering why these looked so familiar.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Like these dishes with the lines around the edges. Oh, and these mugs.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: They all have a uniquely American feel to them.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: And they're surprisingly cheap.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: They were apparently rotated out for newer stock, which is why they're being offered at a special discount right now.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
You don't say. Still, I'm surprised.
I didn't realize you were interested in this kind of stuff.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Not exactly...
<Look at those cups! They seem so fancy!>
<Luka, wait. You're going to stick out like a sore thumb.>

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Hm?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: That sounded like...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: <Haha. I'm sorry.>

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: <We apologize for interrupting your shopping.>

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Not at all. Anyway, what brings you two here?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: <We were curious about the flea market. So, we decided to come take a look.>

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
<We were trying to be discreet...
Is it okay for us to stay?>

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Umm...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Yes, you can stay.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: <Great! Don't mind us, then!>

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: <We've actually been taking peeks here and there for a little while now. I can't believe how many shops they have here.>

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
<Right? It's so exciting!
And just look at these stylish dishes!>

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: <I agree. Colorful dishes like these might even make the food at the cafe taste more delicious.>

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Is there anything in particular that you like?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
<Hmm... Oh, I really like these mugs!
They're so cute and colorful!>

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
<Blue, red and yellow...
Seeing them all lined up like this is so much fun!>

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Yes, vivid colors such as these can have an uplifting effect.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: <I think my favorite are these divided lunch plates, because of their simple design.>

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: <These subdued colors should help the food on them stand out. And these partitions allow you to serve several things all at once without the flavors running together. As such, they seem very practical.>

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Yes, they do seem rather versatile.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: <Oh, I also really like those over there...>

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: <Thank you for letting us look at tableware with the both of you. We had a lot of fun.>

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: <We hardly ever get these kinds of opportunities. I enjoyed getting to see things up close!>

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I'm also glad that you two had a chance to join us.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Hey, Toya, Akito!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Hm? They're calling for us.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: <Then, we'll excuse ourselves here.>

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: <This was a lot of fun! See you later!>

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Okay, see you.
se_walk_women_001_1
se_walk_men_001_2

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Let's go over that way next, you guys.
Slade and Cedric said there's a shop that they really recommend!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Alright, we'll head over once we've finished making our purchases over here.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Okay!
Then, we'll meet you guys there.
se_walk_women_001_2
se_walk_men_001_3

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: You're going to buy something here?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Yes, I'm thinking about buying some things for everyone in SEKAI.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Luka and MEIKO both showed great interest, after all. And I had been thinking I'd like to thank them somehow.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Even while we're here in the US, they've been taking the time to come talk to us and watch us practice.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Ah, that's why you were looking at dishes and stuff.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Something they can use at the cafe would be good, no?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Right. But are you sure about buying everything now?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: I don't think it's a good idea to take a bunch of fragile things to a music event.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: You're right. I'll have to take everything over to SEKAI the next chance I get.
New York City - Park

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I wasn't expecting to get a chance to go sightseeing in the park...

rows.Speaker: Cedric
rows.Line: It's big, open and full of greenery, so I'm sure you'll enjoy it.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Yes, thank you. I'm sure I will.

rows.Speaker: Elena's Voice
rows.Line:
Ceddy, hold up a sec!
There's something I wanna ask you about the park!

rows.Speaker: Cedric
rows.Line:
Okay.
Sorry, Toya, I'll be right back.
se_walk_men_001_1

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (It's a little hard to believe that we all performed in an event just now...)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (We'll do a full debriefing once we get back to the hotel... But I can already say that we weren't at our best.)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (As a team, our English pronunciation skills still require quite a bit of work, which prevented us from really channeling our feelings. I know I was far from perfect myself.)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
(Plus, Embers and illys were both incredible.
Especially illys, when...)

rows.Speaker: Elena
rows.Line: “Here we go, you guys!”

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
(That song was so explosive.
I'm staggered every time I think about it.)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (The track alone was pioneering. And yet, uncannily balanced at the same time.)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (The world of music is just so vast. I'm always learning new things, and I got to encounter another incredible track.)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (I really am grateful.)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (But that's not the only example. There was also...)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (Those jam sessions at the academy. That sensation, of different genres of music overcoming disparate origins and melting into one...)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (I could see my horizons expanding before my very eyes...)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (It was different from learning from a book. Each encounter with a new sound is...special.)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (Soma's incomplete track that Tono told me about comes to mind.)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (It felt so free, like wind rushing through your hair. It felt wild and gentle at the same time. I felt envious of the person who wrote it.)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (And then, I began wanting to produce those sorts of songs.)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (I honestly couldn't believe how well things went when we sang with Shiraishi and Azusawa for the first time in SEKAI.)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (If there was any one moment that solidified our musical style, that would be it.)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
(Then there's my first encounter with music.
My roots lie in...)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (That sound.)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (The beautiful sound that Dad played. I'll never forget it for as long as I live.)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
(I wanted to play beautiful music like him.
I wanted to learn how to do that.
That was my first real encounter with music...)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (And the person standing here now has been shaped by all the music which he's encountered until now.)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I feel very fortunate.
Fortunate?
se_walk_men_001_2
se_walk_women_001_1

rows.Speaker: Cedric
rows.Line: Oh, sorry. I didn't mean to startle you.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
No, that's okay...
More importantly, is something the matter?

rows.Speaker: Elena
rows.Line:
Ceddy came to get you, and I followed him!
We came to tell you that we've decided where we're going.

rows.Speaker: Elena
rows.Line: But we heard you saying how you're very fortunate. Something good happen?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
Oh, not exactly...
I was just thinking about some things....

rows.Speaker: Cedric
rows.Line: What things?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
Well...
As the songwriter for Vivid BAD SQUAD, I gained quite a lot from hearing the track you made, Elena.

rows.Speaker: Elena
rows.Line: Wait, mine?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Yes. I said this when we were all sharing our opinions, but I thought it was very good.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Not only was it a difficult song, you two blew everyone away by performing it flawlessly. Your power shook all of us to our cores.

rows.Speaker: Cedric
rows.Line:
I agree.
I learned a lot from how bold you were too, Elena.

rows.Speaker: Elena
rows.Line:
Hehe. Thanks!
Keep the praise coming!

rows.Speaker: Cedric
rows.Line: Don't get too ahead of yourself.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: It all got me thinking about the world of music, and how vast it really is.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Be it Vivid Street or the United States, I've been able to encounter music which I'd never even imagined before in my life.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
Wonderful songs which moved my heart,
songs full of sounds I've never heard before that enrich me as a person...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Both things have had a positive impact on me.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Thus, I feel very fortunate about having been able to make all those musical encounters.

rows.Speaker: Cedric
rows.Line: Toya...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I've been lucky to meet so many people, and learn from and be influenced by them. Thanks to them, my compositional skills have improved.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: That being said, the world of music is vast, and I'm still yet to reach the heart of it...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: My music still has much room to grow.

rows.Speaker: Cedric
rows.Line: I'm impressed you're able to talk like this after hearing such an unbelievable song.

rows.Speaker: Elena
rows.Line: Hehe. That's what I like to hear!

rows.Speaker: Cedric
rows.Line:
Also...
I think there's more to this story than just luck.

rows.Speaker: Cedric
rows.Line: It's no accident that you have a sharp eye and keen perception for these things, Toya. You worked hard to achieve that, right?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
Yes, that's also true...
Thank you.

rows.Speaker: Cedric
rows.Line: As your opponent, I can't afford to let my guard down, huh?

rows.Speaker: Elena
rows.Line:
Haha. No, you can't!
Let's have ourselves a good battle, Vivid BAD SQUAD, Embers!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Yes, and we don't plan on losing.
Airport
se_walk_men_002_1

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I'm sorry for making you all wait.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
No, that's okay. We also just got back together.
Were you able to buy some nice souvenirs, Aoyagi?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Yes, I'm very happy with my purchases.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Thank goodness!
Then, let's start showing each other what we all got!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: What? Why do we have to—?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Don't you wanna know?
You do, right, Toya?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
Yes, I suppose...
I am a little curious.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
*Sigh*
Alright, fine. It's not like I need to hide it.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Then, let's start with...
The person who got back first!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Which is me.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: I bought my mom and Ena some tea and chocolates.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Wait, what about that big bag? Is it also full of souvenirs?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
Oh, these are for me.
Hoodies and other clothes that I can only buy over here.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
Anyway, that's it for me.
Who got here after me? Kohane, right?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Oh, right!
An already knows since she helped pick them out with me, but...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Kohane picked out the cutest stuff!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: You said you were buying things for your family, yes? What did you get for them, Azusawa?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
So, I got them a set of mugs.
Unfortunately, my dad said that his broke last month.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Hehe. Her dad's been struggling to find a good replacement so much that he's been using a Japanese teacup for everything.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Oh, that's too bad. But I'm sure he'll like it since you got it just for him, Azusawa.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: And it's very big, so he'll be able to drink a lot out of it.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: The designs are nice too. Did you pick red and blue ones on purpose to match?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Yeah. I thought it'd be nice to buy a pair, so my mom and dad can use them together.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Anyway, An, I think you're next!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Okay.
I got... Ta-daa! Juice in glass bottles!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: The bottles look really fancy, so you could use them as decorations once they're empty, don't you think? I was thinking about turning some into lamps.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Hey, that's a pretty good idea coming from you.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: What? If it's a fight you want, then it's a fight you'll get.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
I also think it's a good idea.
I didn't realize glass bottles could be refashioned in such a way. I always just disposed of them.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Thanks...
Anyway, last but not least, Toya, you're up!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: You spent ages talking to that shop assistant. Find anything good in the end?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: They showed me which products were selling the best, as well as what each famous brand had to offer. Thanks to them, I was able to find some chocolates which match my parents' preferences.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: They should enjoy these very much.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
I see.
I'm glad you were able to find something good.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Speaking of which, Aoyagi, didn't you also buy some tea for your mom at that shop by the academy?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Yes, she asked me to buy some black tea for her while I was here.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
I also picked out some coffee beans for the whole family...
They let me try a few different types, and I was able to find one which I liked.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I don't know if they'll all like it, since I chose based on my own preferences, but...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: I don't think you have anything to worry about.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
Yeah.
It has to be good if you chose it.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: What he said! I'm sure they're gonna love it!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Really...?
